Dhanwantari's son was known by the name of Ketumān whose son was the heroic Bhimaratha (28). His son was the king Divodāsa. The pious-souled Divodāsa became the king of Bārānashi (29). O king, at this time the Rakshasa Kshemaka, an attendant of Rudra, made the city of Bārānashi divested of its inhabitants (30). The intelligent and high-souled Nikumbha uttered a curse against Bārānashi saying, "Thou shalt forsooth have none to live in thee for one thousand years" (31). As soon as this curse was pronounced against Bārānashi the king Divodāsa laid out his charming capital on the bank of Gomati (near Bārānashi) (32). Formerly Bārānashi belonged to Bhadrashenya, son of Mahishmān, of the Yadu race. Having slain the hundred sons of Bhadrasenya who were all most excellent bowmen Divodāsa acquired that city. Thus Bhadrasenya was deprived forcibly of his kingdom by the (king Divodāsa) (33–34).
verses.explanation: ययातिने मध्यदेशके राज्य-सिंहासनपर पूरुका अभिषेक किया। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: अमावसुरिति ख्यातमायोः पुत्रं यशस्विनम् । अद्रिकाप्सरसायुक्तं विमानेऽधिष्ठितं दिवि ॥ ३० ॥
verses.transliteration: amāvasuriti khyātamāyoḥ putraṃ yaśasvinam | adrikāpsarasāyuktaṃ vimāne'dhiṣṭhitaṃ divi || 30 ||

verses.sanskrit: सा तेन व्यभिचारेण मनसः कामरूपिणी । पितरं प्रार्थयित्वान्यं योगभ्रष्टा पपात ह ॥ ३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sā tena vyabhicāreṇa manasaḥ kāmarūpiṇī | pitaraṃ prārthayitvānyaṃ yogabhraṣṭā papāta ha || 31 ||
verses.hindi: जरायां बहवो दोषाः पानभोजनकारिताः । तस्माज्जरां न ते राजन ग्रहीतुमहमुत्सहे। प्रतिग्रहीतुं धर्मज्ञ पुत्रमन्‍्यं वृणीष्व वै स एवमुक्तो यदुना राजा कोपसमन्वितः। उवबाच ददतां श्रेष्ठो ययातिर्गईहयन् सुतम् क आश्रयस्तवान्यो5स्ति को वा धर्मो विधीयते। मामनादृत्य दुर्बुद्धे तदहं॑ तव देशिकः

verses.transliteration: trīṇyapaśyad vimānāni patamānā divaścyutā | trasareṇupramāṇāni sāpaśyatteṣu tān pitṝn || 32 ||

verses.sanskrit: सुसूक्ष्मानपरिव्यक्तानग्नीनग्नीष्विवाहितान् । त्रायध्वमित्युवाचार्ता पतन्ती तानवाक्शिराः ॥ ३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: susūkṣmānaparivyaktānagnīnagnīṣvivāhitān | trāyadhvamityuvācārtā patantī tānavākśirāḥ || 33 ||

verses.sanskrit: तैरुक्ता सा तु मा भैषीरिति व्योम्नि व्यवस्थिता । ततः प्रसादयामास तान् पितॄन् दीनया गिरा ॥ ३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tairuktā sā tu mā bhaiṣīriti vyomni vyavasthitā | tataḥ prasādayāmāsa tān pitṝn dīnayā girā || 34 ||

verses.sanskrit: ऊचुस्ते पितरः कन्यां भ्रष्टैश्वर्यो व्यतिक्रमात् । भ्रष्टश्वर्या स्वदोषेण पतसि त्वं शुचिस्मिते ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: ūcuste pitaraḥ kanyāṃ bhraṣṭaiśvaryo vyatikramāt | bhraṣṭaśvaryā svadoṣeṇa patasi tvaṃ śucismite || 35 ||

verses.sanskrit: यैः क्रियन्ते हि कर्माणि शरीरैर्दिवि दैवतैः । तैरेव तत्कर्मफलं प्राप्नुवन्तीह देवताः ॥ ३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: yaiḥ kriyante hi karmāṇi śarīrairdivi daivataiḥ | taireva tatkarmaphalaṃ prāpnuvantīha devatāḥ || 36 ||
verses.hindi: याप्ि: प्रत्याहरेत॒कामान्सर्वतो5ड्रानि कूर्मवत् न जातु काम: कामानामुपभोगेन शाम्यति। हविषा कृष्णवर्त्मेव भूय एवाभिवर्धते यदा भावं न कुरुते सर्वभूतेषु पापकम्। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा ब्रह्म सम्पद्मयते तदा यदा नेच्छति न द्वेष्टि ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—O foremost of Bharatas, hear of the birth of Dhanwantari. When ambrosia was being churned out in the days of yore Dhanwantari arose from the ocean. Enveloped completely with personal grace he came out of the vessel of ambrosia. Meditating on Vishnu who grants success in business he stood up as soon as he saw Him (11–13). Vishnu said to him "As you have come out of water you will be known by the name of _Avja_." And so he passed by the name of Avja (14). Avja then replied:—"O lord I am your son. Confer upon me therefore, O lord of celestials, a share in the sacrificial offerings and a place in this world." Thus addressed and seeing him the Divine Lord spoke to him the truth (15). "The gods, who present themselves at _Yajnas_, have already made apportionments of sacrificial offerings amongst themselves. The great saints too have dedicated various articles of oblation to various gods. Know therefore, I shall not be able to give you any thing however trifling it may be, that is not mentioned in the Vedas. O my son, you have been born after the gods and so you will not be able to partake of sacrificial offerings (16–17). In your second birth you will gain renown in the world. While in the womb you will acquire _Animā Siddhi_⁵⁷ (18). With that body you will acquire the dignity of a god. The twice-born ones will worship you with _Charu_, _Mantra_, vows and _Japas_ (19). You will propagate Ayurveda with its eight divisions. This work, which is sure to come off, is known to you in your watery birth (20). When the second Yuga Dwāpara will set in you will undoubtedly take your birth again." Having conferred this boon on Dhanwantari Vishnu disappeared again (21). Thereupon when the second Dwāpara Yuga set in Sunohotra's son Dirghatapā, the king of Kashi, desirous of having a son, began carrying on hard austerities affording delight to his worshipful deity saying (22)—"I shall lay myself under the protection of that god who will confer on me a son." That king worshipped the deity Avja for a son (23). Thereupon that Divine lord, being pleased with the king, said to him "O you of good vows, I shall grant you any boon that you may choose to have" (24). The king said "O lord, if thou art pleased be born unto me as my illustrious son." Then saying "Let it be so" he disappeared therefrom (25). The deity Dhanwantari was then born in his house. He became the king of Kāshi who could destroy all diseases (26). Having acquired the kowledge of Ayurveda from Bharadwāja he divided the work of the physicians into eight classes and then conferred it upon his disciples (27). Dhanwantari's son was known by the name of Ketumān whose son was the heroic Bhimaratha (28). His son was the king Divodāsa. The pious-souled Divodāsa became the king of Bārānashi (29). O king, at this time the Rakshasa Kshemaka, an attendant of Rudra, made the city of Bārānashi divested of its inhabitants (30). The intelligent and high-souled Nikumbha uttered a curse against Bārānashi saying, "Thou shalt forsooth have none to live in thee for one thousand years" (31). As soon as this curse was pronounced against Bārānashi the king Divodāsa laid out his charming capital on the bank of Gomati (near Bārānashi) (32). Formerly Bārānashi belonged to Bhadrashenya, son of Mahishmān, of the Yadu race. Having slain the hundred sons of Bhadrasenya who were all most excellent bowmen Divodāsa acquired that city. Thus Bhadrasenya was deprived forcibly of his kingdom by the (king Divodāsa) (33–34).
verses.explanation: याप्ि: प्रत्याहरेत॒कामान्सर्वतो5ड्रानि कूर्मवत् न जातु काम: कामानामुपभोगेन शाम्यति। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: सद्यः फलन्ति कर्माणि देवत्वे प्रेत्य मानुषे । तस्मात्त्वं तपसः पुत्रि प्रेत्येदं प्राप्स्यसे फलम् ॥ ३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: sadyaḥ phalanti karmāṇi devatve pretya mānuṣe | tasmāttvaṃ tapasaḥ putri pretyedaṃ prāpsyase phalam || 37 ||

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ता पितृभिः सा तु पितॄन्प्रासादयत्स्वकान् । ध्यात्वा प्रसादं ते चक्रुस्तस्याः सर्वेऽनुकम्पया ॥ ३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: ityuktā pitṛbhiḥ sā tu pitṝnprāsādayatsvakān | dhyātvā prasādaṃ te cakrustasyāḥ sarve'nukampayā || 38 ||

verses.sanskrit: अवश्यं भाविनं ज्ञात्वा तेऽर्थमूचुस्ततस्तु ताम् । अस्य राज्ञो वसोः कन्या त्वमपत्यं भविष्यसि ॥ ३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: avaśyaṃ bhāvinaṃ jñātvā te'rthamūcustatastu tām | asya rājño vasoḥ kanyā tvamapatyaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 39 ||

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नस्य पृथिव्यां तु मानुषेषु महात्मनः । कन्या च भूत्वा लोकान्स्वान्पुनः प्राप्स्यसि दुर्लभान् ॥ ४० ॥
verses.transliteration: utpannasya pṛthivyāṃ tu mānuṣeṣu mahātmanaḥ | kanyā ca bhūtvā lokānsvānpunaḥ prāpsyasi durlabhān || 40 ||

verses.sanskrit: पराशरस्य दायादं त्वं पुत्रं जनयिष्यसि । स वेदमेकं ब्रह्मर्षिश्चतुर्धा विभजिष्यति ॥ ४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: parāśarasya dāyādaṃ tvaṃ putraṃ janayiṣyasi | sa vedamekaṃ brahmarṣiścaturdhā vibhajiṣyati || 41 ||

verses.sanskrit: महाभिषस्य पुत्रौ द्वौ शन्तनोः कीर्तिवर्द्धनौ । विचित्रवीर्यं धर्मज्ञं तथा चित्राङ्गदं शुभम् ॥ ४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: mahābhiṣasya putrau dvau śantanoḥ kīrtivarddhanau | vicitravīryaṃ dharmajñaṃ tathā citrāṅgadaṃ śubham || 42 ||

verses.sanskrit: एतानुत्पाद्य पुत्रांस्त्वं पुनर्लोकानवाप्स्यसि । व्यतिक्रमात्पितॄणां च जन्म प्राप्स्यसि कुत्सितम् ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: etānutpādya putrāṃstvaṃ punarlokānavāpsyasi | vyatikramātpitṝṇāṃ ca janma prāpsyasi kutsitam || 43 ||

verses.sanskrit: अस्यैव राज्ञः कन्या त्वमद्रिकाया भविष्यसि । अष्टाविंशे भवित्री त्वं द्वापरे मत्स्ययोनिजा ॥ ४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: asyaiva rājñaḥ kanyā tvamadrikāyā bhaviṣyasi | aṣṭāviṃśe bhavitrī tvaṃ dvāpare matsyayonijā || 44 ||

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ता तु दाशेयी जाता सत्यवती तदा । मत्स्ययोनौ समुत्पन्ना राज्ञस्तस्य वसोः सुता ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktā tu dāśeyī jātā satyavatī tadā | matsyayonau samutpannā rājñastasya vasoḥ sutā || 45 ||

verses.sanskrit: वैभ्राजा नाम ते लोका दिवि सन्ति सुदर्शनाः । यत्र बर्हिषदो नाम पितरो दिवि विश्रुताः ॥ ४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: vaibhrājā nāma te lokā divi santi sudarśanāḥ | yatra barhiṣado nāma pitaro divi viśrutāḥ || 46 ||

verses.sanskrit: तान् वै देवगणाः सर्वे यक्षगन्धर्वराक्षसाः । नागाः सर्पाः सुपर्णाश्च भावयन्त्यमितौजसः ॥ ४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tān vai devagaṇāḥ sarve yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ | nāgāḥ sarpāḥ suparṇāśca bhāvayantyamitaujasaḥ || 47 ||

verses.sanskrit: एते पुत्रा महात्मानः पुलस्त्यस्य प्रजापतेः । महात्मनो महाभागास्तेजोयुक्तास्तपस्विनः ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.transliteration: ete putrā mahātmānaḥ pulastyasya prajāpateḥ | mahātmano mahābhāgāstejoyuktāstapasvinaḥ || 48 ||
verses.hindi: जनमेजयस्य राजर्षेमहाशालो5भवत् सुतः । देवेषु स परिज्ञातः प्रतिष्ठितयशा भुवि उशीनरं च धर्मज्ञं तितिक्षुं च महाबलम् तपसा वै सुमहता जाता वृद्धस्य भारत राजेन्द्र ! उन कन्याओंके नाम इस प्रकार हैं--रुद्रा,

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां मानसी कन्या पीवरी नाम विश्रुता । योगा च योगिपत्नी च योगिमाता तथैव च ॥ ४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā pīvarī nāma viśrutā | yogā ca yogipatnī ca yogimātā tathaiva ca || 49 ||

verses.sanskrit: भवित्री द्वापरं प्राप्य युगं धर्मभृतां वरा । पराशरकुलोद्भूतः शुको नाम महातपाः ॥ ५० ॥
verses.transliteration: bhavitrī dvāparaṃ prāpya yugaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varā | parāśarakulodbhūtaḥ śuko nāma mahātapāḥ || 50 ||

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यति युगे तस्मिन् महायोगी द्विजर्षभः । व्यासादरण्यां सम्भूतो विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन् ॥ ५१ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyati yuge tasmin mahāyogī dvijarṣabhaḥ | vyāsādaraṇyāṃ sambhūto vidhūmo'gniriva jvalan || 51 ||

verses.sanskrit: स तस्यां पितृकन्यायां पीवर्यां जनयिष्यति । कन्यां पुत्रांश्च चतुरो योगाचार्यान्महाबलान् ॥ ५२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tasyāṃ pitṛkanyāyāṃ pīvaryāṃ janayiṣyati | kanyāṃ putrāṃśca caturo yogācāryānmahābalān || 52 ||
verses.hindi: दो पुत्रोंकी जन्म दिया-धर्मज्ञ हशीनर और महाबली तितिक्षु॥ २३ ॥ उशीनरकी पाँच पत्लियाँ थीं, जो राजर्षियोंके कुलमें उत्पन्न हुई थीं। उनके नाम इस प्रकार हैं--नृगा, कृमी, नवा, दर्वा और पाँचवीं दूषद्वती॥ २४॥ उनके गर्भसे उशीनरके पाँच पुत्र हुए, जो अपने वंशकी मर्यादाको ऊँचे उठानेवाले थे। भारत! वे अपने वृद्ध पिताके महान् तपसे उत्पन्न हुए थे दृषद्वत्यास्तु संजज्े शिविरौशीनरों नृपः। शिबेस्तु शिबयस्तात यौधेयास्तु नृगस्य ह शिबेश्र पत्राश्चत्वारो वीरास्त्रैलोक्यविश्रुता: । वृषदर्भ: सुवीरश्च मद्रकः कैकयस्तथा

verses.explanation: दो पुत्रोंकी जन्म दिया-धर्मज्ञ हशीनर और महाबली तितिक्षु॥ २३ ॥ उशीनरकी पाँच पत्लियाँ थीं, जो राजर्षियोंके कुलमें उत्पन्न हुई थीं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: दो पुत्रोंकी जन्म दिया-धर्मज्ञ हशीनर और महाबली तितिक्षु॥ २३ ॥ उशीनरकी पाँच पत्लियाँ थीं, जो राजर्षियोंके कुलमें उत्पन्न हुई थीं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णं गौरं प्रभुं शम्भुं कृत्वीं कन्यां तथैव च । ब्रह्मदत्तस्य जननीं महिषीं त्वणुहस्य च ॥ ५३ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇaṃ gauraṃ prabhuṃ śambhuṃ kṛtvīṃ kanyāṃ tathaiva ca | brahmadattasya jananīṃ mahiṣīṃ tvaṇuhasya ca || 53 ||

verses.sanskrit: एतानुत्पाद्य धर्मात्त्मा योगाचार्यान्महाव्रतान् । श्रुत्वा स्वजनकाद् धर्मान्व्यासादमितबुद्धिमान् ॥ ५४ ॥
verses.transliteration: etānutpādya dharmāttmā yogācāryānmahāvratān | śrutvā svajanakād dharmānvyāsādamitabuddhimān || 54 ||

verses.sanskrit: महायोगी ततो गन्ता पुनरावर्तिनीं गतिम् । यत्तत्पदमनुद्विग्नमव्ययं ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् ॥ ५५ ॥
verses.transliteration: mahāyogī tato gantā punarāvartinīṃ gatim | yattatpadamanudvignamavyayaṃ brahma śāśvatam || 55 ||

verses.sanskrit: अमूर्तिमन्तः पितरो धर्ममूर्तिधरा मुने । कथा यत्रेयमुत्पन्ना वृष्ण्यन्धककुलान्वया ॥ ५६ ॥
verses.transliteration: amūrtimantaḥ pitaro dharmamūrtidharā mune | kathā yatreyamutpannā vṛṣṇyandhakakulānvayā || 56 ||
verses.hindi: तस्य ते तनयाः सर्वे क्षेत्रजा मुनिपुड़वात्। सम्भूता दीर्घतपस: सुदेष्णायां महौजस: नृगाके पुत्र नृग थे, कृमीके गर्भसे कृमिका जन्म हुआ था, नवाके पुत्र नव तथा दर्वके सुब्रत हुए तात! दृषद्वतीके गर्भसे उशीनरकुमार राजा शिबिका जन्म हुआ। शिबिको शिबिदेशका राज्य मिला और नृगको यौधेय प्रदेशका॥ २७॥ नवको नवराष्ट्र तथा कृमिको कृमिलापुरीका राज्य प्राप्त हुआ। सुब्रतके अधिकारमें अम्बष्ठ देश आया। अब शिबिके पुत्रोंका वर्णन सुनो
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—O foremost of Bharatas, hear of the birth of Dhanwantari. When ambrosia was being churned out in the days of yore Dhanwantari arose from the ocean. Vishnu said to him "As you have come out of water you will be known by the name of _Avja_." And so he passed by the name of Avja (14). Avja then replied:—"O lord I am your son. Confer upon me therefore, O lord of celestials, a share in the sacrificial offerings and a place in this world." Thus addressed and seeing him the Divine Lord spoke to him the truth (15). "The gods, who present themselves at _Yajnas_, have already made apportionments of sacrificial offerings amongst themselves. The great saints too have dedicated various articles of oblation to various gods. Know therefore, I shall not be able to give you any thing however trifling it may be, that is not mentioned in the Vedas. O my son, you have been born after the gods and so you will not be able to partake of sacrificial offerings (16–17). In your second birth you will gain renown in the world. While in the womb you will acquire _Animā Siddhi_⁵⁷ (18). With that body you will acquire the dignity of a god. The twice-born ones will worship you with _Charu_, _Mantra_, vows and _Japas_ (19). You will propagate Ayurveda with its eight divisions. This work, which is sure to come off, is known to you in your watery birth (20). When the second Yuga Dwāpara will set in you will undoubtedly take your birth again." Having conferred this boon on Dhanwantari Vishnu disappeared again (21). That king worshipped the deity Avja for a son (23). Thereupon that Divine lord, being pleased with the king, said to him "O you of good vows, I shall grant you any boon that you may choose to have" (24). The king said "O lord, if thou art pleased be born unto me as my illustrious son." Then saying "Let it be so" he disappeared therefrom (25). The deity Dhanwantari was then born in his house. He became the king of Kāshi who could destroy all diseases (26). As soon as this curse was pronounced against Bārānashi the king Divodāsa laid out his charming capital on the bank of Gomati (near Bārānashi) (32). Formerly Bārānashi belonged to Bhadrashenya, son of Mahishmān, of the Yadu race. Having slain the hundred sons of Bhadrasenya who were all most excellent bowmen Divodāsa acquired that city. Thus Bhadrasenya was deprived forcibly of his kingdom by the (king Divodāsa) (33–34).

verses.science: तस्य ते तनयाः सर्वे क्षेत्रजा मुनिपुड़वात्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुकाला नाम पितरो वसिष्ठस्य प्रजापतेः । निरता दिवि लोकेषु ज्योतिर्भासिषु भासुराः । सर्वकामसमृद्धेषु द्विजास्तान् भावयन्त्युत ॥ ५७ ॥
verses.transliteration: sukālā nāma pitaro vasiṣṭhasya prajāpateḥ | niratā divi lokeṣu jyotirbhāsiṣu bhāsurāḥ | sarvakāmasamṛddheṣu dvijāstān bhāvayantyuta || 57 ||
verses.hindi: बालेय क्षत्रिय कहलाते हैं ॥ ३४ ॥ बलिके कुलमें बालेय ब्राह्मण भी हुए, जो इस भूतलपर उनके वंशकी वृद्धि करनेवाले थे। भरतनन्दन! ब्रह्माजीने बलिपर प्रसन्न होकर तुम्हारी आयु एक कल्पकी होगी, तुम युद्धमें अजेय होओगे, धर्ममें तुम्हारी प्रधानता होगी, तुम तीनों लोकोंकी देखभाल करोगे (अथवा तुम तीनों लोकोंकी सभी बातें प्रत्यक्षकी भाँति देखोगे)। तुम्हारी संतति श्रेष्ठ समझी जायगी, बलमें तुम्हारी समानता करनेवाला कोई न होगा, तुम धर्मतत्त्वके ज्ञाता होओगे तथा भूतलपर चारों वर्णोंको नियन्त्रणमें रखकर उन्हें मर्यादाके भीतर स्थापित करोगे।' भगवान् ब्रह्माजीके ऐसा कहनेपर राजा बलिको बड़ी शान्ति मिली ॥ ३५--३८ ॥ उनके वे सभी पुत्र क्षेत्रज थे। मुनिवर दीर्घतपाद्वारा रानी सुदेष्णाके गर्भसे प्रकट हुए थे। उनका बल महान् था

verses.sanskrit: तेषां वै मानसी कन्या गौर्नाम्ना दिवि विश्रुता । तवैव वंशे या दत्ता शुकस्य महिषी प्रिया । एकशृङ्गेति विख्याता साध्यानां कीर्तिवर्द्धिनी ॥ ५८ ॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ vai mānasī kanyā gaurnāmnā divi viśrutā | tavaiva vaṃśe yā dattā śukasya mahiṣī priyā | ekaśṛṅgeti vikhyātā sādhyānāṃ kīrtivarddhinī || 58 ||
verses.hindi: अधृष्य: सर्वभूतानां कालापेक्षी चरतन्नपि। कालेन महता राजन् स्वं च स्थानमुपागमत् तेषां जनपदा: पञ्ञ अड्भा वड़ा: ससुहाका: । कलिड्डाः पुण्ड्रकाश्रैव प्रजास्त्वड्रस्य मे श्रुणु दथधिवाहनपुत्रस्तु राजा दिविरथो5भवत् विद्वान् धर्मरथो नाम तस्य चित्ररथः सुतः

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिगर्भांस्ताँल्लोकान् समाश्रित्य व्यवस्थिताः । ये त्वथाङ्गिरसः पुत्राः साध्यैः संवर्द्धिताः पुरा ॥ ५९ ॥
verses.transliteration: marīcigarbhāṃstā~llokān samāśritya vyavasthitāḥ | ye tvathāṅgirasaḥ putrāḥ sādhyaiḥ saṃvarddhitāḥ purā || 59 ||

verses.sanskrit: तान् क्षत्रियगणास्तात भावयन्ति फलार्थिनः । तेषां तु मानसी कन्या यशोदा नाम विश्रुता ॥ ६० ॥
verses.transliteration: tān kṣatriyagaṇāstāta bhāvayanti phalārthinaḥ | teṣāṃ tu mānasī kanyā yaśodā nāma viśrutā || 60 ||

verses.sanskrit: पत्नी सा विश्वमहतः स्नुषा वै वृद्धशर्मणः । राजर्षेर्जननी चापि दिलीपस्य महात्मनः ॥ ६१ ॥
verses.transliteration: patnī sā viśvamahataḥ snuṣā vai vṛddhaśarmaṇaḥ | rājarṣerjananī cāpi dilīpasya mahātmanaḥ || 61 ||

verses.sanskrit: तस्य यज्ञे पुरा गीता गाथाः प्रीतैर्महर्षिभिः । तदा देवयुगे तात वाजिमेधे महामखे ॥ ६२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya yajñe purā gītā gāthāḥ prītairmaharṣibhiḥ | tadā devayuge tāta vājimedhe mahāmakhe || 62 ||
verses.hindi: चतुरज्गके पुत्र पृथुलाक्ष कहे गये हैं। पृथुलाक्षके पुत्र महायशस्वी राजा चम्प हुए॥ ४८॥ चम्पकी राजधानी चम्पा थी, जो पहले मालिनीके नामसे प्रसिद्ध थी। चम्पके पुत्र हर्यड्रा हुए, जो पूर्णभद्र नामक मुनिकी कृपासे उत्पन्न हुए थे॥ ४९ ॥ विभाण्डकपुत्र ऋष्यश्वुड्रने हर्यज्रकी सवारीके लिये इन्द्रके उत्तम वाहन गजराज ऐरावतको मन्त्रोंद्वारा स्वर्गसे भूतलपर उतारा था हर्यड्गके पुत्र राजा भद्ररथ कहे गये हैं। भद्गरथके पुत्र राजा बृहत्कर्मा थे॥५१॥ बृहत्कमके पुत्र बृहदरर्भ थे, उनसे बृहन्मनाका जन्म हुआ। राजेन्द्र ! बृहन्मनाने जयद्रथ नामक पुत्रको जन्म दिया, जिससे राजा दृढरथकी उत्पत्ति हुई । जनमेजय ! दृढरथके पुत्र विश्वजित् हुएु
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—O foremost of Bharatas, hear of the birth of Dhanwantari. When ambrosia was being churned out in the days of yore Dhanwantari arose from the ocean. Enveloped completely with personal grace he came out of the vessel of ambrosia. Meditating on Vishnu who grants success in business he stood up as soon as he saw Him (11–13). Vishnu said to him "As you have come out of water you will be known by the name of _Avja_." And so he passed by the name of Avja (14). Avja then replied:—"O lord I am your son. Confer upon me therefore, O lord of celestials, a share in the sacrificial offerings and a place in this world." Thus addressed and seeing him the Divine Lord spoke to him the truth (15). "The gods, who present themselves at _Yajnas_, have already made apportionments of sacrificial offerings amongst themselves. The great saints too have dedicated various articles of oblation to various gods. Know therefore, I shall not be able to give you any thing however trifling it may be, that is not mentioned in the Vedas. O my son, you have been born after the gods and so you will not be able to partake of sacrificial offerings (16–17). In your second birth you will gain renown in the world. While in the womb you will acquire _Animā Siddhi_⁵⁷ (18). With that body you will acquire the dignity of a god. The twice-born ones will worship you with _Charu_, _Mantra_, vows and _Japas_ (19). You will propagate Ayurveda with its eight divisions. This work, which is sure to come off, is known to you in your watery birth (20). When the second Yuga Dwāpara will set in you will undoubtedly take your birth again." Having conferred this boon on Dhanwantari Vishnu disappeared again (21). Thereupon when the second Dwāpara Yuga set in Sunohotra's son Dirghatapā, the king of Kashi, desirous of having a son, began carrying on hard austerities affording delight to his worshipful deity saying (22)—"I shall lay myself under the protection of that god who will confer on me a son." That king worshipped the deity Avja for a son (23). Thereupon that Divine lord, being pleased with the king, said to him "O you of good vows, I shall grant you any boon that you may choose to have" (24). The king said "O lord, if thou art pleased be born unto me as my illustrious son." Then saying "Let it be so" he disappeared therefrom (25). The deity Dhanwantari was then born in his house. He became the king of Kāshi who could destroy all diseases (26). Having acquired the kowledge of Ayurveda from Bharadwāja he divided the work of the physicians into eight classes and then conferred it upon his disciples (27). Dhanwantari's son was known by the name of Ketumān whose son was the heroic Bhimaratha (28). His son was the king Divodāsa. The pious-souled Divodāsa became the king of Bārānashi (29). O king, at this time the Rakshasa Kshemaka, an attendant of Rudra, made the city of Bārānashi divested of its inhabitants (30). The intelligent and high-souled Nikumbha uttered a curse against Bārānashi saying, "Thou shalt forsooth have none to live in thee for one thousand years" (31). As soon as this curse was pronounced against Bārānashi the king Divodāsa laid out his charming capital on the bank of Gomati (near Bārānashi) (32). Formerly Bārānashi belonged to Bhadrashenya, son of Mahishmān, of the Yadu race. Having slain the hundred sons of Bhadrasenya who were all most excellent bowmen Divodāsa acquired that city. Thus Bhadrasenya was deprived forcibly of his kingdom by the (king Divodāsa) (33–34).
verses.explanation: चतुरज्गके पुत्र पृथुलाक्ष कहे गये हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: चतुरज्गके पुत्र पृथुलाक्ष कहे गये हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेर्जन्म तथा श्रुत्वा शाण्डिल्यस्य महात्मनः । दिलीपं यजमानं ये पश्यन्ति सुसमाहिताः । सत्यवन्तं महात्मानं तेऽपि स्वर्गजितो नराः ॥ ६३ ॥
verses.transliteration: agnerjanma tathā śrutvā śāṇḍilyasya mahātmanaḥ | dilīpaṃ yajamānaṃ ye paśyanti susamāhitāḥ | satyavantaṃ mahātmānaṃ te'pi svargajito narāḥ || 63 ||
verses.hindi: विश्वजित्के पुत्र कर्ण तथा कर्णके पुत्र विकर्ण हुए। विकर्णके सौ पुत्र थे, जो अद्भवंशकी वृद्धि करनेवाले थे॥ ५४॥ बृहदर्भका जो बृहन्मना नामसे प्रसिद्ध पुत्र था, उसकी दो पत्नियाँ थीं। ये दोनों ही चेदिराजकी सुन्दरी कन्याएँ थीं। एकका नाम यशोदेवी था और दूसरीका सत्या। उन दोनोंके द्वारा उस वंशमें भेद हो गया अर्थात् दोनोंकी पृथक्ू-पृथक् वंश-परम्परा चली जयद्रथस्तु राजेन्द्र यशोदेव्यां व्यजायत। ब्रह्मक्षत्रोत्तर: सत्यां विजयो नाम विश्रुत: धृतब्रतस्य पुत्रस्तु सत्यकर्मा महायशा:

verses.sanskrit: सुस्वधा नाम पितरः कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः । समुत्पन्नास्तु पुलहान्महात्मानो द्विजर्षभाः ॥ ६४ ॥
verses.transliteration: susvadhā nāma pitaraḥ kardamasya prajāpateḥ | samutpannāstu pulahānmahātmāno dvijarṣabhāḥ || 64 ||
verses.hindi: सत्यकर्मसुतश्चापि सूतस्त्वधिरथस्तु वै। यः कर्ण प्रतिजग्राह तत: कर्णस्तु सूतज: एतत् ते कथितं सर्व कर्ण प्रति महाबलम् । कर्णस्य वृषसेनस्तु वृषस्तस्यात्मज: स्मृत: एते5ड्डरबंशजा: सर्वे राजान: कीर्तिता मया। सत्यब्रता महात्मानः प्रजावन्तो महारथा: राजेन्द्र! बृहन्मनाका जो जयद्रथ नामक पुत्र था, वह यशोदेवीके गर्भसे उत्पन्न हुआ था तथा उनका दूसरा पुत्र, जो विजय नामसे विख्यात था, सत्याके पेटसे पैदा हुआ था। वह शान्ति आदि गुणोंमें ब्राह्मणोंसे और शौर्य

verses.sanskrit: लोकेषु दिवि वर्तन्ते कामगेषु विहङ्गमाः । तांश्च वैश्यगणास्तात भावयन्ति फलार्थिनः ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.transliteration: lokeṣu divi vartante kāmageṣu vihaṅgamāḥ | tāṃśca vaiśyagaṇāstāta bhāvayanti phalārthinaḥ || 65 ||

verses.sanskrit: तेषां वै मानसी कन्या विरजा नाम विश्रुता । ययातेर्जननी ब्रह्मन् महिषी नहुषस्य च ॥ ६६ ॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ vai mānasī kanyā virajā nāma viśrutā | yayāterjananī brahman mahiṣī nahuṣasya ca || 66 ||
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहाभारते खिलभागे हरिवंशे हरिवंशपर्वणि कुक्षेयुवंशानुकीर्तन॑ं नाम एकत्रिंशो5ध्याय: इस ग्रकार श्रीमहाभारत खिलभाग हरिवंशके अन्तर्गत हरिवंशपर्वमें कुक्षेय॒वंशका वर्णणगविषयक इकतीसवाँ अध्याय पूरा हुआ पूरुके वंशके अन्तर्गत ऋचेयुकी वंशपरम्परा--अजमीढवंश, पाञ्जाल एवं सोमकवंश, कौरववबंश तथा तुर्वसु, ब्रह्म और अनुकी संततिका वर्णन अनाधृष्यस्तु राजर्षिक्रचेयुश्षेकराट् स्मृतः। ऋषचेयोज्वलना नाम भार्या वै तक्षकात्मजा

verses.science: इति श्रीमहाभारते खिलभागे हरिवंशे हरिवंशपर्वणि कुक्षेयुवंशानुकीर्तन॑ं नाम एकत्रिंशो5ध्याय: इस ग्रकार श्रीमहाभारत खिलभाग हरिवंशके अन्तर्गत हरिवंशपर्वमें कुक्षे…। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रय एते गणाः प्रोक्ताश्चतुर्थं तु निबोध मे । उत्पन्ना ये स्वधायां ते सोमपा वै कवेः सुताः । हिरण्यगर्भस्य सुताः शूद्रास्तान्भावयन्त्युत ॥ ६७ ॥
verses.transliteration: traya ete gaṇāḥ proktāścaturthaṃ tu nibodha me | utpannā ye svadhāyāṃ te somapā vai kaveḥ sutāḥ | hiraṇyagarbhasya sutāḥ śūdrāstānbhāvayantyuta || 67 ||

verses.sanskrit: मानसा नाम ते लोका यत्र तिष्ठन्ति ते दिवि । तेषां वै मानसी कन्या नर्मदा सरितां वरा ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.transliteration: mānasā nāma te lokā yatra tiṣṭhanti te divi | teṣāṃ vai mānasī kanyā narmadā saritāṃ varā || 68 ||

verses.sanskrit: या भावयति भूतानि दक्षिणापथगामिनी । पुरुकुत्सस्य या पत्नी त्रसद्दस्योर्जनन्यपि ॥ ६९ ॥
verses.transliteration: yā bhāvayati bhūtāni dakṣiṇāpathagāminī | purukutsasya yā patnī trasaddasyorjananyapi || 69 ||
verses.hindi: तंसोः सुरोधो राजर्षिध्धर्मनेत्रो महायशा:। ब्रह्मवादी पराक्रान्तस्तस्य भायोपदानवी उपदानवी सुतॉल्लेभ चतुरस्त्वैलिकात्मजान्। दुष्यन्तमथ सुष्मन्तं प्रवीरमनघं तथा दुष्यन्तं प्रति राजानं वागुवाचाशरीरिणी। रेतोधाः पुत्र उन्नयति नरदेव यमक्षयात्
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—O foremost of Bharatas, hear of the birth of Dhanwantari. When ambrosia was being churned out in the days of yore Dhanwantari arose from the ocean. Enveloped completely with personal grace he came out of the vessel of ambrosia. Meditating on Vishnu who grants success in business he stood up as soon as he saw Him (11–13). Vishnu said to him "As you have come out of water you will be known by the name of _Avja_." And so he passed by the name of Avja (14). Avja then replied:—"O lord I am your son. Confer upon me therefore, O lord of celestials, a share in the sacrificial offerings and a place in this world." Thus addressed and seeing him the Divine Lord spoke to him the truth (15). "The gods, who present themselves at _Yajnas_, have already made apportionments of sacrificial offerings amongst themselves. The great saints too have dedicated various articles of oblation to various gods. Know therefore, I shall not be able to give you any thing however trifling it may be, that is not mentioned in the Vedas. O my son, you have been born after the gods and so you will not be able to partake of sacrificial offerings (16–17). In your second birth you will gain renown in the world. While in the womb you will acquire _Animā Siddhi_⁵⁷ (18). With that body you will acquire the dignity of a god. The twice-born ones will worship you with _Charu_, _Mantra_, vows and _Japas_ (19). You will propagate Ayurveda with its eight divisions. This work, which is sure to come off, is known to you in your watery birth (20). When the second Yuga Dwāpara will set in you will undoubtedly take your birth again." Having conferred this boon on Dhanwantari Vishnu disappeared again (21). Thereupon when the second Dwāpara Yuga set in Sunohotra's son Dirghatapā, the king of Kashi, desirous of having a son, began carrying on hard austerities affording delight to his worshipful deity saying (22)—"I shall lay myself under the protection of that god who will confer on me a son." That king worshipped the deity Avja for a son (23). Thereupon that Divine lord, being pleased with the king, said to him "O you of good vows, I shall grant you any boon that you may choose to have" (24). The king said "O lord, if thou art pleased be born unto me as my illustrious son." Then saying "Let it be so" he disappeared therefrom (25). The deity Dhanwantari was then born in his house. He became the king of Kāshi who could destroy all diseases (26). Having acquired the kowledge of Ayurveda from Bharadwāja he divided the work of the physicians into eight classes and then conferred it upon his disciples (27). Dhanwantari's son was known by the name of Ketumān whose son was the heroic Bhimaratha (28). His son was the king Divodāsa. The pious-souled Divodāsa became the king of Bārānashi (29). O king, at this time the Rakshasa Kshemaka, an attendant of Rudra, made the city of Bārānashi divested of its inhabitants (30). The intelligent and high-souled Nikumbha uttered a curse against Bārānashi saying, "Thou shalt forsooth have none to live in thee for one thousand years" (31). As soon as this curse was pronounced against Bārānashi the king Divodāsa laid out his charming capital on the bank of Gomati (near Bārānashi) (32). Formerly Bārānashi belonged to Bhadrashenya, son of Mahishmān, of the Yadu race. Having slain the hundred sons of Bhadrasenya who were all most excellent bowmen Divodāsa acquired that city. Thus Bhadrasenya was deprived forcibly of his kingdom by the (king Divodāsa) (33–34).
verses.explanation: तंसोः सुरोधो राजर्षिध्धर्मनेत्रो महायशा:। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: तंसोः सुरोधो राजर्षिध्धर्मनेत्रो महायशा:। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषामथाभ्युपगमान्मनुस्तात युगे युगे । प्रवर्तयति श्राद्धानि नष्टे धर्मे प्रजापतिः ॥ ७० ॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāmathābhyupagamānmanustāta yuge yuge | pravartayati śrāddhāni naṣṭe dharme prajāpatiḥ || 70 ||
verses.hindi: मातृणां तात कोपेन मया ते कथित पुरा। बृहस्पतेराड्धिरसः पुत्रो राजन् महामुनिः। संक्रामितो भरद्वाजो मरुद्धि: क्रतुभिर्विभु: राजा जनमेजय! जिनकी कन्या ईलिनी नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुई थी, वे ईलिन नामक नरेश ब्रह्मवादी ब्राह्मण- समुदायमें उत्कृष्ट माने जाते थे। उनकी उस ईलिनी नामक कन्याको तंसुने पत्लीरूपमें प्राप्त किया तंसुके महायशस्वी राजर्षि सुरोध हुए, जो धर्मके प्रवर्तक होनेसे धर्मनेत्र कहलाते थे। वे ब्रह्मवादी और पराक्रमी थे। उनकी पत्नी उपदानवी थी। उपदानवीने चार पुत्र प्राप्त किये, जो दुष्यन्त, सुष्मन्त, प्रवीर और अनघके नामसे विख्यात थे। ये चारों ईलिनीकुमार सुरोध या धर्मनेत्रके पुत्र थे॥ ७-८॥ दुष्यन्तके पुत्रका नाम भरत था। वे बड़े पराक्रमी थे। सबका दमन करनेके कारण उनका दूसरा नाम सर्वदमन भी था। महान् वीर भरतमें

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणामादिसर्गेण सर्वेषां द्विजसत्तम । तस्मादेनं स्वधर्मेण श्राद्धदेवं वदन्ति वै ॥ ७१ ॥
verses.transliteration: pitṝṇāmādisargeṇa sarveṣāṃ dvijasattama | tasmādenaṃ svadharmeṇa śrāddhadevaṃ vadanti vai || 71 ||

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां राजतं पात्रमथ वा रजसान्वितम् । दत्तं स्वधां पुरोधाय श्राद्धं प्रीणाति वै पितॄन् ॥ ७२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ rājataṃ pātramatha vā rajasānvitam | dattaṃ svadhāṃ purodhāya śrāddhaṃ prīṇāti vai pitṝn || 72 ||

verses.sanskrit: सोमस्याप्यायनं कृत्वा अग्नेर्वैवस्वतस्य च । उदगायनमप्यग्नावग्न्यभावेऽप्सु वा पुनः ॥ ७३ ॥
verses.transliteration: somasyāpyāyanaṃ kṛtvā agnervaivasvatasya ca | udagāyanamapyagnāvagnyabhāve'psu vā punaḥ || 73 ||

verses.sanskrit: पितॄन् प्रीणाति यो भक्त्या पितरः प्रीणयन्ति तम् । यच्छन्ति पितरः पुष्टिं प्रजाश्च विपुलास्तथा ॥ ७४ ॥
verses.transliteration: pitṝn prīṇāti yo bhaktyā pitaraḥ prīṇayanti tam | yacchanti pitaraḥ puṣṭiṃ prajāśca vipulāstathā || 74 ||
verses.hindi: मुदूलः सृक्षयश्चवेव राजा बृहदिषुः स्मृतः। यवीनरश्च विक्रान्तः कृमिलाश्वश्च पञ्ञम: मौदूलस्य सुतो ज्येष्ठो ब्रह्मर्षि: सुमहायशा: । इन्द्रसेनो यतो गर्भ वष्य्रश्व॑ प्रत्यपद्यत इसी प्रसद्भमें बुद्धिमान् भरद्वाजके धर्मसंक्रमणकी यह बात कही जाती है। मरुद्रणोंने भरतको पुत्ररूपमें जब भरद्वाजको ही अर्पित कर दिया, तब भरद्वाजने भरतसे देवताओंसहित यज्ञका अनुष्ठान करवाया। इसके पहले भरतके पुत्र-जन्मका सारा प्रयास वितथ (व्यर्थ) हो चुका था। भरद्वाजके प्रयत्नसे जो पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ, उसका नाम वितथ हुआ। वितथका जन्म हो जानेपर भरत स्वर्गवासी हो गये। तत्पश्चात् वितथका

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गमारोग्यमेवाथ यदन्यदपि चेप्सितम् । देवकार्यादपि मुने पितृकार्यं विशिष्यते ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.transliteration: svargamārogyamevātha yadanyadapi cepsitam | devakāryādapi mune pitṛkāryaṃ viśiṣyate || 75 ||

verses.sanskrit: देवतानां हि पितरः पूर्वमाप्यायनं स्मृतम् । शीघ्रप्रसादा ह्यक्रोधा लोकस्याप्यायनं परम् ॥ ७६ ॥
verses.transliteration: devatānāṃ hi pitaraḥ pūrvamāpyāyanaṃ smṛtam | śīghraprasādā hyakrodhā lokasyāpyāyanaṃ param || 76 ||

verses.sanskrit: स्थिरप्रसादाश्च सदा तान् नमस्यस्व भार्गव । पितृभक्तोऽसि विप्रर्षे मद्भक्तश्च विशेषतः ॥ ७७ ॥
verses.transliteration: sthiraprasādāśca sadā tān namasyasva bhārgava | pitṛbhakto'si viprarṣe madbhaktaśca viśeṣataḥ || 77 ||

verses.sanskrit: श्रेयस्तेऽद्य विधास्यामि प्रत्यक्षं कुरु तत्स्वयम् । दिव्यं चक्षुः सविज्ञानं प्रदिशामि च तेऽनघ ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.transliteration: śreyaste'dya vidhāsyāmi pratyakṣaṃ kuru tatsvayam | divyaṃ cakṣuḥ savijñānaṃ pradiśāmi ca te'nagha || 78 ||

verses.sanskrit: गतिमेतामप्रमत्तो मार्कण्डेय निशामय । न हि योगगतिर्दिव्या पितॄणां च परा गतिः ॥ ७९ ॥
verses.transliteration: gatimetāmapramatto mārkaṇḍeya niśāmaya | na hi yogagatirdivyā pitṝṇāṃ ca parā gatiḥ || 79 ||

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्विधेनापि सिद्धेन दृश्यते मांसचक्षुषा । स एवमुक्त्वा देवेशो मामुपस्थितमग्रतः ॥ ८० ॥
verses.transliteration: tvadvidhenāpi siddhena dṛśyate māṃsacakṣuṣā | sa evamuktvā deveśo māmupasthitamagrataḥ || 80 ||

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुर्दत्त्वा सविज्ञानं देवानामपि दुर्लभम् । जगाम गतिमिष्टां वै द्धितीयोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन् ॥ ८१ ॥
verses.transliteration: cakṣurdattvā savijñānaṃ devānāmapi durlabham | jagāma gatimiṣṭāṃ vai ddhitīyo'gniriva jvalan || 81 ||

verses.sanskrit: तन्निबोध कुरुश्रेष्ठ यन्मयासीन्निशामितम् । प्रसादात्तस्य देवस्य दुर्ज्ञेयं भुवि मानुषैः ॥ ८२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tannibodha kuruśreṣṭha yanmayāsīnniśāmitam | prasādāttasya devasya durjñeyaṃ bhuvi mānuṣaiḥ || 82 ||
verses.hindi: सा तु पुत्रार्थिनी देवी व्नरतचर्यासमन्विता। ततो वर्षायुतं तप्त्वा तपः परमदुश्चरम् अग्निहोत्रकुशेष्वेव. सुष्वाप जनमेजय धूमिन्या स॒ तया देव्या त्वजमीढ: समेयिवान्। ऋक्ष॑ संजनयामास धूमवर्ण सुदर्शनम् यः प्रयागादतिक्रम्य कुरुक्षेत्र चकार ह
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—O foremost of Bharatas, hear of the birth of Dhanwantari. When ambrosia was being churned out in the days of yore Dhanwantari arose from the ocean. Enveloped completely with personal grace he came out of the vessel of ambrosia. Meditating on Vishnu who grants success in business he stood up as soon as he saw Him (11–13). Vishnu said to him "As you have come out of water you will be known by the name of _Avja_." And so he passed by the name of Avja (14). Avja then replied:—"O lord I am your son. Confer upon me therefore, O lord of celestials, a share in the sacrificial offerings and a place in this world." Thus addressed and seeing him the Divine Lord spoke to him the truth (15). "The gods, who present themselves at _Yajnas_, have already made apportionments of sacrificial offerings amongst themselves. The great saints too have dedicated various articles of oblation to various gods. Know therefore, I shall not be able to give you any thing however trifling it may be, that is not mentioned in the Vedas. O my son, you have been born after the gods and so you will not be able to partake of sacrificial offerings (16–17). In your second birth you will gain renown in the world. While in the womb you will acquire _Animā Siddhi_⁵⁷ (18). With that body you will acquire the dignity of a god. The twice-born ones will worship you with _Charu_, _Mantra_, vows and _Japas_ (19). You will propagate Ayurveda with its eight divisions. This work, which is sure to come off, is known to you in your watery birth (20). When the second Yuga Dwāpara will set in you will undoubtedly take your birth again." Having conferred this boon on Dhanwantari Vishnu disappeared again (21). Thereupon when the second Dwāpara Yuga set in Sunohotra's son Dirghatapā, the king of Kashi, desirous of having a son, began carrying on hard austerities affording delight to his worshipful deity saying (22)—"I shall lay myself under the protection of that god who will confer on me a son." That king worshipped the deity Avja for a son (23). Thereupon that Divine lord, being pleased with the king, said to him "O you of good vows, I shall grant you any boon that you may choose to have" (24). The king said "O lord, if thou art pleased be born unto me as my illustrious son." Then saying "Let it be so" he disappeared therefrom (25). The deity Dhanwantari was then born in his house. He became the king of Kāshi who could destroy all diseases (26). Having acquired the kowledge of Ayurveda from Bharadwāja he divided the work of the physicians into eight classes and then conferred it upon his disciples (27). Dhanwantari's son was known by the name of Ketumān whose son was the heroic Bhimaratha (28). His son was the king Divodāsa. The pious-souled Divodāsa became the king of Bārānashi (29). O king, at this time the Rakshasa Kshemaka, an attendant of Rudra, made the city of Bārānashi divested of its inhabitants (30). The intelligent and high-souled Nikumbha uttered a curse against Bārānashi saying, "Thou shalt forsooth have none to live in thee for one thousand years" (31). As soon as this curse was pronounced against Bārānashi the king Divodāsa laid out his charming capital on the bank of Gomati (near Bārānashi) (32). Formerly Bārānashi belonged to Bhadrashenya, son of Mahishmān, of the Yadu race. Having slain the hundred sons of Bhadrasenya who were all most excellent bowmen Divodāsa acquired that city. Thus Bhadrasenya was deprived forcibly of his kingdom by the (king Divodāsa) (33–34).
verses.explanation: सा तु पुत्रार्थिनी देवी व्नरतचर्यासमन्विता। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: सा तु पुत्रार्थिनी देवी व्नरतचर्यासमन्विता। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पितृकल्प- भरद्वाज के पुत्रों की कथा, योगभ्रष्ट पुरुषों की गति, योगसिद्धि के अधिकारी पुरुषों के लक्षण तथा मार्कण्डेय सनत्कुमार संवाद की समाप्ति आसन् पूर्वयुगे तात भरद्वाजात्मजा द्विजाः योगधर्ममनुप्राप्य भ्रष्टा दुश्चरितेन वै ॥ १ ॥
verses.transliteration: pitṛkalpa- bharadvāja ke putroṃ kī kathā, yogabhraṣṭa puruṣoṃ kī gati, yogasiddhi ke adhikārī puruṣoṃ ke lakṣaṇa tathā mārkaṇḍeya sanatkumāra saṃvāda kī samāpti āsan pūrvayuge tāta bharadvājātmajā dvijāḥ yogadharmamanuprāpya bhraṣṭā duścaritena vai || 1 ||
verses.translation: Janamejaya said:—Why did the powerful Nikumbha imprecate a curse on Bārānasi? Who is the virtuous Nikumbha who pronounced a curse on that holy land (25)?
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं—(सनत्कुमारजीने अन्तर्धान होनेसे पहले मुझसे इस प्रकार कहा—) तात! पूर्वयुगमें कुछ ब्राह्मण रहते थे, जो भरद्वाजके पुत्र थे। वे योगधर्मका सेवन करते-करते दुराचारमें फँस जानेके कारण (स्वर्गसे) भ्रष्ट हो गये थे
verses.commentary: Sense: Janamejaya said:—Why did the powerful Nikumbha imprecate a curse on Bārānasi? Who is the virtuous Nikumbha who pronounced a curse on that holy land (25)?
verses.science: च्यवनस्तस्य पुत्रस्तु राज्ञा धर्मार्थकोविदः च्यवनात् कृतयज्ञस्तु इष्ठा यज्ञैः स धर्मवित्। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अपभ्रंशमनुप्राप्ता योगधर्मापचारिणः । महतः सरसः पारे मानसस्य विसंज्ञिताः ॥ २ ॥
verses.transliteration: apabhraṃśamanuprāptā yogadharmāpacāriṇaḥ | mahataḥ sarasaḥ pāre mānasasya visaṃjñitāḥ || 2 ||
verses.hindi: वे योगधर्मका उल्लड्डन करनेवाले ब्राह्मण अचेतन-से होकर महान्‌ मानसरोवरके तटपर आकर गिरे

verses.sanskrit: तमेवार्थमनुध्यायन्तो नष्टमप्स्विव मोहिताः । अप्राप्य योगं ते सर्वे संयुक्ताः कालधर्मणा ॥ ३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tamevārthamanudhyāyanto naṣṭamapsviva mohitāḥ | aprāpya yogaṃ te sarve saṃyuktāḥ kāladharmaṇā || 3 ||
verses.hindi: वे सभी जलमें डूबते हुए पुरुषके समान मोहमें पड़ गये और उसी योगविषयका विचार करते-करते योगके तत्त्वको बिना पाये ही मर गये

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते योगविभ्रष्टा देवेषु सुचिरोषिताः । जाताः कौशिकदायादाः कुरुक्षेत्रे नरर्षभाः ॥ ४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataste yogavibhraṣṭā deveṣu suciroṣitāḥ | jātāḥ kauśikadāyādāḥ kurukṣetre nararṣabhāḥ || 4 ||
verses.translation: Thereupon going to the city of Bārānasi Nikumbha appeared in a dream to a barber by name Kanduka and said to him. "O sinless one, I shall encompass your well-being. Place a faithful image of mine in the city." O king, what he commanded in a dream was all carried out (43–48). Having duly made an announcement to the king at the gate of the city he began daily to worship him (Nikumbha) with scents, garland, incense, lamps, food, and drink. This appeared to be extremely wondrous (49–50). Thus the lord of _Ganas_ was daily worshipped. Thereupon he began to confer thousands of boons on the citizens, such as sons, gold, long life and various desired-for objects (51). The eldest queen of the king Divodāsa was celebrated by the name of Suyasha. Despatched by her husband that chaste damsel appeared there for a son (52). Offering him a grand _Pujā_ she prayed for a son. Thus did she daily come there for a son (53). But for some reason Nikumbha did not give her a son, thinking "If the king gets enraged I shall accomplish my object" (54). Thereupon after a long time the king was possessed by anger. He said "This ghost, stationed at the main gate, is delightedly conferring hundreds of boons on my citizens; why does he not confer one on me? My people in this city are always worshipping him. I requested of him for a son for my queen. Why does not that ungrateful wretch confer a son on me (55–57)? So this ghost does not deserve good treatment from any, especially from me. I shall therefore have the habitation of this vicious-souled one destroyed" (58). Having made this resolution that vicious-souled, wicked king sacked the house of that king of _Ganas_ (59). Having seen his own house destroyed Nikumbha imprecated a curse on the king saying, "I have committed no offence; and still while my house has been ruined, this city, all on a sudden, shall be shorn of its people" (60).
verses.hindi: अब वे योगभ्रष्ट नर्श्रेष्ठ भरद्वाज- पुत्र, जो दीर्घकालतक देवताओंमें रह चुके हैं, कुरुक्षेत्रमें कौशिकके पुत्र बनकर उत्पन्न होंगे
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon going to the city of Bārānasi Nikumbha appeared in a dream to a barber by name Kanduka and said to him. "O sinless one, I shall encompass your well-being. Place a faithful image of mine in the city." O king, what he commanded in a dream was all carried out (43–48).…
verses.explanation: वसुसे उनकी पत्नी गिरिकाने सात मनुष्योंको उत्पन्न किया॥ ५३॥ उनमें प्रथम संतान थे सुविख्यात महारथी राजा बृहद्रथ, जो मगध देशके अधिपति थे। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: वसुसे उनकी पत्नी गिरिकाने सात मनुष्योंको उत्पन्न किया॥ ५३॥ उनमें प्रथम संतान थे सुविख्यात महारथी राजा बृहद्रथ, जो मगध देशके अधिपति थे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हिंसया विहरिष्यन्तो धर्मं पितृकृतेन वै । ततस्ते पुनराजातिं भ्रष्टाः प्राप्स्यन्ति कुत्सिताम् ॥ ५ ॥
verses.transliteration: hiṃsayā vihariṣyanto dharmaṃ pitṛkṛtena vai | tataste punarājātiṃ bhraṣṭāḥ prāpsyanti kutsitām || 5 ||
verses.hindi: वे (ब्राह्मण होनेपर भी) पितरोंके लिये धर्म (श्राद्)-के बहाने हिंसा करेंगे, फिर वह हिंसारूपी पाप करनेके कारण भ्रष्ट होकर कुत्सित योनिमें उत्पन्न होंगे

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पितृप्रसादेन पूर्वजातिकृतेन वै । स्मृतिरुत्पत्स्यते प्राप्य तां तां जतिं जुगुप्सिताम् ॥ ६ ॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ pitṛprasādena pūrvajātikṛtena vai | smṛtirutpatsyate prāpya tāṃ tāṃ jatiṃ jugupsitām || 6 ||
verses.hindi: परंतु पूर्वजन्मके पितरोंकी कृपाके कारण उस-उस निन्दित योनिमें उत्पन्न होनेपर भी उनको पूर्वजन्मकी स्मृति बनी रहेगी

verses.sanskrit: ते धर्मचारिणो नित्यं भविष्यन्ति समाहिताः । ब्राह्मण्यं प्रतिलप्स्यन्ति ततो भूयः स्वकर्मणा ॥ ७ ॥
verses.transliteration: te dharmacāriṇo nityaṃ bhaviṣyanti samāhitāḥ | brāhmaṇyaṃ pratilapsyanti tato bhūyaḥ svakarmaṇā || 7 ||
verses.hindi: वे प्रत्येक जन्ममें धर्मात्मा रहकर अपने चित्तको सावधान रखेंगे और (अन्तमें) अपने कर्मवश फिर ब्राह्मणत्वको प्राप्त कर लेंगे

verses.explanation: उपाध्यायस्तु देवानां देवापिरभवन्मुनिः। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च योगं प्राप्स्यन्ति पूर्वजातिकृतं पुनः । भूयः सिद्धिमनुप्राप्ताः स्थानं प्राप्स्यन्ति शाश्वतम् ॥ ८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataśca yogaṃ prāpsyanti pūrvajātikṛtaṃ punaḥ | bhūyaḥ siddhimanuprāptāḥ sthānaṃ prāpsyanti śāśvatam || 8 ||
verses.hindi: उस जन्ममें वे पुनः अपने पूर्वजन्मके योगको पायेंगे और फिर सिद्धिको पाकर शाश्वत स्थानको प्राप्त करेंगे

Having seen his own house destroyed Nikumbha imprecated a curse on the king saying, "I have committed no offence; and still while my house has been ruined, this city, all on a sudden, shall be shorn of its people" (60).
verses.explanation: वह आधे-आधे शरीरके दो टुकड़ोंके रूपमें (दो माताओंके गर्भसे) उत्पन्न हुआ था। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: वह आधे-आधे शरीरके दो टुकड़ोंके रूपमें (दो माताओंके गर्भसे) उत्पन्न हुआ था। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं धर्मे च ते बुद्धिर्भविष्यति पुनः पुनः । योगधर्मे च नितरां प्राप्स्यसे बुद्धिमुत्तमाम् ॥ ९ ॥
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dharme ca te buddhirbhaviṣyati punaḥ punaḥ | yogadharme ca nitarāṃ prāpsyase buddhimuttamām || 9 ||
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार तुम्हारी बुद्धि भी बारम्बार धर्ममें ही लगी रहेगी और तुम्हें योगधर्मके विषयमें सब प्रकारसे उत्तम बुद्धि प्राप्त होगी

verses.sanskrit: योगो हि दुर्लभो नित्यमल्पप्रज्ञैः कदाचन । लब्ध्वापि नाशयन्त्येनं व्यसनैः कटुतामिताः । अधर्मेष्वेव वर्तन्ते प्रार्दयन्ते गुरूनपि ॥ १० ॥
verses.transliteration: yogo hi durlabho nityamalpaprajñaiḥ kadācana | labdhvāpi nāśayantyenaṃ vyasanaiḥ kaṭutāmitāḥ | adharmeṣveva vartante prārdayante gurūnapi || 10 ||
verses.hindi: अल्पबुद्धि मनुष्योंको योगसिद्धि मिलना सदा दुर्लभ है। उन्हें कदाचित्‌ योगसिद्धि मिल भी जाय तो वे (मृगया आदि) व्यसनोंसे क्रूर होकर उसे नष्ट | कर डालते हैं। वे अधर्मके कामोंमें ही लगे रहते हैं तथा अपने गुरुजनोंको भी कष्टमें डालते रहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: याचन्ते न त्वयाच्यानि रक्षन्ति शरणागतान् । नावजानन्ति कृपणान् माद्यन्ते न धनोष्मणा ॥ ११ ॥
verses.transliteration: yācante na tvayācyāni rakṣanti śaraṇāgatān | nāvajānanti kṛpaṇān mādyante na dhanoṣmaṇā || 11 ||
verses.hindi: जो अयाच्यसे याचना नहीं करते, शरणागतोंकी क्षा करते हैं, कृपण (दीन) पुरुषोंका अपमान नहीं करते तथा जो धनकी गर्मीसे मदमत्त नहीं होते, जिनका भाहार-विहार शास्त्रानुकूल होता है, जो अपने कर्मोंमें गास्त्रानुसार चेष्टा करते हैं, ईश्वरके ध्यान तथा स्वाध्यायमें परायण रहते हैं, नष्ट हुई वस्तुको पानेके लिये चोर भादिको नहीं ढूँढ़ते, सर्वदा भोगमें ही लीन नहीं रहते, पर्वदा मधु-मांसका भक्षण नहीं करते और सर्वदा क्रामपरायण भी नहीं रहते तथा जो सर्वदा ब्राह्मणोंकी पेवा करते हैं, अनार्य पुरुषोंकी बातोंमें आसक्त नहीं होते, जिनको कभी आलस्य नहीं सताता, जो अत्यन्त भभिमानमें आसक्त नहीं रहते, सदा आत्ममीमांसा करनेमें लगे रहते हैं, ऐसे शान्त चित्तवाले, क्रोधको जीतनेवाले, मान तथा अहंकाररहित मनुष्योंको योगसिद्धि मिलती है; क्योंकि पृथ्वीमें योगकी प्राप्ति अति दुर्लभ दे

verses.sanskrit: युक्ताहारविहाराश्च युक्तचेष्टाः स्वकर्मसु । ध्यानाध्ययनयुक्ताश्च न नष्टानुगवेषिणः ॥ १२ ॥
verses.transliteration: yuktāhāravihārāśca yuktaceṣṭāḥ svakarmasu | dhyānādhyayanayuktāśca na naṣṭānugaveṣiṇaḥ || 12 ||
verses.translation: Thereupon going to the city of Bārānasi Nikumbha appeared in a dream to a barber by name Kanduka and said to him. "O sinless one, I shall encompass your well-being. Place a faithful image of mine in the city." O king, what he commanded in a dream was all carried out (43–48). Having duly made an announcement to the king at the gate of the city he began daily to worship him (Nikumbha) with scents, garland, incense, lamps, food, and drink. This appeared to be extremely wondrous (49–50). Thus the lord of _Ganas_ was daily worshipped. Thereupon he began to confer thousands of boons on the citizens, such as sons, gold, long life and various desired-for objects (51). The eldest queen of the king Divodāsa was celebrated by the name of Suyasha. Despatched by her husband that chaste damsel appeared there for a son (52). Offering him a grand _Pujā_ she prayed for a son. Thus did she daily come there for a son (53). But for some reason Nikumbha did not give her a son, thinking "If the king gets enraged I shall accomplish my object" (54). Thereupon after a long time the king was possessed by anger. He said "This ghost, stationed at the main gate, is delightedly conferring hundreds of boons on my citizens; why does he not confer one on me? My people in this city are always worshipping him. I requested of him for a son for my queen. Why does not that ungrateful wretch confer a son on me (55–57)? So this ghost does not deserve good treatment from any, especially from me. I shall therefore have the habitation of this vicious-souled one destroyed" (58). Having made this resolution that vicious-souled, wicked king sacked the house of that king of _Ganas_ (59). Having seen his own house destroyed Nikumbha imprecated a curse on the king saying, "I have committed no offence; and still while my house has been ruined, this city, all on a sudden, shall be shorn of its people" (60).
verses.explanation: उन्हें अपना प्रिय पुत्र बना लिया था॥ ७१॥ राजा शन्तनु कौरवकुलका भार वहन करनेवाले हुए। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: उन्हें अपना प्रिय पुत्र बना लिया था॥ ७१॥ राजा शन्तनु कौरवकुलका भार वहन करनेवाले हुए। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: नोपभोगरता नित्यं न मांसमधुभक्षणाः । न च कामपरा नित्यं न विप्रासेविनस्तथा ॥ १३ ॥
verses.transliteration: nopabhogaratā nityaṃ na māṃsamadhubhakṣaṇāḥ | na ca kāmaparā nityaṃ na viprāsevinastathā || 13 ||

verses.sanskrit: नानार्यसङ्कथासक्ता नालस्योपहतास्तथा । नात्यन्तमानसंसक्ता गोष्ठीषु निरतास्तथा ॥ १४ ॥
verses.transliteration: nānāryasaṅkathāsaktā nālasyopahatāstathā | nātyantamānasaṃsaktā goṣṭhīṣu niratāstathā || 14 ||

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नुवन्ति नरा योगं योगो वै दुर्लभो भुवि । प्रशान्ताश्च जितक्रोधा मानाहङ्कारवर्जिताः ॥ १५ ॥
verses.transliteration: prāpnuvanti narā yogaṃ yogo vai durlabho bhuvi | praśāntāśca jitakrodhā mānāhaṅkāravarjitāḥ || 15 ||

verses.sanskrit: कल्याणभाजनं ये तु ते भवन्ति यतव्रताः । एवंविधास्तु ते तात ब्राह्मणा ह्यभवंस्तदा ॥ १६ ॥
verses.transliteration: kalyāṇabhājanaṃ ye tu te bhavanti yatavratāḥ | evaṃvidhāstu te tāta brāhmaṇā hyabhavaṃstadā || 16 ||
verses.hindi: ऐसे ब्रतोंका पालन करनेवाले मनुष्य ही कल्याणके पात्र होते हैं। तात! वे (भरद्वाजपुत्र) से ही ब्राह्मण बनकर उत्पन्न हुए हैं

verses.sanskrit: स्मरन्ति ह्यात्मनो दोषं प्रमादकृतमेव तु । ध्यानाध्ययनयुक्ताश्च शान्ते वर्त्मनि संस्थिताः ॥ १७ ॥
verses.transliteration: smaranti hyātmano doṣaṃ pramādakṛtameva tu | dhyānādhyayanayuktāśca śānte vartmani saṃsthitāḥ || 17 ||
verses.hindi: वे अपने प्रमादवश हुए दोषका स्मरण करते रहते हैं और ध्यान था स्वाध्यायमें लगे रहकर शान्त मार्गमें स्थित रहते थे

verses.sanskrit: योगधर्माद्धि धर्मज्ञ न धर्मोऽस्ति विशेषवान् । वरिष्ठः सर्वधर्माणां तमेवाचर भार्गव ॥ १८ ॥
verses.transliteration: yogadharmāddhi dharmajña na dharmo'sti viśeṣavān | variṣṭhaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ tamevācara bhārgava || 18 ||
verses.hindi: धर्मज् भार्गव ! योगधर्मसे श्रेष्ठ और कोई धर्म हीं है। वह सभी धर्मोसे श्रेष्ठ है, अत: तुम उसीका भाचरण करो

verses.sanskrit: कालस्य परिणामेन लघ्वाहारो जितेन्द्रियः । तत्परः प्रयतः श्राद्धी योगधर्ममवाप्स्यसि ॥ १९ ॥
verses.transliteration: kālasya pariṇāmena laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ | tatparaḥ prayataḥ śrāddhī yogadharmamavāpsyasi || 19 ||
verses.hindi: यदि तुम श्रद्धापूर्वक प्रयत्रशील एवं योगधर्ममें परायण रहकर हलका भोजन करते हुए जितेन्द्रिय रहोगे तो कालक्रमसे तुम्हें योगसिद्धि प्राप्त हो जायगी

Place a faithful image of mine in the city." O king, what he commanded in a dream was all carried out (43–48). verses.explanation: सुतस्तु॒ तुर्वसोर्वह्निर्वह्नेगों भानुरात्मज:। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: सुतस्तु॒ तुर्वसोर्वह्निर्वह्नेगों भानुरात्मज:। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् देवस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत । अष्टादशैव वर्षाणि त्वेकाहमिव मेऽभवत् ॥ २० ॥
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā bhagavān devastatraivāntaradhīyata | aṣṭādaśaiva varṣāṇi tvekāhamiva me'bhavat || 20 ||
verses.hindi: (मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं कि) इतनी त्रातें कहकर भगवान्‌ सनत्कुमार वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये। पे (सनत्कुमारकी सेवामें बीते हुए) अठारह वर्ष मुझे एक दिनके समान प्रतीत हुए

verses.sanskrit: उपासतस्तं देवेशं वर्षाण्यष्टादशैव मे । प्रसादात् तस्य देवस्य न ग्लानिरभवत्तदा ॥ २१ ॥
verses.transliteration: upāsatastaṃ deveśaṃ varṣāṇyaṣṭādaśaiva me | prasādāt tasya devasya na glānirabhavattadā || 21 ||
verses.hindi: अठारह वर्षतक इन देवेशकी उपासना करते रहनेपर भी उनकी कृपाके क्रारण उस समय मुझे कुछ भी ग्लानि नहीं हुई

verses.sanskrit: न क्षुत्पिपासे कालं वा जानामि स्म तदानघ । पश्चाच्छिष्यसकाशात्तु कालः संविदितो मया ॥ २२ ॥
verses.transliteration: na kṣutpipāse kālaṃ vā jānāmi sma tadānagha | paścācchiṣyasakāśāttu kālaḥ saṃvidito mayā || 22 ||
verses.hindi: नष्पाप! मुझे भूख, प्यास और समय आदि कुछ न आालूम हुआ। बादमें शिष्यके द्वारा मुझे समयका पता नगा

verses.explanation: जनमेजय ! यह तुमसे पौरववंशका वर्णन किया गया, जिसमें तुम्हारा जन्म हुआ है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: पितृकल्प-ब्रह्मदत्त और उग्रायुध के वंश तथा पूजनीया चिडिया द्वारा शुक्रनीति का वर्णन तस्मिन्नन्तर्हिते देवे वचनात् तस्य वै प्रभोः । चक्षुर्दिव्यं सविज्ञानं प्रादुरासीत् तदा मम ॥ १ ॥
verses.transliteration: pitṛkalpa-brahmadatta aura ugrāyudha ke vaṃśa tathā pūjanīyā ciḍiyā dvārā śukranīti kā varṇana tasminnantarhite deve vacanāt tasya vai prabhoḥ | cakṣurdivyaṃ savijñānaṃ prādurāsīt tadā mama || 1 ||

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽहं तानपश्यं वै ब्राह्मणान् कौशिकात्मजान् । आपगेय कुरुक्षेत्रे यानुवाच विभुर्मम ॥ २ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato'haṃ tānapaśyaṃ vai brāhmaṇān kauśikātmajān | āpageya kurukṣetre yānuvāca vibhurmama || 2 ||

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मदत्तोऽभवद् राजा यस्तेषां सप्तमो द्विजः । पितृवर्तीति विख्यातो नाम्ना शीलेन कर्मणा ॥ ३ ॥
verses.transliteration: brahmadatto'bhavad rājā yasteṣāṃ saptamo dvijaḥ | pitṛvartīti vikhyāto nāmnā śīlena karmaṇā || 3 ||
verses.translation: Vaishampayana said:—The highly energetic Nahusha begat on his father's daughter Virajā six sons gifted with the effulgence of Indra (1). They were Yati, Yayāti, Sang yāti, Ayati and Yāti. And the sixth was Suyāti; of them Yayāti became the king (2). Yati was the eldest of all. Next to him was Yayāti. On account of his being the foremost of the pious he obtained a daughter of Kakuthsthas by name Go. Yati was an ascetic. Having acquired final liberation he was united with Brahman (3). Of the other five Yayāti conquered this world. He espoused Sukrācharya's daughter Devayani as well as Sharmisthā the daughter of an Asura by name Vrishaparva (4). Devayāni gave birth to Yadu and Turvasu and Vrishaparva's daughter Sharmishthā to Drahyu, Anu, and Puru (5). Being pleased Sakra gave him a highly effulgent, celestial, golden chariot going every where without any interruption. White celestial and excellent horses, fleet like the mind, were yoked to it. By that chariot he used to accomplish every work. Ascending that car, Yayāti, irrepressible in battle, within six nights conquered the entire earth and even the gods with Vāsava (6-7). That car was in the possession of the Pauravas till Sunāmā was born, O Janamejaya (8). Kuru's son the king Parikshit lost that car by the imprecation of the intelligent Gārgya (9). O Janamejaya, that king slew the harsh-speeched boy of Gārgya and accordingly he was guilty of the crime of Brahmanicide (10). With a stench all about his body that royal saint moved about hither and thither. Then cast off both by the citizens and villagers he could not enjoy happiness anywhere (11). Thereupon stricken with grief he could not find relief anywhere. He then sought refuge with the ascetic Indrota born in the race of Shounaka (12). Indrota then undertook the celebration of a horse-sacrifice for purifying that king (13). When he bathed after the termination of a Yajna, that stench disappeared from his body. Then O king, the lord of gods, with pleasure, gave away that celestial car to Vasu the king of Chedis; from him Vrihadratha acquired it (14). From him that car gradually passed into the hands of Jarāsandha. Thereupon slaying Jarāsandha Bhima, the descendant of Kuru, delightedly conferred that most excellent car on Vāsudeva.
verses.hindi: है॥ ८८--९०॥ अब मैं ययातिके ज्येष्ठ पुत्र उत्तम तेजस्वी यदुके वंशका क्रमश: विस्तारपूर्वक वर्णन करूँगा। तुम मेरे मुखसे इसको सुनो इति श्रीमहाभारते खिलभागे हरिवंशे हरिवंशपर्वणि पूरुवंशानुकीर्तने द्वात्रिंशो3ध्याय: इस प्रकार श्रीमहाभारत खिलभाग हरिवंशके अन्तर्गत हरिवंशपर्वमें प्रुवंशका वर्णनविषयक बत्तीसवाँ अध्याय पूरा हुआ यदुवंशका वर्णन, कार्तवीर्यकी उत्पत्ति एवं चरित्र तथा पाँचों ययाति-पुत्रोंके वंश-वर्णनके श्रवणकी महिमा

verses.commentary: Sense: Vaishampayana said:—The highly energetic Nahusha begat on his father's daughter Virajā six sons gifted with the effulgence of Indra (1). They were Yati, Yayāti, Sang yāti, Ayati and Yāti. And the sixth was Suyāti; of them Yayāti became the king (2). Yati was the eldest of all.…
verses.science: है॥ ८८--९०॥ अब मैं ययातिके ज्येष्ठ पुत्र उत्तम तेजस्वी यदुके वंशका क्रमश: विस्तारपूर्वक वर्णन करूँगा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शुकस्य कन्या कृत्वी तं जनयामास पार्थिवम् । अणुहात् पार्थिवश्रेष्ठात् काम्पिल्ये नगरोत्तमे ॥ ४ ॥
verses.transliteration: śukasya kanyā kṛtvī taṃ janayāmāsa pārthivam | aṇuhāt pārthivaśreṣṭhāt kāmpilye nagarottame || 4 ||
verses.translation: Having conquered the earth consisting of seven insular continents with its oceans Yayāti divided it (amongst his sons). Nahusha's son installed Turvasa as the king of the south-eastern quarter, Anu and Druhya as the kings of the northern and eastern divisions respectively, the eldest Yadu as the king of the north-east, and Puru as the king of the Central division. Even now they are righteously ruling over the earth consisting of seven insular continents and various cities in their respective provinces. O foremost of kings, I shall afterwards describe their progeny (15–20). Having been thus blessed with five sons and conferred upon them his bows, arrows and the charge of the kingdom, the foremost of men, that king Yayāti was possessed by decrepitude. Divested of weapons when that ever victorious king cast his eyes on the earth he felt joy. Having thus divided the earth he said to Yadu (21–22):—"Retiring from thy office, O my son, do thou take this decrepitude of mine upon thee. Making over my decrepitude to thee and being gifted with thy youth and beauty I shall range over the earth." Whereto Yadu replied (23):—"I have promised to give alms to a Brāhmana. It has not been decided as yet. Without ascertaining this I cannot accept your decrepitude (24). There are many inconveniences regarding food and drink in decrepitude. Therefore, O king, I do not like to take your decrepitude on me (25). O king, you have many other sons who are more beloved than I. Therefore, O pious king, command any other son of yours to take your decrepitude" (26).
verses.hindi: बभूवुस्तु यदोः पुत्रा: पञ्ञ देवसुतोपमा:। सहस्रदस्य दायादास्त्रय: परमधार्मिका:। हैहयश्व हयश्लेव राजन् वेणुहयस्तथा॥ हैहयस्याभवत् पुत्रो धर्मनेत्र इति स्मृतः। धर्मनेत्रस्य कार्तस्तु साहझ्जस्तस्य चात्मज: ॥ वाराणस्यधिपो राजा कथित: पूर्वमेव तु। दुर्दमस्य सुतो धीमान् कनको नाम वीर्यवान्। कनकस्य तु दायादाश्चवत्वारो लोकविश्रुताः॥
verses.wordMeaning: Having conquered the earth consisting of seven insular continents with its oceans Yayāti divided it (amongst his sons). Nahusha's son installed Turvasa as the king of the south-eastern quarter, Anu and Druhya as the kings of the northern and eastern divisions respectively,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Having conquered the earth consisting of seven insular continents with its oceans Yayāti divided it (amongst his sons). Nahusha's son installed Turvasa as the king of the south-eastern quarter, Anu and Druhya as the kings of the northern and eastern divisions respectively,…
verses.science: बभूवुस्तु यदोः पुत्रा: पञ्ञ देवसुतोपमा:। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथोवाच महाभागो मार्कण्डेयो महातपाः । तस्य वंशमहं राजन् कीर्तयिष्यामि तच्छृणु ॥ ५ ॥
verses.transliteration: yathovāca mahābhāgo mārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ | tasya vaṃśamahaṃ rājan kīrtayiṣyāmi tacchṛṇu || 5 ||
verses.translation: Thus accosted by Yadu the king was filled with anger. Then blaming his son Yayāti, the foremost of speakers, said (27):—"O you of vicious intellect, disregarding me who am your preceptor and who have given you education, whom else can you seek and what religion can you follow?" (28) Having addressed Yadu thus in anger he imprecated a curse on him, saying, "O foolish wight, your sons will be deprived of their kingdom"
verses.hindi: जिगाय पृथिवीमेको रथेनादित्यवर्चसा॥ वैशम्पायनजी कहते हैं--जनमेजय ! यदुके पाँच देवोपम पुत्र हुए--सहस्रद, पयोद, क्रोष्ठाि, नील और अज्लिक॥ १॥ राजन्! सहख्रदके तीन परम धर्मात्मा पुत्र हुए--हैहय, हय और वेणुहय॥ २॥ हैहयका पुत्र धर्मनेत्र हुआ। धर्मनेत्रके कार्त और कार्तके साहझ नामक पुत्र हुए॥३॥ राजा साहझने साहझनी नामक पुरी बसायी। साहझके पुत्र राजा महिष्मान् हुए, जिन्होंने माहिष्मती नामक नगरी बसायी थी। महिष्मानूके पुत्र प्रतापी भद्रश्रेण्ण थे, जो वाराणसीपुरीके अधिपति कहे गये हैं। राजा भद्रश्रेण्पका परिचय तुम्हें पहले ही दे दिया गया है। भद्रश्रेण्यके पुत्रका नाम दुर्दम था, जो भूमण्डलके विख्यात राजा थे। दुर्दमके पुत्र

verses.sanskrit: अणुहः कस्य वै पुत्रः कस्मिन्काले बभूव ह । राजा धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठो यस्य पुत्रो महायशाः ॥ ६ ॥
verses.transliteration: aṇuhaḥ kasya vai putraḥ kasminkāle babhūva ha | rājā dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭho yasya putro mahāyaśāḥ || 6 ||

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मदत्तो नरपतिः किंवीर्यः स बभूव ह । कथं च सप्तमस्तेषां स बभूव नराधिपः ॥ ७ ॥
verses.transliteration: brahmadatto narapatiḥ kiṃvīryaḥ sa babhūva ha | kathaṃ ca saptamasteṣāṃ sa babhūva narādhipaḥ || 7 ||
verses.translation: That king, the foremost of Bharatas, likewise requested Turvasu, Drahyu and Anu and was equally dishonoured by them all (30). Being enraged that ever victorious Yayāti cursed them all as I had described to you before, O foremost of the royal saints (31). Having thus cursed his four sons who preceded Puru the king said to him, O descendant of Bharata (32). "O Puru, if you agree, I shall transfer this my decrepitude to you and being invested with your beauty and youth I shall roam over this world" (33). His powerful son Puru accepted his decrepitude. Yayāti too, endued with Puru's beauty, ranged over the earth (34). Seeing the termination of pleasures, O foremost of Bharatas, that lord lived in the Chaitraratha forest with Vishrāvyā (35). When he was satiated with enjoyments the king came to Puru and took back from him his decrepitude (36). Hear, O great king, the songs sung there by Yayāti. Hearing them a man withdraws himself from pleasures as a tortoise draws in its limbs (37). "Desire is never satiated with the enjoy ment of its object. It rather assumes proportions like a fire when clarified butter is thrown into it (38). Rice, barley, gold, animals and women, that are on earth, are not sufficient to afford satisfaction to one man. Seeing this even men are not brought to their senses (39). When a man does not commit injury to any creature even by his action, thought and words, he is unified with Brahman (40). When a man is not afraid of another, when no one is afraid of him, when he cherishes no desire or malice he is unified with Brahman (41). Verily does he attain to happiness when a man relinquishes thirst, which wicked people can never cast off, which does not wear out even when a man is possessed by decrepitude and which is like a fatal malady (42). When a man is worn out with age his hairs and teeth fall off but the desire for life and wealth never disappears (43). Whatever pleasure is there in this world derivable from the satisfaction of sensual appetites, whatever great heavenly pleasure is there none of them is equal to the one sixteenth of the pleasure derived from the extinction of desire" (44). Having said this the royal saint Yayāti retired into the forest with his wife and for many long years he carried on hard austerities (45). Having carried on his penances on the Bhrigu hill that great ascetic, renouncing his body, attained to heaven with his wife (46).
verses.hindi: कनक हुए, जो बुद्धिमानू और बलवान् थे। कनकके चार पुत्र हुए, जो सम्पूर्ण विश्वमें विख्यात थे। उनके नाम इस प्रकार हैं--कृतवीर्य, कृतौजा, कृतवर्मा और कृताग्रि। कृताग्रि कनकके चौथे पुत्र थे। कृतवीर्यसे अर्जुनकी उत्पत्ति हुई॥४--८॥ अर्जुन सहस्र भुजाओंसे युक्त हो सातों द्वीपोंका राजा हुआ। उसने अकेले ही सूर्यके समान तेजस्वी रथद्वारा सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वीको जीत लिया था दत्तमाराधयामास कार्तवीयोंउत्रिसम्भवम् अधर्मे वर्तमानस्य सद्ध्िस्तत्र निवारणम्। उग्रेण पृथिवीं जित्वा स्वधर्मेणानुरझनम्

verses.sanskrit: न ह्यल्पवीर्याय शुको भगवाँल्लोकपूजितः । कन्याप्रदद्याद्योगात्मा कृर्त्वी कीर्तिमतीं प्रभुः ॥ ८ ॥
verses.transliteration: na hyalpavīryāya śuko bhagavā~llokapūjitaḥ | kanyāpradadyādyogātmā kṛrtvī kīrtimatīṃ prabhuḥ || 8 ||
verses.translation: O great king, in his family five royal saints were born. By them the whole earth was occupied as by the rays of the sun (47). Hear now of the family of Yadu honored by all the royal saints. In his family Nārāyana Hari, the perpetuator of Vrishni race, took his birth (48), O king, he, who listens to the sacred biography of the king Yāyāti or reads it, acquires health, offspring, long life and renown (49).
verses.hindi: संग्रामे वर्तमानस्य वधं चाप्यधिकाद रणे तेन सप्तसु द्वीपेषु सप्त यज्ञशतानि वै। प्राप्तानि विधिना राज्ञा श्रूयन्ते जनमेजय सर्वे यज्ञा महाबाहोस्तस्यासन् भूरिदक्षिणा:। सर्वे काझ्जननयूपाश्व सर्वे काञ्जलनवेदय: यस्य यज्ञे जगौ गाथां गन्धर्वो नारदस्तथा।
verses.wordMeaning: O great king, in his family five royal saints were born. By them the whole earth was occupied as by the rays of the sun (47). Hear now of the family of Yadu honored by all the royal saints. In his family Nārāyana Hari, the perpetuator of Vrishni race, took his birth (48),…
verses.commentary: Sense: O great king, in his family five royal saints were born. By them the whole earth was occupied as by the rays of the sun (47). Hear now of the family of Yadu honored by all the royal saints. In his family Nārāyana Hari, the perpetuator of Vrishni race, took his birth (48),…
