verses.science: धर्मविधानतसज्ज्ञा: प्रीति: प्रमाणं न वय: प्रमाणम् वृष्णयन्धकाः: पुत्रसखा बभूवु- विसर्जिता: केशिविनाशनेन गुणोदयके इस विज्ञानको यथावत् रूपसे जानते हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गवारोहेषु चपलस्तरुघाताङ्किताननः ॥ युद्धसञ्जाविषाणाग्रो द्विषद्वृषभसूदनः ॥ ६ ॥
verses.transliteration: gavāroheṣu capalastarughātāṅkitānanaḥ || yuddhasañjāviṣāṇāgro dviṣadvṛṣabhasūdanaḥ || 6 ||
verses.hindi: वह गौओंके पछले भागपर चढ़नेके लिये चज्नल हो रहा था। वृक्षोंसे क्र लेनेके कारण उसके मस्तकमें कई जगह घट्ढे पड़ ये थे। वह अपने सींगोंके अग्रभागको सदा जूझनेके लिये द्यत रखता था तथा विपक्षी बैलोंको मार डालता था

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टो नाम हि गवामरिष्टो दारुणाकृतिः । दैत्यो वृषभरूपेण गोष्ठान् विपरिधावति ॥ ७ ॥
verses.transliteration: ariṣṭo nāma hi gavāmariṣṭo dāruṇākṛtiḥ | daityo vṛṣabharūpeṇa goṣṭhān viparidhāvati || 7 ||
verses.hindi: पयानक आकारवाला वह अरिष्टुसुर गौओंके लिये प्रिष्टकारक ग्रह बन गया था। वह दैत्य बैलके रूपमें माकर सभी गोठोंमें दौड़ लगाया करता था
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Having thus honored the Emperor Ugrasena in the presence of all the soldiers Janārddana, with great delight, entered the city of Mathurā (53). On account of the celestial ornaments, garlands, raiments and unguents it appeared as if he was living in the city of the celestials encircled by gods (54). Like unto the muttering of clouds there arose a great tumult consisting of the sound of bugles and trumpets, blare of conches, the noise of elephants, the neighing of horses, the leonine shouts of the heroes and rattle of car-wheels (55-56). The panegyrists began to sing his praises and the subjects to salute him with numberless presents. At this Hari was not the least surprised (57). He was high-minded by nature, shorn of egoism and has seen a greater display than this beforehand. And for this he was not filled with surprise (58). Beholding Mādhava's arrival who was shining in the lustre of his own person effulgent like the sun the inhabitants of Mathurā saluted him at every step and said (59):
verses.explanation: जन्मोत्सवोंमें उक्त गान्धर्वद्वारा क्रीडा या मनोरञ्ञन करते थे। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: जन्मोत्सवोंमें उक्त गान्धर्वद्वारा क्रीडा या मनोरञ्ञन करते थे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पातयानो गवां गर्भान् दृप्तो गच्छत्यनार्तवम् । भजमानश्च चपलो गृष्टीः सम्प्रचचार ह ॥ ८ ॥
verses.transliteration: pātayāno gavāṃ garbhān dṛpto gacchatyanārtavam | bhajamānaśca capalo gṛṣṭīḥ sampracacāra ha || 8 ||
verses.hindi: वह ौओंके गर्भ गिरा देता था। मदमत्त होकर बिना ऋतुके ही उनसे समागम करता तथा वह चज्नल दैत्य तुरंतकी यायी हुई गौओंका भी उपभोग करनेके लिये उनके पीछे डड़ा रहता था

verses.sanskrit: शृङ्गप्रहरणो रौद्रः प्रहरन् गोषु दुर्मदः । गोष्ठेषु न रतिं लेभे विना युद्धेन गोवृषः ॥ ९ ॥
verses.transliteration: śṛṅgapraharaṇo raudraḥ praharan goṣu durmadaḥ | goṣṭheṣu na ratiṃ lebhe vinā yuddhena govṛṣaḥ || 9 ||
verses.hindi: सींग ही उसके आयुध थे। वह बड़ा भयंकर एवं दुर्भद प्रतीत होता था। गौऑंपर प्रहार करना उसका नित्यका काम था । वह वृषभरूपधारी दैत्य गोठों में हुँचकर युद्ध किये बिना संतुष्ट नहीं होता था
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Having thus honored the Emperor Ugrasena in the presence of all the soldiers Janārddana, with great delight, entered the city of Mathurā (53). On account of the celestial ornaments, garlands, raiments and unguents it appeared as if he was living in the city of the celestials encircled by gods (54). Like unto the muttering of clouds there arose a great tumult consisting of the sound of bugles and trumpets, blare of conches, the noise of elephants, the neighing of horses, the leonine shouts of the heroes and rattle of car-wheels (55-56). The panegyrists began to sing his praises and the subjects to salute him with numberless presents. At this Hari was not the least surprised (57). He was high-minded by nature, shorn of egoism and has seen a greater display than this beforehand. And for this he was not filled with surprise (58). Beholding Mādhava's arrival who was shining in the lustre of his own person effulgent like the sun the inhabitants of Mathurā saluted him at every step and said (59):
verses.explanation: तेषां क्रीडावसक्तानां यदूनां पुण्यकर्मणाम्। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: तेषां क्रीडावसक्तानां यदूनां पुण्यकर्मणाम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य स वृषः केशवाग्रतः । आजगाम बलोदग्रो वैवस्वतवशे स्थितः ॥ १० ॥
verses.transliteration: kasyacit tvatha kālasya sa vṛṣaḥ keśavāgrataḥ | ājagāma balodagro vaivasvatavaśe sthitaḥ || 10 ||
verses.hindi: केसी समय यमराजके वशमें पड़ा हुआ वह उत्कट बलशाली वृषभरूपधारी असुर भगवान्‌ श्रीकृष्णके सामने आ्राया

verses.sanskrit: स तत्र गास्तु प्रसभं बाधमानो मदोत्कटः । चकार निर्वृषं गोष्ठं निर्वत्सशिशुपुङ्गवम् ॥ ११ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tatra gāstu prasabhaṃ bādhamāno madotkaṭaḥ | cakāra nirvṛṣaṃ goṣṭhaṃ nirvatsaśiśupuṅgavam || 11 ||
verses.hindi: मदमत्त अरिष्टासुर वहाँ आते ही बलपूर्वक पैओंको सताने लगा । उसने उस गोष्ठको बैल, बछड़ों तथा ब्रालकोंसे सूना कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु गावः कृष्णसमीपगाः । त्रासयामास दुष्टात्मा वैवस्वतवशे स्थितः ॥ १२ ॥
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu gāvaḥ kṛṣṇasamīpagāḥ | trāsayāmāsa duṣṭātmā vaivasvatavaśe sthitaḥ || 12 ||
verses.hindi: इसी समय कालके त्रशमें पड़ा हुआ वह दुष्टात्मा दैत्य श्रीकृष्णके पास खड़ी दुई गौओंको त्रास देने लगा

verses.sanskrit: सेन्द्राशनिरिवाम्भोदो नर्दमानो महासुरः । तालशब्देन तं कृष्णः सिंहनादैश्च मोहयन् ॥ १३ ॥
verses.transliteration: sendrāśanirivāmbhodo nardamāno mahāsuraḥ | tālaśabdena taṃ kṛṣṇaḥ siṃhanādaiśca mohayan || 13 ||
verses.hindi: उस समय गर्जना करता हुआ वह महान्‌ असुर इन्द्रके वज़की गड़गड़ाहटके पाथ आकाशमें छाये हुए मेघके समान जान पड़ता था। उसे मोहमें डालनेके लिये श्रीकृष्णने ताल ठोंका और सिंहनाद किया

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यधावत गोविन्दो दैत्यं वृषभरूपिणम् । स कृष्णं गोवृषो दृष्ट्वा हृष्टलाङ्गूललोचनः ॥ १४ ॥
verses.transliteration: abhyadhāvata govindo daityaṃ vṛṣabharūpiṇam | sa kṛṣṇaṃ govṛṣo dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭalāṅgūlalocanaḥ || 14 ||
verses.hindi: फिर वे भगवान्‌ गोविन्द उस तृषभरूपधारी दैत्यकी ओर दौड़े। श्रीकृष्णको देखते ही उस बैलने हर्षमें भरकर अपनी पूँछ उठायी और उसके नेत्र भी खिल उठे

verses.sanskrit: रोषितस्तालशब्देन युद्धाकाङ्क्षी ननर्द ह । तमापतन्तं दुर्वृत्तं दृष्ट्वा वृषभरूपिणम् । तस्मात् स्थानान्न व्यचलत् कृष्णो गिरिरिवाचलः ॥ १५ ॥
verses.transliteration: roṣitastālaśabdena yuddhākāṅkṣī nanarda ha | tamāpatantaṃ durvṛttaṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛṣabharūpiṇam | tasmāt sthānānna vyacalat kṛṣṇo giririvācalaḥ || 15 ||
verses.hindi: उनके ताल उठॉंकनेके शब्दसे तरह रोषमें भरा हुआ था, अत: युद्धकी इच्छासे गर्जना करने लगा। बैलका रूप धारण करके अपनी ओर आते हुए उस दुराचारी दैत्यको देखकर भी श्रीकृष्ण उस स्थानसे तनिक भी इधर-उधर नहीं हुए, पर्वतके समान अविचलभावसे खड़े रह गये

verses.sanskrit: स कुक्षौ वृषभो दृष्टिं प्रणिधाय धृताननः । कृष्णस्य निधनाकाङ्क्षी तूर्णमभ्युत्पपात ह ॥ १६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa kukṣau vṛṣabho dṛṣṭiṃ praṇidhāya dhṛtānanaḥ | kṛṣṇasya nidhanākāṅkṣī tūrṇamabhyutpapāta ha || 16 ||
verses.hindi: उस वृषभने श्रीकृष्णके पेठमें दृष्टि जमाकर उधर ही मस्तक भिड़ाया और उनके वधकी इच्छा रखकर तुरंत ही उछला

verses.sanskrit: तमापतन्तं वेगेन प्रतिजग्राह दुर्द्धरम् । कृष्णः कृष्णाञ्जननिभो वृषं प्रति वृषोपमः ॥ १७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tamāpatantaṃ vegena pratijagrāha durddharam | kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇāñjananibho vṛṣaṃ prati vṛṣopamaḥ || 17 ||
verses.hindi: काले अज्जनके समान श्याम शरीरवाले श्रीकृष्ण उस बैलका सामना करनेके लिये विपक्षी साँड़के समान प्रतीत होते थे। उन्होंने वेगसे अपनी ओर आते हुए उस दुर्धर दैत्यको पकड़ लिया

verses.sanskrit: स संसक्तस्तु कृष्णो वै वृषेणेव महावृषः । मुमोच वक्त्रजं फेनं नस्तश्चाथ सशब्दवत् ॥ १८ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa saṃsaktastu kṛṣṇo vai vṛṣeṇeva mahāvṛṣaḥ | mumoca vaktrajaṃ phenaṃ nastaścātha saśabdavat || 18 ||
verses.hindi: फिर तो श्रीकृष्ण उसके साथ इस तरह उलझ गये, जैसे एक साँड़के साथ दूसरा महासाँड भिड़ गया हो। अरिष्टासुर हाँफता हुआ अपनी नाक और मुखसे फेन छोड़ने लगा

verses.sanskrit: तावन्योन्यावरुद्धाङ्गौ युद्धे कृष्णवृषावुभौ । रेजतुर्मेघसमये संसक्ताविव तोयदौ ॥ १९ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāvanyonyāvaruddhāṅgau yuddhe kṛṣṇavṛṣāvubhau | rejaturmeghasamaye saṃsaktāviva toyadau || 19 ||
verses.hindi: श्रीकृष्ण और अरिष्टासुर दोनोंने उस युद्धमें एक-दूसरेके शरीरको अवरुद्ध कर लिया था। उस समय वे दोनों वर्षाकालमें परस्पर सटे हुए दो मेघोंके समान शोभा पा रहे थे

verses.sanskrit: तस्य दर्पबलं हत्वा कृत्वा शृङ्गान्तरे पदम् । आपीडयदरिष्टस्य कण्ठं क्लिन्नमिवाम्बरम् ॥ २० ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya darpabalaṃ hatvā kṛtvā śṛṅgāntare padam | āpīḍayadariṣṭasya kaṇṭhaṃ klinnamivāmbaram || 20 ||
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार उसके बलको क्षीण करके घमंड चूर कर देनेके बाद श्रीकृष्णने उसके दोनों सींगोंके बीचमें एक पैर रखा और जैसे भीगे हुए कपड़ेको निचोड़ा जाता है, उसी प्रकार अरिषासुरके गलेको दबाकर मरोड़ दिया

verses.sanskrit: शृङ्गं चास्य पुनः सव्यमुत्पाट्य यमदण्डवत् । तेनैव प्राहरद् वक्त्रे स ममार भृशं हतः ॥ २१ ॥
verses.transliteration: śṛṅgaṃ cāsya punaḥ savyamutpāṭya yamadaṇḍavat | tenaiva prāharad vaktre sa mamāra bhṛśaṃ hataḥ || 21 ||
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात्‌ उसके बायें सींगको जो यमदण्डके समान जान पड़ता था, उखाड़ लिया और उसीके द्वारा उसके मुखपर प्रहार किया । उसकी गहरी चोट खाकर अरिष्टासुर मर गया
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Having thus honored the Emperor Ugrasena in the presence of all the soldiers Janārddana, with great delight, entered the city of Mathurā (53). On account of the celestial ornaments, garlands, raiments and unguents it appeared as if he was living in the city of the celestials encircled by gods (54). Like unto the muttering of clouds there arose a great tumult consisting of the sound of bugles and trumpets, blare of conches, the noise of elephants, the neighing of horses, the leonine shouts of the heroes and rattle of car-wheels (55-56). The panegyrists began to sing his praises and the subjects to salute him with numberless presents. At this Hari was not the least surprised (57). He was high-minded by nature, shorn of egoism and has seen a greater display than this beforehand. And for this he was not filled with surprise (58). Beholding Mādhava's arrival who was shining in the lustre of his own person effulgent like the sun the inhabitants of Mathurā saluted him at every step and said (59):
verses.explanation: दृष्ठा देवान् हषीकेशश्रिन्रैर्युद्धैररिंदम:। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: दृष्ठा देवान् हषीकेशश्रिन्रैर्युद्धैररिंदम:। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स भिन्नशृङ्गो भग्नास्यो भग्नस्कन्धश्च दानवः । पपात रुधिरोद्गारी साम्बुधार इवाम्बुदः ॥ २२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa bhinnaśṛṅgo bhagnāsyo bhagnaskandhaśca dānavaḥ | papāta rudhirodgārī sāmbudhāra ivāmbudaḥ || 22 ||
verses.hindi: उसका सींग उखड़ गया, मुख कुचल दिया गया और गर्दन टूट गयी, उस दशामें वह दानव जलकी धारा बरसानेवाले मेघके समान अपने मुखसे रक्त वमन करता हुआ गिर पड़ा
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Having thus honored the Emperor Ugrasena in the presence of all the soldiers Janārddana, with great delight, entered the city of Mathurā (53). On account of the celestial ornaments, garlands, raiments and unguents it appeared as if he was living in the city of the celestials encircled by gods (54). Like unto the muttering of clouds there arose a great tumult consisting of the sound of bugles and trumpets, blare of conches, the noise of elephants, the neighing of horses, the leonine shouts of the heroes and rattle of car-wheels (55-56). The panegyrists began to sing his praises and the subjects to salute him with numberless presents. At this Hari was not the least surprised (57). He was high-minded by nature, shorn of egoism and has seen a greater display than this beforehand. And for this he was not filled with surprise (58). Beholding Mādhava's arrival who was shining in the lustre of his own person effulgent like the sun the inhabitants of Mathurā saluted him at every step and said (59):
verses.explanation: अवष्टभ्य मुहूर्त तु हरि: कौमोदकीं गदाम्। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: अवष्टभ्य मुहूर्त तु हरि: कौमोदकीं गदाम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गोविन्देन हतं दृष्ट्वा दृप्तं वृषभदानवम् । साधु साध्विति भूतानि तत्कर्मास्याभितुष्टुवुः ॥ २३ ॥
verses.transliteration: govindena hataṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛptaṃ vṛṣabhadānavam | sādhu sādhviti bhūtāni tatkarmāsyābhituṣṭuvuḥ || 23 ||
verses.hindi: मदसे उन्मत्त रहनेवाले उस वृषभरूपी दानवको भगवान्‌ गोविन्दके हाथसे मारा गया देख सब प्राणी साधु-साधु कहकर उनके उस कर्मकी भूरि-भूरि प्रशंसा करने लगे
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Having thus honored the Emperor Ugrasena in the presence of all the soldiers Janārddana, with great delight, entered the city of Mathurā (53). On account of the celestial ornaments, garlands, raiments and unguents it appeared as if he was living in the city of the celestials encircled by gods (54). Like unto the muttering of clouds there arose a great tumult consisting of the sound of bugles and trumpets, blare of conches, the noise of elephants, the neighing of horses, the leonine shouts of the heroes and rattle of car-wheels (55-56). The panegyrists began to sing his praises and the subjects to salute him with numberless presents. At this Hari was not the least surprised (57). He was high-minded by nature, shorn of egoism and has seen a greater display than this beforehand. And for this he was not filled with surprise (58). Beholding Mādhava's arrival who was shining in the lustre of his own person effulgent like the sun the inhabitants of Mathurā saluted him at every step and said (59):
verses.explanation: कृष्ण: प्रत्यागतप्राणश्रक्रमुद्यम्य भारत। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: कृष्ण: प्रत्यागतप्राणश्रक्रमुद्यम्य भारत। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: स चोपेन्द्रो वृषं हत्वा कान्तचन्द्रे निशामुखे । अरविन्दाभनयनः पुनरेव ररास ह ॥ २४ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa copendro vṛṣaṃ hatvā kāntacandre niśāmukhe | aravindābhanayanaḥ punareva rarāsa ha || 24 ||
verses.hindi: उस प्रदोषकालमें जब कि चन्द्रमाकी कमनीय कान्ति बढ़ी हुई थी, कमलनयन भगवान्‌ उपेन्द्र वृषभासुरको मारकर पुन: रासक्रीड़ामें संलग्र हो गये

verses.sanskrit: तेऽपि गोवृत्तयः सर्वे कृष्णं कमललोचनम् । उपासाञ्चक्रिरे हृष्टाः सर्वे शक्रमिवामराः ॥ २५ ॥
verses.transliteration: te'pi govṛttayaḥ sarve kṛṣṇaṃ kamalalocanam | upāsāñcakrire hṛṣṭāḥ sarve śakramivāmarāḥ || 25 ||
verses.hindi: गौएँ ही जिनकी आजीविका हैं, वे समस्त गोप भी हर्षमें भरकर कमलनयन श्रीकृष्णकी उसी तरह उपासना करने लगे, जैसे सम्पूर्ण देवता इन्द्रकी आराधना करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: कंसस्य आशङ्का, तस्य रात्रिसमये यदुवंशीनामाह्वयित्वा सभायां श्रीकृष्णस्य एवं विष्णोः प्रभावस्य कथनम्, वसुदेवोपरि कठोराक्षेपम्, श्रीकृष्णादीनां आनयने अक्रूरस्य व्रजगमनाय आज्ञापनं कृष्णं व्रजगतं श्रुत्वा वर्धमानमिवानलम् । उद्वेगमगमत् कंसः शङ्कमानस्ततो भयम् ॥ १ ॥
verses.transliteration: kaṃsasya āśaṅkā, tasya rātrisamaye yaduvaṃśīnāmāhvayitvā sabhāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya evaṃ viṣṇoḥ prabhāvasya kathanam, vasudevopari kaṭhorākṣepam, śrīkṛṣṇādīnāṃ ānayane akrūrasya vrajagamanāya ājñāpanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vrajagataṃ śrutvā vardhamānamivānalam | udvegamagamat kaṃsaḥ śaṅkamānastato bhayam || 1 ||

verses.sanskrit: पूतनायां हतायां च कालिये च पराजिते । धेनुके प्रलयं नीते प्रलम्बे च निपातिते ॥ २ ॥
verses.transliteration: pūtanāyāṃ hatāyāṃ ca kāliye ca parājite | dhenuke pralayaṃ nīte pralambe ca nipātite || 2 ||
verses.translation: Having heard this conversation of the citizens, the bards, panegyrists and the poets sang, "O thou the ocean of accomplishments, how can we, who are one tongued men, sing the deeds begotten of thy prowess and energy (64–65). The thousand-headed serpent-king Vāsuki, who has the intellect of a god, can, with his two thousand tongues, to a certain extent describe thy accomplishments (66). It is a great wonder to the kings of the earth that a throne was sent by Indra. It never happened before nor will it be in future (67). The descension of the assembly-hall and jars from the celestial region has never been heard of or seen. Therefore we consider it as a wonder (68). O Keshava, conceiving a son like thee, the foremost of gods, Devaki, the best of damsels, has been blessed because she, with her eyes full of affection, saw thy lotus face adored by men and the immortals (69–70)".
verses.hindi: प्रजहासाथ भगवानर्जुनेन सह प्रभु: सहस्त्राण्येव कृष्णं तु तथा पार्थमरिंदम। रौक्मिणेयं तथा वीरं तदद्धुतमिवाभवत् पाण्डवस्य धनु: केचित्केचिदस्य महाशरान्। अन्येउ5स्य जगृहुर्हस्तावन्ये पादौ महासुरा: पार्थानामपि कोट्यस्तु गृहीतानां तदाभवन्
verses.wordMeaning: Having heard this conversation of the citizens, the bards, panegyrists and the poets sang, "O thou the ocean of accomplishments, how can we, who are one tongued men, sing the deeds begotten of thy prowess and energy (64–65). The thousand-headed serpent-king Vāsuki,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Having heard this conversation of the citizens, the bards, panegyrists and the poets sang, "O thou the ocean of accomplishments, how can we, who are one tongued men, sing the deeds begotten of thy prowess and energy (64–65). The thousand-headed serpent-king Vāsuki,…
verses.science: प्रजहासाथ भगवानर्जुनेन सह प्रभु: सहस्त्राण्येव कृष्णं तु तथा पार्थमरिंदम। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: धृते गोवर्धने शैले विफले शक्रशासने । गोषु त्रातासु च तथा स्पृहणीयेन कर्मणा ॥ ३ ॥
verses.transliteration: dhṛte govardhane śaile viphale śakraśāsane | goṣu trātāsu ca tathā spṛhaṇīyena karmaṇā || 3 ||
verses.translation: Placing Ugrasena before them and listening to the conversation regarding their praises sung by the citizens the two brothers Rāma and Krishna arrived at the gate and the king worshipped them repeatedly sending for _arghya_ and water for washing feet and rinsing mouth (71–72). Thereupon approaching Keshava's car, saluting him with his head down and mounting on an elephant the energetic and intelligent Ugrasena began to shower gold as the clouds discharge their watery contents (73). Having thus showered gold on him the beautiful Mādhava arrived at his father's house and said to Ugrasena, the king of Mathura (74): "O lord, although I have secured the dignity of the Lord Paramount, this throne, conferred by the king of gods, should be kept in the king's Palace (75). Although acquired by the strength of my own arms I do not like to come by the assembly-hall of the king of Mathurā. O lord, I propitiate you. Do not be offended" (76).
verses.hindi: नान्तं ददर्श कृष्णश्व कार्ण्णिश्च रिपुनाशनौ। विच्छिद्य तौ शरैर्वीरौ निकुम्भं पार्थवर्जितो दिव्यज्ञानस्तदा कृष्णो भगवाननुदृष्टवान् स चक्रेण शिरस्तस्थ चकर्तासुरसूदन:। पश्यतां सर्वभूतानां भूतभव्यभवो हरिः उनकी यह बात सुनकर अत्यन्त मायावी दुर्जय वीर निकुम्भ भी अपने उस शरीरको वहीं त्यागकर ऊपरकी ओर उड़ गया। श्रीकृष्णको उसकी इस चालका पता न लगा॥ ५० ॥ प्रभो! यह मरना चाहता है अथवा मर गया है--ऐसा समझकर वीर-ब्रतका स्मरण रखते हुए वीर जनार्दनने उसकी रक्षा की (गिरे हुए उस दानवके शरीरपर अपना अस्त्र नहीं चलाया)
verses.wordMeaning: Placing Ugrasena before them and listening to the conversation regarding their praises sung by the citizens the two brothers Rāma and Krishna arrived at the gate and the king worshipped them repeatedly sending for _arghya_ and water for washing feet and rinsing mouth (71–72).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Placing Ugrasena before them and listening to the conversation regarding their praises sung by the citizens the two brothers Rāma and Krishna arrived at the gate and the king worshipped them repeatedly sending for _arghya_ and water for washing feet and rinsing mouth (71–72).…
verses.science: नान्तं ददर्श कृष्णश्व कार्ण्णिश्च रिपुनाशनौ। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ककुद्मिनि हतेऽरिष्टे गोपेषु मुदितेषु च । दृश्यमाने विनाशे च सन्निकृष्टे महाभये ॥ ४ ॥
verses.transliteration: kakudmini hate'riṣṭe gopeṣu muditeṣu ca | dṛśyamāne vināśe ca sannikṛṣṭe mahābhaye || 4 ||
verses.translation: O king Janamejaya, at that time Vasudeva, Devaki and Rohini were so much overwhelmed with joy that they could not give vent to any word (77).
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर प्रद्यम्म और अर्जुन दोनों सचेत हो श्रीकृष्णके निकट आकर खड़े हो गये। उन दोनोंने निकुम्भके वधका निश्चय कर लिया था॥ ५२॥ प्रद्युम्न भी मायावी थे; अतः उन्होंने निकुम्भकी मायाको पहचान लिया और श्रीकृष्ससे कहा--'तात! निकुम्भ यहाँ नहीं है। वह दुर्बद्धि कहीं चला गया'॥ ५३॥ प्रद्यु्अके इतना कहते ही निकुम्भभा वह कलेवर अदृश्य हो गया। यह देख अर्जुनके साथ भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण जोर-जोरसे हँसने लगे॥ ५४॥ नरेश्वर! इतनेहीमें उन वीरोंने पृथ्वीपर, आकाशमें तथा सब ओर सहस्नों अयुत (एक करोड़) निकुम्भके शरीर देखे॥ ५५॥ शत्रुदमन नरेश! श्रीकृष्ण, अर्जुन तथा रुक्मिणीकुमार वीर प्रद्युम्रके भी सहस्तरों शरीर दिखायी दिये। वह अद्धुत-सा दृश्य प्रकट हुआ॥ ५६॥ किन्हीं महान् असुरोंने अर्जुनका धनुष ले लिया, किन्हींने उनके बड़े-बड़े बाण छीन लिये, दूसरोंने उनके दोनों हाथ पकड़ लिये और अन्य असुरोंने उनके
verses.commentary: Sense: O king Janamejaya, at that time Vasudeva, Devaki and Rohini were so much overwhelmed with joy that they could not give vent to any word (77).
verses.science: तदनन्तर प्रद्यम्म और अर्जुन दोनों सचेत हो श्रीकृष्णके निकट आकर खड़े हो गये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्षणे वृक्षयोश्चैव शकटस्य तथैव च । अचिन्त्यं कर्म्म तच्छ्रुत्वा वर्धमानेषु शत्रुषु ॥ ५ ॥
verses.transliteration: karṣaṇe vṛkṣayoścaiva śakaṭasya tathaiva ca | acintyaṃ karmma tacchrutvā vardhamāneṣu śatruṣu || 5 ||

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तारिष्टमिवात्मानं मेने स मथुरेश्वरः । विसंज्ञेन्द्रियभूतात्मा गतासुप्रतिमो बभौ ॥ ६ ॥
verses.transliteration: prāptāriṣṭamivātmānaṃ mene sa mathureśvaraḥ | visaṃjñendriyabhūtātmā gatāsupratimo babhau || 6 ||
verses.translation: Krishna said:—"It is time that has snatched away your two sons; I have not slain them either for riches or for the kingdom of Mathurā (80), O king of Mathura, having vanquished your enemies by the might of my arms do you perform many sacrifices and make profuse presents (81). O king, do you cast off your mental agony and fear consequent upon Kansa's death. I return you these riches; do you accept them" (82)
verses.hindi: जगाम द्वारकां देव: पार्थकामसमन्वित: समियाय दशाहों5थ द्वारकां मुदितो विभु: । नारदं च महात्मानं वबन्दे यदुनन्दनः भानो मा कार्षा्मन्युं त्वं श्रूयतां भेमनन्दन क्रीडन्त्या रैवतेद्याने दुर्वासा: कोपितो3नया। स शशाप ततो रोषान्मुनिर्दुहितर तव
verses.wordMeaning: Krishna said:—"It is time that has snatched away your two sons; I have not slain them either for riches or for the kingdom of Mathurā (80), O king of Mathura, having vanquished your enemies by the might of my arms do you perform many sacrifices and make profuse presents (81).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Krishna said:—"It is time that has snatched away your two sons; I have not slain them either for riches or for the kingdom of Mathurā (80), O king of Mathura, having vanquished your enemies by the might of my arms do you perform many sacrifices and make profuse presents (81).…
verses.science: जगाम द्वारकां देव: पार्थकामसमन्वित: समियाय दशाहों5थ द्वारकां मुदितो विभु:। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो ज्ञातीन् समानाय्य पितरं चोग्रशासनः । निशि स्तिमितमूकायां मथुरायां जनाधिपः ॥ ७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato jñātīn samānāyya pitaraṃ cograśāsanaḥ | niśi stimitamūkāyāṃ mathurāyāṃ janādhipaḥ || 7 ||
verses.translation: Having thus consoled the king, Krishna, along with Balarama, went to his parents (83). There those two highly powerful heroes, with heart full of joy, saluted their parents bending their heads (84). O Janamejaya, at that time the city of Mathurā left off her own form and as if the capital of gods came down there leaving the celestial region (85). Beholding Vasudeva's house the citizens did not consider it as earth but took it for the region of the celestials (86). Having thus entered Vasudeva's house the heroic Baladeva and Keshava dismissed Ugrasena, the king of Mathurā and his queen. And then leaving off their arms and moving about for some time they went through the evening rites. And then seated at ease they conversed with one another (87-88). In the meantime there took place a highly dreadful calamity. The clouds were scattered in the sky, the earth and the mountains were shaken, the oceans were agitated, the serpents were terrified and the Yadavas, trembling, fell down on earth (89–90). Beholding them thus fallen the immoveable Rāma and Krishna, perceived, from the flapping of the huge wings, the approach of Garuda, the foremost of birds. And within a short time they saw Garuda by them. Saluting them both with his head, Vinatā's son, of a gentle form, adorned with celestial garlands and unguents, sat on a seat (61–92). Observing the arrival of his war-like minister, the intelligent son of Vinatā, the slayer of Madhu said: "O thou the grinder of the enemies of the celestial army, O delight of Vinatā's heart, O foremost of birds, O favourite of Keshava, may thy arrival here prove auspicious" (93–94). Having thus addressed Vinatā's son, stationed there like a very god Krishna again said to him who was equally powerful (95).
verses.hindi: सुतार्थ ते मया सार्द्ध मुनिभि: स प्रसादितः शप्तवानसि धर्मज्ञ कथ्थ धर्मभूतां बर। अनुग्रह॑ विधत्स्वात्र वयं विज्ञापयामहे अदूषिता नु धर्मेण भर्तारमुपलप्स्यति। बहुपुत्रा बहुधना सुभगा च भविष्यति एवं भानुमती वीर सहदेवाय दीयताम्। श्रदधान: स शूरश्व धर्मशीलश्चव पाण्डव: सहदेवाय धर्मात्मा नारदस्य वच: स्मरन्
verses.wordMeaning: Having thus consoled the king, Krishna, along with Balarama, went to his parents (83). There those two highly powerful heroes, with heart full of joy, saluted their parents bending their heads (84). O Janamejaya,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Having thus consoled the king, Krishna, along with Balarama, went to his parents (83). There those two highly powerful heroes, with heart full of joy, saluted their parents bending their heads (84). O Janamejaya,…
verses.science: सुतार्थ ते मया सार्द्ध मुनिभि: स प्रसादितः शप्तवानसि धर्मज्ञ कथ्थ धर्मभूतां बर। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: वसुदेवं च देवाभं कङ्कं चाहूय यादवम् । सत्यकं दारुकं चैव कङ्कावरजमेव च ॥ ८ ॥
verses.transliteration: vasudevaṃ ca devābhaṃ kaṅkaṃ cāhūya yādavam | satyakaṃ dārukaṃ caiva kaṅkāvarajameva ca || 8 ||

verses.sanskrit: भोजं वैतरणं चैव विकद्रुं च महाबलम् । भयशङ्खं च धर्मज्ञं विपृथुं च पृथुश्रियम् ॥ ९ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhojaṃ vaitaraṇaṃ caiva vikadruṃ ca mahābalam | bhayaśaṅkhaṃ ca dharmajñaṃ vipṛthuṃ ca pṛthuśriyam || 9 ||

verses.sanskrit: बभ्रुं दानपतिं चैव कृतवर्माणमेव च । भूरितेजसमक्षोभ्यं भूरिश्रवसमेव च ॥ १० ॥
verses.transliteration: babhruṃ dānapatiṃ caiva kṛtavarmāṇameva ca | bhūritejasamakṣobhyaṃ bhūriśravasameva ca || 10 ||

verses.sanskrit: एतान्स यादवान् सर्वानाभाष्य शृणुतेति च । उग्रसेनसुतो राजा प्रोवाच मथुरेश्वरः ॥ ११ ॥
verses.transliteration: etānsa yādavān sarvānābhāṣya śṛṇuteti ca | ugrasenasuto rājā provāca mathureśvaraḥ || 11 ||
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Having said this to Keshava and saluted them both Vinatā's son took his seat (117). Meditating on the words uttered by him conducive to their well-being, and in order to give a proof of his appreciation Krishna, with Rama, honored Garuda with presents of most excellent and precious dresses and dismissed him. And then they enjoyed there like two immortals in the city of the celestials (118-119). When in time the highly illustrious Bhoja king heard of what Garuda had said he affectionately addressed to Keshava the following nectarine words
verses.hindi: इमं कृष्णस्य विजयं यः पठेच्छुणुयादथ। पत्नीसहित विदा कर दिया, फिर वे अपनी पुरीको चले गये॥ ७७॥ जो मनुष्य श्रद्धापूर्वक भगवान् श्रीकृष्णकी इस विजय-वार्ताको पढ़ेगा या सुनेगा, वह सभी कार्योमें विजयं सर्वकृत्येषु श्रद्धानो लभेन्नर:।॥ ७८  विजय प्राप्त करेगा इति श्रीमहाभारते खिलभागे हरिवंशे विष्णुपर्वणि भानुमतीहरणे निकुम्भवधो नाम नवतितमोउध्याय: इस ग्रकार श्रीमहाभारतके खिलभाग हरिवशके अन्तर्गत विष्युपर्वणें भानुमतीहरणके ग्रसड्में निकृम्पका वधविषयक नब्बेवाँ अध्याय पूरा हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Vaishampāyana said:—Having said this to Keshava and saluted them both Vinatā's son took his seat (117). Meditating on the words uttered by him conducive to their well-being, and in order to give a proof of his appreciation Krishna, with Rama,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vaishampāyana said:—Having said this to Keshava and saluted them both Vinatā's son took his seat (117). Meditating on the words uttered by him conducive to their well-being, and in order to give a proof of his appreciation Krishna, with Rama,…
verses.science: इमं कृष्णस्य विजयं यः पठेच्छुणुयादथ। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तः सर्वकार्यज्ञा वेदेषु परिनिष्ठिताः । न्यायवृत्तान्तकुशलास्त्रिवर्गस्य प्रवर्तकाः ॥ १२ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhavantaḥ sarvakāryajñā vedeṣu pariniṣṭhitāḥ | nyāyavṛttāntakuśalāstrivargasya pravartakāḥ || 12 ||

verses.sanskrit: कर्तव्यानां च कर्तारो लोकस्य विबुधोपमाः । तस्थिवांसो महावृत्ते निष्कम्पा इव पर्वताः ॥ १३ ॥
verses.transliteration: kartavyānāṃ ca kartāro lokasya vibudhopamāḥ | tasthivāṃso mahāvṛtte niṣkampā iva parvatāḥ || 13 ||

verses.sanskrit: अदम्भवृत्तयः सर्वे सर्वे गुरुकुलोषिताः । राजमन्त्रधराः सर्वे सर्वे धनुषि पारगाः ॥ १४ ॥
verses.transliteration: adambhavṛttayaḥ sarve sarve gurukuloṣitāḥ | rājamantradharāḥ sarve sarve dhanuṣi pāragāḥ || 14 ||

verses.sanskrit: यशःप्रदीपा लोकानां वेदार्थानां विवक्षवः । आश्रमाणां निसर्गज्ञा वर्णानां क्रमपारगाः ॥ १५ ॥
verses.transliteration: yaśaḥpradīpā lokānāṃ vedārthānāṃ vivakṣavaḥ | āśramāṇāṃ nisargajñā varṇānāṃ kramapāragāḥ || 15 ||
verses.translation: Thereupon the Vrishnis began to hold consultations regarding this most excellent proposal:—"Our enemy the king Jarāsandha has been destined as unslayable by us. And his power is also very great (10). True it is that many armies of the kings have been slain in this city of Mathurā. But so great is the number of his soldiers that we shall not be able to bring about their destruction even in hundred years" (11). At that time O king, the emperor Jarāsandha, along with Kālayavana was proceeding towards Mathurā with his army (12). Having heard of the approach of Jarāsandha and Kālayavana with that highly irrepressible huge army the Yadavas thought of retreating as mentioned before (13). The truthful Krishna again said to the Yadavas:—"To day is an auspicious day. So we shall, even this very day, issue out of Mathura along with our army and followers (14)".
verses.hindi: हुए सुन्दर वज़्पुर नामक नगरकी भी याचना की भारत! उस नगरमें स्वच्छन्दतापूर्वक वायुका भी प्रवेश नहीं होता था। नरेश्वर! बिना चिन्तन किये ही वहाँ सम्पूर्ण मनोवाड्छित भोगोंकी प्राप्ति होती रहती थी कोटिशो वरलब्धं तमसुराः परिवार्य ते। ऊषुर्वज़पुरे राजन् संवाहेषु तथेव च हृष्टपुष्टपप्रमुदिता नृप देवस्यथ शत्रवः महेन्द्रमब्रवीद् गत्वा देवलोक॑ विशाम्पते। अहमीशितुमिच्छामि त्रैलोक्यं पाकशासन
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon the Vrishnis began to hold consultations regarding this most excellent proposal:—"Our enemy the king Jarāsandha has been destined as unslayable by us. And his power is also very great (10).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon the Vrishnis began to hold consultations regarding this most excellent proposal:—"Our enemy the king Jarāsandha has been destined as unslayable by us. And his power is also very great (10).…
verses.science: हुए सुन्दर वज़्पुर नामक नगरकी भी याचना की भारत! उस नगरमें स्वच्छन्दतापूर्वक वायुका भी प्रवेश नहीं होता था। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवक्तारः सुनियतां नेतारो नयदर्शिनाम् । भेत्तारः परराष्ट्राणां त्रातारः शरणार्थिनाम् ॥ १६ ॥
verses.transliteration: pravaktāraḥ suniyatāṃ netāro nayadarśinām | bhettāraḥ pararāṣṭrāṇāṃ trātāraḥ śaraṇārthinām || 16 ||
verses.translation: Having obtained this command from Krishna, the Yadavas, headed by Vasudeva, along with their wives, cars and elephants, set out, echoing the four quarters with the noise of their soldiers resembling that of the waves of the ocean (15-16). Leaving Mathurā the Yadavas went on with their wealth, kinsmen, friends, golden chariots, infuriated elephants and trotting horses decorated with gold (17-18). O foremost of Bharatas, having adorned their respective detachments of the army and moved it on the Yādadas set out for the west (19). Stationed in front, Vasudeva and other leaving Yadavas, ever adorning a battle-field, guided the army (20). Having thus wended a very long distance the leading Yādus reached the bank of the ocean. It was variegated with creepers, abounded in coconut trees and beautiful elephants, was covered with Ketaki trees, palmyras, Pannages and vines (21–24). Having secured such a picturesque site the Yadavas were highly delighted as if they had arrived at the celestial region (23). Searching for a site where he would lay out a city Krishna, the slayer of inimical heroes, saw an extensive tract of land situated on the bank of the ocean (24). The land had a coppery soil mixed with gravels, was well-suited for animals of burden, was endued with all the favourable marks of a city, as if it was presided over by the Goddess of prosperity herself. It was fanned by the sea breeze and was watered by the ocean. Near it was shining in beauty the charming mountain Raivata like the mount Mandara. On that mountain containing all the jems and resorted to by many great men Drona lived for many long years. There lived the king Ekalavya. And the sporting ground laid out by himself like a board of dice is celebrated by the name of Dwāravati (25-29). Keshava selected that site for his city and the Yādavas also wanted to encamp their soldiers there. Thereupon the Yadu commanders pitched tents there for the night (30–31).
verses.hindi: अथवा मे प्रयच्छस्व युद्धं देवगणेश्वर। सामान्य हि जगत्कृत्मत काश्यपानां महात्मनाम् सत्रेषु दीक्षित: सौम्य कश्यपो नः पिता मुनि:। तस्मिन् वृत्ते यथा न्याय्यं तथा स हि करिष्यति यथोक्त देवराजेन तमुवाचाथ कश्यपः सत्रे वृत्ते करिष्यामि यथा न्याय्यं भविष्यति। त्वं तु बच्नपुरे पुत्र वत्स गच्छ समाहितः
verses.wordMeaning: Having obtained this command from Krishna, the Yadavas, headed by Vasudeva, along with their wives, cars and elephants, set out, echoing the four quarters with the noise of their soldiers resembling that of the waves of the ocean (15-16).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Having obtained this command from Krishna, the Yadavas, headed by Vasudeva, along with their wives, cars and elephants, set out, echoing the four quarters with the noise of their soldiers resembling that of the waves of the ocean (15-16).…
verses.science: अथवा मे प्रयच्छस्व युद्धं देवगणेश्वर। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमक्षतचारित्रैः श्रीमद्भिरुदितोदितैः । द्यौरप्यनुगृहीता स्याद्भवद्भिः किं पुनर्मही ॥ १७ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamakṣatacāritraiḥ śrīmadbhiruditoditaiḥ | dyaurapyanugṛhītā syādbhavadbhiḥ kiṃ punarmahī || 17 ||

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणामिव वो वृत्तं प्रभावो मरुतामिव । रुद्राणामिव वः क्रोधो दीप्तिरङ्गिरसारमिव ॥ १८ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāmiva vo vṛttaṃ prabhāvo marutāmiva | rudrāṇāmiva vaḥ krodho dīptiraṅgirasāramiva || 18 ||

verses.sanskrit: व्यावर्तमानं सुमहद् भवद्भिः ख्यात कीर्तिभिः । धृतं यदुकुलं वीरैर्भूतलं पर्वतैरिव ॥ १९ ॥
verses.transliteration: vyāvartamānaṃ sumahad bhavadbhiḥ khyāta kīrtibhiḥ | dhṛtaṃ yadukulaṃ vīrairbhūtalaṃ parvatairiva || 19 ||
verses.translation: Janamejaya said:—O reverend sir, I wish to listen at length to the history of the high-souled and intelligent Vāsudeva, the foremost of Yadus (1). O foremost of the twice-born, why did Janārddana, without fighting, leave Mathura the only abode of Lakshmi (the goddess of prosperity), the hump (the most elevated) of Central India, the very summit of the earth, abounding in profuse corns, wealth and beautiful houses, and consisting of many worshipful Aryans? How did Kālayavana behave towards Krishna? Having obtained the watery fortress Dwarkā what did the great Yogin of hard penances the mighty-armed Janārddana do (2–5)? Whose son was Kālayavana and how powerful was he? Do thou describe all this to me (6).
verses.hindi: कहा-- ॥ १८॥ “वत्स! यज्ञ समाप्त हो जानेपर जैसा उचित होगा, वैसा करूँगा। तबतक तुम वचज़पुरमें चलकर सावधान होकर रहो'॥ १९॥ पिताके ऐसा कहनेपर वज़नाभ अपने ही नगरकों चला गया। उधर महेन्द्रदेव भी सुन्दर द्वारसे सुशोभित होनेवाली द्वारकापुरीको गये॥ २०॥ वहाँ जाकर अदृश्य होकर ही इन्द्रदेवने भगवान् श्रीकृष्णसे वज्ननाभका सारा वृत्तान्त कह सुनाया। तब श्रीकृष्ण उनसे बोले--॥ २१॥ 'देव! वासव! मेरे पिताजीका अश्वमेध नामक महान् यज्ञ उपस्थित है। उसके पूर्ण हो जानेपर मैं वजनत्ननाभको अवश्य मार गिराऊँगा॥ २२॥ सत्पुरुषोंके आश्रयदाता प्रभो! उसके नगरमें प्रवेश करनेका क्या उपाय है--यह हम दोनों सोचें; क्योंकि वज्ननाभकी इच्छाके बिना वहाँ वायुका भी प्रवेश नहीं हो सकता' ततो गतो देवराजो वासुदेवेन सत्कृतः। वाजिमेधे च सम्प्राप्ते वसुदेवस्य भारत
verses.wordMeaning: Janamejaya said:—O reverend sir, I wish to listen at length to the history of the high-souled and intelligent Vāsudeva, the foremost of Yadus (1). O foremost of the twice-born, why did Janārddana, without fighting,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Janamejaya said:—O reverend sir, I wish to listen at length to the history of the high-souled and intelligent Vāsudeva, the foremost of Yadus (1). O foremost of the twice-born, why did Janārddana, without fighting,…

verses.sanskrit: एवं भवत्सु युक्तेषु मम चित्तानुवर्तिषु । वर्धमानो ममानर्थो भवद्भिः किमुपेक्षितः ॥ २० ॥
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bhavatsu yukteṣu mama cittānuvartiṣu | vardhamāno mamānartho bhavadbhiḥ kimupekṣitaḥ || 20 ||
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—The high-minded Gārgya was the preceptor of both the Andhaka and Vrishni races. He always observed the vow of celibacy; and although he had a wife he did not know her. While the eternal Gārgya, who was a master of passions, was thus spending his days this brother-in-law described him as impotent before the king (7-8). O king, having been thus dishonored in the city of Ajitanjaya and giving up his desire of being united with his wife out of anger for his brother-in-law, Gārgya engaged in hard penances for obtaining a son. And living on pounded iron for twelve years he worshipped Mahādeva, the holder of trident. For this Rudra conferred on him a boon that he would obtain an all powerful son who would be able to discomfit in battle the descendants of the Vishni and Andhaka races (9–10).
verses.hindi: तस्मिन् यज्ञे वर्तमाने प्रवेशार्थ सुरोत्तमौ। चिन्तयामासतुर्वीरा देवराजाच्युतावुभौ ततन्र यज्ञे वर्तमाने सुनाट्येन नटस्तदा। महर्षीस्तोषयामास भद्रनामेति नामतः त॑ बरेण मुनिश्रेष्ठाश्छन्दयामासुरात्मवत्। स वत्रे तु नटो भद्रो वरं देवेश्वरोपम: देवेन्द्रकृष्णच्छन्देन सरस्वत्या प्रचोदितः। प्रणिपत्य मुनिश्रेष्ठानश्रमेधे समागतान्

verses.science: तस्मिन् यज्ञे वर्तमाने प्रवेशार्थ सुरोत्तमौ। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: एष कृष्ण इति ख्यातो नन्दगोपसुतो व्रजे । वर्धमान इवाम्भोभिर्मूलं नः परिकृन्तति ॥ २१ ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa kṛṣṇa iti khyāto nandagopasuto vraje | vardhamāna ivāmbhobhirmūlaṃ naḥ parikṛntati || 21 ||
verses.translation: The king of Yavanas had no son. Hearing of the boon of having a son conferred upon Gārgya, the foremost of the twice-born by Mahādeva, the king brought him over to his own kingdom. And having consoled him he engaged the milk-women to attend him in their own settlement. Having assumed the guise of a milk-woman, an Apsara, Gopāli by name, conceived that dreadful and undecaying embryo through Gārgya (12-14). Thus by the command of the holder of trident, Gārgya begat on the Apsara, assuming the form of a woman and living by him like a wife, the highly powerful hero Kālayavana. And he was brought up in the inner appartment, like his son, of the king Yavanas who had no issue. O king, after the demise of the lord of Yavanas Kalyavana became king. And being desirous of fighting when he questioned the leading twice-born ones about his antagonist Narada pointed out the heroes of the Vrishnu and Andhaka races (15-17). Krishna, the powerful slayer of Madhu, took no notice of Kālayavana, although he grew up in the midst of the Yavanas because he had heard from Narada the story of his obtaining the boon (18). When the king of Yavanas grew exceedingly powerful, Shaka, Tukhāra Darava, Parava, Tangana, Khasha, Panhava and hundreds of Mlechcha kings, living near Himavan, took shelter under him (19–20). Encircled by those Dasyu kings resembling a swarm of locusts, assuming various dresses and holding various weapons, the king of Yavanas set out for Mathura (21). He agitated the surface of the earth with innumerable horses, elephants, asses, camels and a huge army (22). The path of the sun was covered with the dust raised by the soldiers. By the urine and excreta of the soldiers a river was created (23). And because that river issued from the excreta of the horses and camels it passed by the name of Aswasakrit
verses.hindi: भोज्यो द्विजानां सर्वेषां भवेय॑ं मुनिसत्तमा:। सप्तद्वीपां च पृथिवीं विचरेयमिमामहम् प्रसिद्धाकाशगमनः शबनुवंश्व विशेषतः। अवध्य: सर्वभूतानां स्थावरा ये च जड़मा: पुराणि दानवेन्द्राणामुत्तरांश्व कुरूंस्तथा। भद्राश्वान् केतुमालांश्व॒ कालाग्रद्वीपमेव च पर्वणाषु तु सर्वासु द्वारकां यदुमण्डिताम् । आयाति वरदत्त: स लोकवीरो महानट: ततो हंसान् धार्तराष्ट्रानू देवलोकनिवासिन:  उवाच भगवाउ्छक्रः सान्त्वयित्वा सुरे धर:

verses.sanskrit: अनमात्यस्य शून्यस्य चारान्धस्य ममैव तु । कारणान्नन्दगोपस्य स सुतो गोपितो गृहे ॥ २२ ॥
verses.transliteration: anamātyasya śūnyasya cārāndhasya mamaiva tu | kāraṇānnandagopasya sa suto gopito gṛhe || 22 ||
verses.translation: Hearing of the approach of this huge army Vāsudeva, the leader of the Vrishnis and Andhakas, addressed his kinsmen, saying (25):—"Great is the calamity that has befallen the descendants of the Vrishni and Andhaka races. For this enemy is unslayable by us on account of the boon conferred on him by the holder of the trident (26). I employed all other means as conciliation etc. to win him over. But he wishes for battle worked up with pride (27). 'I am to live here:' this Nārada said to me; I too tell you this (28). The emperor Jarāsandha is not forgiving towards us; and the other kings too, assailed by the Vrishni discus and on account of the distruction of Kansa, have been displeased with us and sought refuge with the Magadha king. Under the protection of Jarāsandha they want to obstruct us: and many kinsmen of the Yādavas have been slain by them. What more we will never acquire prosperity if we live in
verses.hindi: भवन्तो भ्रातरोउस्माक काश्यपा देवपक्षिण:। विमानवाहा देवानां सुकृतीनां तथेव च तत्पश्चात् श्रीकृष्णके द्वारा सत्कार पाकर देवराज इन्द्र चले गये। भारत! जब वसुदेवजीका अश्वमेध यज्ञ प्रापत हुआ (तब उसमें देवराज इन्द्र भी पधारे।) जब वह यज्ञ चालू हुआ, उस समय सुरश्रेष्ठ वीर देवराज इन्द्र और श्रीकृष्ण दोनों वज्रपुरमें प्रवेश करनेके लिये कोई उपाय सोचने लगे॥२५॥ उस यज्ञमें भद्रनामा नामक एक नटने अपने उत्तम नाट्यके द्वारा महर्षियोंको संतुष्ट किया॥ २६॥ तब उन श्रेष्ठ मुनियोंने उसे अपने योग्य वर माँगनेके लिये कहा। तब देवेन्द्र तथा श्रीकृष्णकी इच्छाके अनुसार सरस्वतीसे प्रेरित हो अश्वमेध यज्ञमें पधारे हुए मुनिवरोंकों प्रणाम करके देवेन्द्रतुल्य भद्र

verses.sanskrit: उपेक्षित इव व्याधिः पूर्यमाण इवाम्बुदः । नदन्मेघ इवोष्णान्ते स दुरात्मा विवर्धते ॥ २३ ॥
verses.transliteration: upekṣita iva vyādhiḥ pūryamāṇa ivāmbudaḥ | nadanmegha ivoṣṇānte sa durātmā vivardhate || 23 ||
verses.translation: Saying this and desirous of retreating Keshava sent an envoy to the king of Yavanas. In order to terrorize him (the king of Yavanas) the highly intelligent Mādhava put a highly dreadful black serpent, resembling a collection of collyrium, into a jar and sealed it up. He then sent it to the king of Yavanas through his own emissary. O foremost of Bharatas, having said "Krishna is like a deadly serpent" that emissary showed the jar to Kālayavana. Thereupon understanding that the Yadavas had sent it to terrorize him Kalayavana filled that jar with dreadful ants. Thereat that serpent was eaten up by the innumerable ants having sharp beaks and was reduced to ashes. Thereupon sealing up that jar, Kālayavana sent it with a profuse description to Krishna (29–37). Observing his own expedient baffled Vāsudeva soon left the city of Mathurā and went to Dwarka (33). O king, after that in order to put an end to hostilities, that highly illustrious and powerful hero, Vasudeva settled all the heroes in Dwarkā and having consoled them, set out on foot for Mathurā with only his own arm for his weapon (39-40). Kālayavana was pleased at seeing him and confronted him with rage. The highly powerful Krishna too attracted him of his own accord. In order to get hold of Govinda the lord of Yavanas pursued him, but could not catch that Yogin (41-42).
verses.hindi: नामक नटने इस प्रकार वर माँगा नट बोला--मुनिवरो! मैं समस्त द्विजोंके लिये भोजनीय होऊँ अर्थात् सब द्विज मुझे सादर भोजन करायें अथवा समस्त ब्राह्मण मेरा अन्न भोजन करें। सातों द्वीपोंसे युक्त इस सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वीपर मैं विचरण कर सकूँ। आकाशमें चलने-फिरनेकी उत्कृष्ट शक्ति मुझे प्राप्त हो। मैं विशेष शक्तिशाली रहकर स्थावर-जज्ग्म सभी प्राणियोंके लिये अवध्य होऊँ॥ २९-३० ॥ जो मर गया है, जीवित है अथवा जो भविष्यरूपसे मेरे द्वारा तत्काल उत्पन्न किया गया है, ऐसे लोगोंमेंसे जिस-जिसके वेषसे में कहीं प्रवेश करना चाहूँ, मैं वाद्योसहित ठीक वैसा ही हो जाऊँ! जरा और रोग मुझे छू न सकें। मुझपर ऋषि-मुनि तथा अन्य लोग भी नित्य-निरन्तर संतुष्ट रहें ॥ ३१-३२ ॥ नरेश्वर ! तब ब्राह्मणोंने 'एवमस्तु' कहकर उस नटको अभीष्ट वरदान दे दिया। तबसे वह देवोपम शक्तिशाली नट सातों द्वीपोंवाली पृथ्वीपर विचरण करता रहता है॥ ३३॥ वह दानवेन्द्रोंक नगरोंमें तथा उत्तर-कुरु,

verses.sanskrit: तस्य नाहं गतिं जाने न योगं न पराक्रमम् । नन्दगोपस्य भवने जातस्याद्भुतकर्मणः ॥ २४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya nāhaṃ gatiṃ jāne na yogaṃ na parākramam | nandagopasya bhavane jātasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ || 24 ||
verses.translation: On account of his being successful in the war between gods and demons the former offered a boon to the highly powerful and illustrious king Muchakunda, the son of Māndhāta who prayed for sleep. O king, because he was tired in battle he repeatedly said:—"O gods, I will, with my eyes burning in anger, consume him who will arouse me from my sleep" (43–45). The deities along with their king said "So be it." Having been thus ordered by the gods, that king, worn out with fatigue, first came to the king of mountains. And then entering into a cave he was asleep till he was seen by Krishna. Nārada communicated to Krishna the boon obtained by Muchukunda and his power. And therefore when pursued by his Mlechcha enemy he humbly entered into Muchukunda's cave (46–49). In order to avoid the look of the royal saint Keshava, the foremost of the intelligent, sat near his head (55). Following Vāsudeva, the wicked minded Yavana king entered into the cave and saw that king there. And like an insect falling into fire he kicked that king with his foot for his own destruction (51–52). With the touch of the foot the royal saint Muchukunda awoke and was highly enraged on account of the break of his sleep (53). Thereupon recollecting the boon that was conferred by Indra he looked at the Yavana king with angry eyes. As soon as he was eyed, the king of Yavanas was all ablaze (54). O king, as a lightning consumes a dried tree so the fire, engendered by the energy of Muchukunda's eyes, in no time reduced Kālayavana to ashes (55). Having thus acquired victory by virtue of his own intellect Vāsudeva went to the emperor Muchukunda, who was engaged in sleep for a long time and addressed to him the following most excellent words (56):—"O king, I have heard from Nārada—that thou art asleep for a long time. Thou hast performed a great work for me. May good betide thee. I depart" (57).
verses.hindi: भद्राश्व, केतुमाल तथा कालाग्न द्वीपोंमें घृूमा करता था॥ ३४॥ वह वर पाया हुआ लोकवीर महानट सभी पर्वोपर यादवोंसे अलंकृत द्वारकापुरीमें आया करता था॥ ३५॥ तदनन्तर देवलोकमें निवास करनेवाले हंसोंको जो धृतराष्ट्री एवं कश्यपके वंशज थे, देवराज इन्द्रने बुलवाया और उन्हें सान्त्वना देकर कहा-- 'हंसो! तुम लोकपिता कश्यपजीकी संतति होनेके कारण हमारे भाई हो, देवपक्षी हो तथा देवताओं और पुण्यात्माओंके विमानवाहक हो देवानामस्ति कर्तव्यं कार्य शत्रुवधान्वितम्। तत् कर्तव्यं न मन्त्रश्च भेत्तव्यो व: कथंचन

verses.sanskrit: किं तद्भूतं समुद्भूतं देवापत्यं न विद्महे । अतिदेवैरमानुष्यैः कर्मभिः सोऽनुमीयते ॥ २५ ॥
verses.transliteration: kiṃ tadbhūtaṃ samudbhūtaṃ devāpatyaṃ na vidmahe | atidevairamānuṣyaiḥ karmabhiḥ so'numīyate || 25 ||

verses.sanskrit: पूतना शकुनी बाल्ये शिशुनोत्तानशायिना । स्तनपानेप्सुना पीता प्राणैः सह दुरासदा ॥ २६ ॥
verses.transliteration: pūtanā śakunī bālye śiśunottānaśāyinā | stanapānepsunā pītā prāṇaiḥ saha durāsadā || 26 ||
verses.translation: Krishna said:—"There flourished a king in the Lunar dynasty, by name Yayāti, son of Nahusha. Yadu was his eldest son. He had four other sons Turvasu and others. O lord, know me, as Vāsudeva, the son of Vasudeva born in Yadu's family. For some work I had come to you (60–61). O king, I have heard from Nārada that you fell asleep in the Treta Yuga: and now the Kali has set in. Tell me, what more I can do for you presently (62). O king, you have reduced him to ashes by virtue of the boon conferred on you by the gods whom, fighting for a hundred years, I could not slay
verses.hindi: नेत्रवक्त्रप्रसादश्ष॒कर्तव्यस्तत्र सर्वथा द्वारवत्यां च कृष्णस्य भ्रातुर्मम यवीयस: तावचद्यत्नश्च कर्तव्यः प्रद्ुप्नो यावदात्मवित्। पर्यावर्तेंद् बरारोहां वच्ननाभसुतां विभु: अवध्यास्ते तु देवानां ब्रह्मणो वरदर्पिता:। देवपुत्रेर्ठ हन्तव्या: प्रद्युम्नप्रमुखेर्युधि

verses.sanskrit: यमुनाया ह्रदे नागः कालियो दमितस्तथा । रसातलचरो नीतः क्षणेनादर्शनं ह्रदात् ॥ २७ ॥
verses.transliteration: yamunāyā hrade nāgaḥ kāliyo damitastathā | rasātalacaro nītaḥ kṣaṇenādarśanaṃ hradāt || 27 ||
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Thus accosted by Krishna the king Muchukunda issued out of the cave. And having accomplished his object the intelligent Vāsudeva too followed him (64). Having come out from the mouth of the cave he saw that the earth had been covered with men of short stature and of limited energy, strength and prowess and that his kingdom had been occupied by others (65). Having seen all this and resolved upon practising hard penances the king dismissed Krishna and entered into thickets of the Himalaya (66). Having carried on austerities there he died and repaired to the celestial region acquired by his own good actions (67). verses.hindi: “इस समय देवताओंके सामने शत्रुवध-सम्बन्धी कार्य उपस्थित है, जो हम सबके लिये आवश्यक कर्तव्य है। उस कार्यको तुम्हें पूण करना है और इस गुप्त मनत्रकों किसी तरह फूटने नहीं देना है 'देवताओंकी इस आज्ञाका पालन न करनेपर तुम्हारे ऊपर भयानक दण्ड भी पड़ सकता है। श्रेष्ठ हंसो! तुम्हारी सर्वत्र अप्रतिहत गति है॥ ३९ ॥ “वज्ननाभके श्रेष्ठ नगरमें प्रवेश करना दूसरोंके लिये असम्भव है। तुम वहाँ जाकर अन्तःपुरकी बावड़ियोंमें विचरो, क्योंकि यह कार्य तुम्हारे ही योग्य है॥ ४० ॥ 'त्रजनाभके एक रत्नस्वरूपा कन्या है, जो त्रिलोकीमें अतिशय सुन्दरी है। उसका नाम प्रभावती है। वह ऐसी प्रतीत होती है मानो चन्द्रमाकी आभा ही उसकी प्रभा बनकर प्रकाशित हो रही हो “उसकी माताने गिरिराज हिमवान्की पुत्री महादेवी उमासे मिले हुए वरदानके प्रभावसे उस सुन्दर मुखवाली कन्याको प्राप्त किया है, ऐसा हमारे सुननेमें आया है

verses.sanskrit: नन्दगोपसुतो योगं कृत्वा स पुनरुत्थितः । चेनुकस्तालशिखरात् पातितो जीवितं विना ॥ २८ ॥
verses.transliteration: nandagopasuto yogaṃ kṛtvā sa punarutthitaḥ | cenukastālaśikharāt pātito jīvitaṃ vinā || 28 ||

verses.sanskrit: प्रलम्बं यं मृधे देवा न शेकुरतिवर्तितुम् । बालेन मुष्टिनैकेन स हतः प्राकृतो यथा ॥ २९ ॥
verses.transliteration: pralambaṃ yaṃ mṛdhe devā na śekurativartitum | bālena muṣṭinaikena sa hataḥ prākṛto yathā || 29 ||
verses.hindi: “हंसो! अपने बन्धुओंद्वारा सुरक्षित हुई वह सुन्दरी कन्या प्रभावती स्वयंवरा है। स्वयंवरमें अपनी इच्छाके अनुसार पतिका वरण करेगी॥ ४३॥ “अतः तुमलोग प्रभावतीके सम्मुख महात्मा प्रद्युम्अके उत्तम कुल, सुन्दर रूप, अच्छे शील-स्वभाव तथा नयी अबस्थाके श्रेष्ठ गुणोंका बखान करो ॥ ४४॥ “ब्रजनाभकी वह सती-साध्वी पुत्री जब प्रद्ुम्नके प्रति हृदयसे अनुरक्त हो जाय, तब एकाग्रचित्त होकर उसका संदेश तुम्हें प्रद्युव्के पास पहुँचाना चाहिए; फिर वहाँसे तुमलोग उस संदेशका उत्तर लाया करो। साथ ही, अपनी बुद्धिसे भी सोच-विचारकर अवसरके अनुरूप कार्य करके मेरा हित-साधन करो “तुम्हें वहाँ अपने नेत्रों और मुखके द्वारा सब प्रकारसे प्रसन्नता प्रकट करनी चाहिए। महात्मा प्रद्युम्नके गुणोंको उसी-उसी प्रकारसे बताना चाहिए, जिससे प्रभावतीका मन उनमें पूर्णतः अनुरक्त हो जाय॥४७-४८॥ “इन

verses.transliteration: vāsavasyotsavaṃ bhaṅaktvā varṣaṃ vāsavaroṣajam | nirjitya gogṛhārthāya dhṛto govardhano giriḥ || 30 ||

verses.sanskrit: हतस्त्वरिष्टो बलवान् निःशृङ्गश्च कृतो व्रजे । अबालो बाल्यमास्थाय रमते शिशुलीलया ॥ ३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: hatastvariṣṭo balavān niḥśṛṅgaśca kṛto vraje | abālo bālyamāsthāya ramate śiśulīlayā || 31 ||

verses.sanskrit: प्रबन्धः कर्मणामेव तस्य गोव्रजवासिनः । सन्निकृष्टं भयं चैव केशिनो मम च धुवम् ॥ ३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabandhaḥ karmaṇāmeva tasya govrajavāsinaḥ | sannikṛṣṭaṃ bhayaṃ caiva keśino mama ca dhuvam || 32 ||

verses.sanskrit: भूतपूर्वश्च मे मृत्युः सततं पूर्वदैहिकः । युद्धाकाङ्क्षी च स यथा तिष्ठतीह ममाग्रतः ॥ ३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhūtapūrvaśca me mṛtyuḥ satataṃ pūrvadaihikaḥ | yuddhākāṅkṣī ca sa yathā tiṣṭhatīha mamāgrataḥ || 33 ||

verses.sanskrit: क्व च गोपत्वमशुभं मानुष्यं मृत्युदुर्बलम् । क्व च देवप्रभावेण क्रीडितव्यं व्रजे मम ॥ ३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: kva ca gopatvamaśubhaṃ mānuṣyaṃ mṛtyudurbalam | kva ca devaprabhāveṇa krīḍitavyaṃ vraje mama || 34 ||

verses.sanskrit: अहो नीचेन वपुषाच्छादयित्वाऽऽत्मनो वपुः । कोऽप्येष रमते देवः श्मशानस्य इवानलः ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: aho nīcena vapuṣācchādayitvā''tmano vapuḥ | ko'pyeṣa ramate devaḥ śmaśānasya ivānalaḥ || 35 ||

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयते हि पुरा विष्णुः सुराणां कारणान्तरे । वामनेन तु रूपेण जहार पृथिवीमिमाम् ॥ ३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrūyate hi purā viṣṇuḥ surāṇāṃ kāraṇāntare | vāmanena tu rūpeṇa jahāra pṛthivīmimām || 36 ||

Having brought about the destruction of his own enemy through this expedient, the pious-souled and intelligent Vāsudeva went to his soldiers and set out with that army consisting of cars, elephants and horses, who had their master slain (68–69). verses.explanation: सुनाकर अपनी श्रेष्ठ सखी वज्जनाभकुमारी प्रभावतीके मनमें पूर्ण विश्वास पैदा कर लिया। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: सुनाकर अपनी श्रेष्ठ सखी वज्जनाभकुमारी प्रभावतीके मनमें पूर्ण विश्वास पैदा कर लिया। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: चालितो गुरुपुत्रेण भार्गवोऽङ्गिरसेन वै । प्रविश्य दार्दुरीं मायामनावृष्टिं चकार ह ॥ ३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: cālito guruputreṇa bhārgavo'ṅgirasena vai | praviśya dārdurīṃ māyāmanāvṛṣṭiṃ cakāra ha || 39 ||

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तः शाश्वतो देवः सहस्रशिरसोऽव्ययः । वाराहं रूपमास्थाय प्रोज्जहारार्णवान्मही म् ॥ ४० ॥
verses.transliteration: anantaḥ śāśvato devaḥ sahasraśiraso'vyayaḥ | vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya projjahārārṇavānmahī m || 40 ||

verses.sanskrit: अमृते निर्मिते पूर्वं विष्णुः स्त्रीरूपमास्थितः । सुराणामसुराणां च युद्धं चक्रे सुदारुणम् ॥ ४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: amṛte nirmite pūrvaṃ viṣṇuḥ strīrūpamāsthitaḥ | surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca yuddhaṃ cakre sudāruṇam || 41 ||

verses.sanskrit: अमृतार्थे पुरा चापि देवदैत्यसमागमे । दधार मन्दरं विष्णुरकूपार इति श्रुतिः ॥ ४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: amṛtārthe purā cāpi devadaityasamāgame | dadhāra mandaraṃ viṣṇurakūpāra iti śrutiḥ || 42 ||
verses.hindi: मनसे जिन-जिन उत्तम गुणोंकी कल्पना करोगी अथवा तीनों लोकोंमें जो-जो श्रेष्ठ गुण वाञ्छनीय हैं, वे सब- के-सब प्रद्युम्ममें वर्तमान हैं॥ २६ ॥ ' वे कान्तिमें अग्निके समान, क्षमामें पृथ्वीके तुल्य, तेजमें सूर्यके सदृश तथा गम्भीरतामें सागरके समान हैं'। यह सुनकर भामिनी प्रभावतीने शुचिमुखीसे इस प्रकार कहा तथा अपने पिताके मुखसे कई बार सुना है कि भगवान् विष्णु इस समय मनुष्यलोकमें अवतीर्ण होकर विराज रहे हैं॥ २८ ॥ पापरहित मानिनि! शाखानगरके प्रदेशोंमें जो असुर निवास करते हैं, उन्हें मेरे पिता दानवराज वज्जनाभ भगवान् विष्णुके विषयमें इस प्रकार संदेश दिया करते हैं--“विष्णु हैत्योंके शत्रुके रूपमें प्रसिद्ध हैं, अतः उन्हें सदाके लिये त्याग देना चाहिए। उन्होंने अपने तेजस्वी चक्र, शार्ड्घनुष तथा कौमोदकी गदाके द्वारा हैत्योंक बहुत-से कुल दग्ध कर डाले हैं !। पवित्र मुसकानवाली हंसी! प्रायः सभी स्त्रियोंका ऐसा ही मनोरथ होता है कि मेरा पतिकुल पितृकुलसे श्रेष्ठ हो। यदि प्रद्युम्नके यहाँ आनेके लिये कोई उपाय हो सके
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Thus accosted by Krishna the king Muchukunda issued out of the cave. And having accomplished his object the intelligent Vāsudeva too followed him (64). Having come out from the mouth of the cave he saw that the earth had been covered with men of short stature and of limited energy, strength and prowess and that his kingdom had been occupied by others (65). Having seen all this and resolved upon practising hard penances the king dismissed Krishna and entered into thickets of the Himalaya (66). Having carried on austerities there he died and repaired to the celestial region acquired by his own good actions (67). Having brought about the destruction of his own enemy through this expedient, the pious-souled and intelligent Vāsudeva went to his soldiers and set out with that army consisting of cars, elephants and horses, who had their master slain (68–69). Having thus attained to the consummate accomplishment of his object and conferred upon the king Ugrasena that four-fold army Janārddana embellished the city of Dwarkā with wealth acquired by him (70).
verses.explanation: मनसे जिन-जिन उत्तम गुणोंकी कल्पना करोगी अथवा तीनों लोकोंमें जो-जो श्रेष्ठ गुण वाञ्छनीय हैं, वे सब- के-सब प्रद्युम्ममें वर्तमान हैं॥ २६ ॥ ' वे कान्तिमें अग्नि…। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: मनसे जिन-जिन उत्तम गुणोंकी कल्पना करोगी अथवा तीनों लोकोंमें जो-जो श्रेष्ठ गुण वाञ्छनीय हैं, वे सब- के-सब प्रद्युम्ममें वर्तमान हैं॥ २६ ॥ ' वे कान्तिमें अग्नि…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वपुर्वामनमास्थाय नन्दनीयं पुरा बलेः । त्रिभिः क्रमैस्तु त्रींल्लोकाञ्जहार त्रिदिवालयम् ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: vapurvāmanamāsthāya nandanīyaṃ purā baleḥ | tribhiḥ kramaistu trīṃllokāñjahāra tridivālayam || 43 ||

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्धा तेजसो भागं कृत्वा दाशरथे गृहे । स एव रामसंज्ञो वै रावणं व्यनशत् तदा ॥ ४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: caturdhā tejaso bhāgaṃ kṛtvā dāśarathe gṛhe | sa eva rāmasaṃjño vai rāvaṇaṃ vyanaśat tadā || 44 ||
verses.hindi: तो यह मुझपर तुम्हारा महान् अनुग्रह होगा और मेरा कुल पवित्र हो जायगा। पवित्र वार्ता करनेवाली हंसी! मैंने तुमसे कार्यसिद्धिका उपाय पूछा है। वह उपाय तुम यथा च तेन निहतो बलवान् कालशम्बरः  हृदि मे वर्तते नित्य॑ प्रद्युस्ओ खलु सत्तमे तथा चैव करिष्यामि यथैष्यति तवान्तिकम्। साक्षात्कामेन सुश्रोणि भविष्यति सकामिनी मम त्वं तत्र मे देवि हितं सम्यक् प्रपत्स्यसे । इत्युक्ता सा तथा चक्रे यत्तत् सा तामथाब्रवीतू

Having come out from the mouth of the cave he saw that the earth had been covered with men of short stature and of limited energy, strength and prowess and that his kingdom had been occupied by others (65). Having seen all this and resolved upon practising hard penances the king dismissed Krishna and entered into thickets of the Himalaya (66). Having carried on austerities there he died and repaired to the celestial region acquired by his own good actions (67). Having brought about the destruction of his own enemy through this expedient, the pious-souled and intelligent Vāsudeva went to his soldiers and set out with that army consisting of cars, elephants and horses, who had their master slain (68–69). Having thus attained to the consummate accomplishment of his object and conferred upon the king Ugrasena that four-fold army Janārddana embellished the city of Dwarkā with wealth acquired by him (70).
verses.explanation: तो यह मुझपर तुम्हारा महान् अनुग्रह होगा और मेरा कुल पवित्र हो जायगा। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: तो यह मुझपर तुम्हारा महान् अनुग्रह होगा और मेरा कुल पवित्र हो जायगा। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमेव निकृत्या वै तत्तद्रूपमुपागतः । साधयत्यात्मनः कार्यं सुराणामर्थसिद्धये ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: evameva nikṛtyā vai tattadrūpamupāgataḥ | sādhayatyātmanaḥ kāryaṃ surāṇāmarthasiddhaye || 45 ||

verses.sanskrit: तदेव नूनं विष्णुर्वा शक्रो वा मरुतां पतिः । मत्साधनेच्छया प्राप्तो नारदो मां यदुक्तवान् ॥ ४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadeva nūnaṃ viṣṇurvā śakro vā marutāṃ patiḥ | matsādhanecchayā prāpto nārado māṃ yaduktavān || 46 ||

verses.sanskrit: अत्र मे शङ्कते बुद्धिर्वसुदेवं प्रति ध्रुवा । अस्य बुद्धिविशेषेण वयं कातरतां गताः ॥ ४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: atra me śaṅkate buddhirvasudevaṃ prati dhruvā | asya buddhiviśeṣeṇa vayaṃ kātaratāṃ gatāḥ || 47 ||
verses.hindi: पूछा--'शुचिमुखि ! प्रभावतीने बताया है कि तुम कथा कहनेमें बड़ी चतुर हो। अत: उत्तम पक्षिणि! तुम कोई कथा कहो, क्योंकि योग्यतामें बड़ी हो। बताओ, संसारमें तुमने कौन-सी आश्चर्यकी बात देखी है? अनिन्दिते! जिसे दूसरोंने पहले कभी नहीं देखा हो, ऐसी कोई योग्य या अयोग्य आश्चर्यकी बात तुमने देखी हो तो बताओ '। नरेशशिरोमणे ! तब हंसीने महातेजस्वी दानवराज वज्जननाभको सम्बोधित करके कहा--सुनिये--' दानवगश्रेष्ठ ! मैंने मेरुगिरिके पार्थभागमें साध्वी मनस्विनी शाण्डिलीको देखा है, जो वहाँ आश्चर्यजनक कार्य करती हैं॥४१--४६॥ “समस्त प्राणियोंके हितमें तत्पर रहनेवाली कौशल्या सुमनाका भी किसी प्रकार दर्शन किया है, जो शैलपुत्री श्रेष्ठ शाण्डिलीकी शुभ सखी हैं॥ ४७॥ “एक नटको भी मैंने देखा है, जिसे मुनियोंने अभीष्ट वर दे रखा है। वह शुभलक्षण नट इच्छानुसार रूप धारण करनेवाला, भोजनीय तथा त्रिभुवनमें सबको सदा ही प्रिय है कुरून् यात्युत्तरान् वीर कालाग्रद्ठीपमेव च । भद्गाश्वान केतुमालां श्व द्वीपानन्यांस्तथानघ

Having come out from the mouth of the cave he saw that the earth had been covered with men of short stature and of limited energy, strength and prowess and that his kingdom had been occupied by others (65). Having seen all this and resolved upon practising hard penances the king dismissed Krishna and entered into thickets of the Himalaya (66). Having thus attained to the consummate accomplishment of his object and conferred upon the king Ugrasena that four-fold army Janārddana embellished the city of Dwarkā with wealth acquired by him (70).

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि खट्वाङ्गवने नारदेन समागतः । द्वितीयं स हि मां विप्रः पुनरेवाब्रवीद् वचः ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ hi khaṭvāṅgavane nāradena samāgataḥ | dvitīyaṃ sa hi māṃ vipraḥ punarevābravīd vacaḥ || 48 ||
verses.hindi: देवगन्धर्वगेयानि नृत्यानि विविधानि च। स वेत्ति देवान् नृत्येन विस्मापयति सर्वथा गुणवन्तं जन॑ श्रुत्वा गुणकार्य: स सर्वथा ते हंसा वज्जनाभेन कार्यहेतोर्विसर्जिता:। देवेन्द्रायाथ कृष्णाय शशंसुः सर्वमेव तत्
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Thus accosted by Krishna the king Muchukunda issued out of the cave. And having accomplished his object the intelligent Vāsudeva too followed him (64). Having come out from the mouth of the cave he saw that the earth had been covered with men of short stature and of limited energy, strength and prowess and that his kingdom had been occupied by others (65). Having seen all this and resolved upon practising hard penances the king dismissed Krishna and entered into thickets of the Himalaya (66). Having carried on austerities there he died and repaired to the celestial region acquired by his own good actions (67). Having brought about the destruction of his own enemy through this expedient, the pious-souled and intelligent Vāsudeva went to his soldiers and set out with that army consisting of cars, elephants and horses, who had their master slain (68–69). Having thus attained to the consummate accomplishment of his object and conferred upon the king Ugrasena that four-fold army Janārddana embellished the city of Dwarkā with wealth acquired by him (70).

verses.science: देवगन्धर्वगेयानि नृत्यानि विविधानि च। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वया हि कृतो यत्नः कंस गर्भकृते महान् । वसुदेवेन ते रात्रौ तत्कर्म विफलीकृतम् ॥ ४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: yastvayā hi kṛto yatnaḥ kaṃsa garbhakṛte mahān | vasudevena te rātrau tatkarma viphalīkṛtam || 49 ||

verses.sanskrit: दारिका या त्वया रात्रौ शिलायां कंस पातिता । तां यशोदासुतां विद्धि कृष्णं च वसुदेवजम् ॥ ५० ॥
verses.transliteration: dārikā yā tvayā rātrau śilāyāṃ kaṃsa pātitā | tāṃ yaśodāsutāṃ viddhi kṛṣṇaṃ ca vasudevajam || 50 ||
verses.hindi: भाँतिके नृत्योंको भी जानता है। वह अपने नृत्योंसे देवताओंको भी सर्वथा आश्चर्यचकित कर देता है' वज्जननाभ बोला--हंसी ! थोड़े ही दिन हुए मैंने भी महात्मा, सिद्धों और चारणोंके मुखसे यह नटविषयक समाचार विस्तारपूर्वक सुना है ॥ ५१॥ पक्षिनन्दिनि! मुझे भी उस वरप्राप्त नटको देखनेके लिये सर्वथा उत्कण्ठा हो रही है; परंतु मालूम होता है, मेरी प्रसिद्धि उसके कानोंतक नहीं गयी है (इसीलिये वह अबतक यहाँ नहीं आ सका है) हंसीने कहा--हैत्यप्रवर ! वह नट सातों द्वीपोंमें विचरता है और गुणवान् पुरुषका नाम सुनकर उसके पास जाता है। उसके कार्य सर्वथा गुणयुक्त होते हैं। वीर महासुर! यदि वह तुम्हारे श्रेष्ठ एवं विस्तृत
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Thus accosted by Krishna the king Muchukunda issued out of the cave. And having accomplished his object the intelligent Vāsudeva too followed him (64). Having come out from the mouth of the cave he saw that the earth had been covered with men of short stature and of limited energy, strength and prowess and that his kingdom had been occupied by others (65). Having seen all this and resolved upon practising hard penances the king dismissed Krishna and entered into thickets of the Himalaya (66). Having carried on austerities there he died and repaired to the celestial region acquired by his own good actions (67). Having brought about the destruction of his own enemy through this expedient, the pious-souled and intelligent Vāsudeva went to his soldiers and set out with that army consisting of cars, elephants and horses, who had their master slain (68–69). Having thus attained to the consummate accomplishment of his object and conferred upon the king Ugrasena that four-fold army Janārddana embellished the city of Dwarkā with wealth acquired by him (70).
verses.explanation: भाँतिके नृत्योंको भी जानता है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: भाँतिके नृत्योंको भी जानता है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ व्यावर्तितावेतौ गर्भौ तव वधाय वै । वसुदेवेन सन्धाय मित्ररूपेण शत्रुणा ॥ ५१ ॥
verses.transliteration: rātrau vyāvartitāvetau garbhau tava vadhāya vai | vasudevena sandhāya mitrarūpeṇa śatruṇā || 51 ||

verses.sanskrit: सा तु कन्या यशोदाया विन्ध्ये पर्वतसत्तमे । हत्वा शुम्भनिशुम्भौ द्वौ दानवौ नगचारिणौ ॥ ५२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sā tu kanyā yaśodāyā vindhye parvatasattame | hatvā śumbhaniśumbhau dvau dānavau nagacāriṇau || 52 ||
verses.hindi: हुए रमणीय विमानपर आरूढ़ हो महातेजस्वी देवताओंके कार्यकी सिद्धिके लिये वहाँ गये वे सभी पुरुष रूपमें एक-एक पुरुषके अनुरूप स्त्रियोंकी भी समानता करते थे॥६२॥ वे सब-के- सब वज्रपुरके उत्तम शाखानगर सुपुरमें, जो दानवोंसे जम्मुर्दानवसंकीर्ण सुपुरं नाम नामतः॥ ६३  भरा-पूरा था, गये

verses.sanskrit: कृताभिषेका वरदा भूतसङ्घनिषेविता । अर्च्यते दस्युभिर्घोरैर्महाबलिपशुप्रिया ॥ ५३ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtābhiṣekā varadā bhūtasaṅghaniṣevitā | arcyate dasyubhirghorairmahābalipaśupriyā || 53 ||

verses.sanskrit: सुरापिशितपूर्णाभ्यां कुम्भाभ्यामुपशोभिता । मयूराङ्गदचित्रैश्च बर्हभारैर्विभूषिता ॥ ५४ ॥
verses.transliteration: surāpiśitapūrṇābhyāṃ kumbhābhyāmupaśobhitā | mayūrāṅgadacitraiśca barhabhārairvibhūṣitā || 54 ||

verses.sanskrit: हृष्टकुक्कुटसन्नादं वनं वायसनादितम् । मृगसङ्घैश्च सम्पूर्णमविरुद्धैश्च पक्षिभिः ॥ ५५ ॥
verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭakukkuṭasannādaṃ vanaṃ vāyasanāditam | mṛgasaṅghaiśca sampūrṇamaviruddhaiśca pakṣibhiḥ || 55 ||

verses.sanskrit: सिंहव्याघ्रवराहाणां नादेन प्रतिनादितम् । वृक्षगम्भीरनिबिडं कान्तारैः सर्वतो वृतम् ॥ ५६ ॥
verses.transliteration: siṃhavyāghravarāhāṇāṃ nādena pratināditam | vṛkṣagambhīranibiḍaṃ kāntāraiḥ sarvato vṛtam || 56 ||
verses.hindi: पृथगर्थषु दत्तेषु लोकैस्ते तुष्टुवुर्नटा:। असुरांश्व मुनींश्रेव गोत्रैरभिजनैरपि आवासश्च ततो दत्त: सुकृतो विश्वकर्मणा। एष्टव्यं यच्च तत् सर्व दत्तं शतगुणोत्तरम् अथ कालोत्सवं चक्रे वज्ननाभो महासुरः । कारयामास रम्यं च चमूवार्टं प्रहष्टवान् कार्यार्थ भीमकर्माणो नृत्यार्थमुपचक्रमुः

Having seen all this and resolved upon practising hard penances the king dismissed Krishna and entered into thickets of the Himalaya (66). Having carried on austerities there he died and repaired to the celestial region acquired by his own good actions (67). verses.science: पृथगर्थषु दत्तेषु लोकैस्ते तुष्टुवुर्नटा:। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यभृङ्गारुचमरैरादर्शैरुपशोभितम् । देवतूर्यनिनादैश्च शतशः प्रतिनादितम् ॥ ५७ ॥
verses.transliteration: divyabhṛṅgārucamarairādarśairupaśobhitam | devatūryaninādaiśca śataśaḥ pratināditam || 57 ||

verses.sanskrit: स्थानं तस्या नगे विन्ध्ये निर्मितं स्वेन तेजसा । रिपूणां त्रासजननी नित्यं तत्र मनोरमे ॥ ५८ ॥
verses.transliteration: sthānaṃ tasyā nage vindhye nirmitaṃ svena tejasā | ripūṇāṃ trāsajananī nityaṃ tatra manorame || 58 ||

verses.sanskrit: वसते परमप्रीता देवतैरपि पूजिता । यस्त्वयं नन्दगोपस्य कृष्ण इत्युच्यते सुतः ॥ ५९ ॥
verses.transliteration: vasate paramaprītā devatairapi pūjitā | yastvayaṃ nandagopasya kṛṣṇa ityucyate sutaḥ || 59 ||

verses.sanskrit: अत्र मे नारदः प्राह सुमहत्कर्मकारणम् । द्वितीयो वसुदेवाद् वै वासुदेवो भविष्यति ॥ ६० ॥
verses.transliteration: atra me nāradaḥ prāha sumahatkarmakāraṇam | dvitīyo vasudevād vai vāsudevo bhaviṣyati || 60 ||

verses.sanskrit: स हि ते सहजो मृत्युर्बान्धवश्च भविष्यति । स एव वासुदेवो वै वसुदेवसुतो बली । बान्धवो धर्मतो मह्यं हृदयेनान्तको रिपुः ॥ ६१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa hi te sahajo mṛtyurbāndhavaśca bhaviṣyati | sa eva vāsudevo vai vasudevasuto balī | bāndhavo dharmato mahyaṃ hṛdayenāntako ripuḥ || 61 ||
verses.hindi: तीनों बीच-बीचमें) खड़े हो-होकर असुरोंको संतोष प्रदान करते थे॥ २५॥ कार्यवश नटभावको प्राप्त हुए के अन्तमें रुक्मिणीनन्दन प्रद्यम्नने गड़ावतरणसे सम्बन्ध रखनेवाले श्लोकका उत्तम अभिनयके साथ पाठ किया॥ २७॥ तत्पश्चात् कुबेरलोकसम्बन्धी रम्भाभिसार नामक नाटकका वे सब लोग अभिनय करने लगे। शूर नामक यादव रावणरूपसे उपस्थित हुए। मनोवती नामक वाराड़नाने रम्भाका वेष धारण किया॥ २८ ॥ प्रद्युम्न ही नलकूबर बने। साम्ब उनके विदूषक बनकर तदनुरूप कार्य करने लगे। यादवकुमारोंने मायासे वहाँ कैलासको ही मूर्तिमान् कर दिया॥ २९ ॥ क्रोधमें भरे हुए नलकूबरने जिस प्रकार दुरात्मा रावणको शाप दिया और जिस तरह रम्भाको सान्त्वना प्रदान की, इस प्रकरणका, जिसके द्वारा सर्वज्ञ महात्मा नारदमुनिकी कीर्तिपर प्रकाश पड़ता है, उन वीर यादवकुमारोंने नाटकद्दारा प्रदर्शन किया ॥ ३०- ३१॥ अत्यन्त तेजस्वी भीमवंशियोंके पाद-विक्षेपपूर्वक किये गये नृत्य और अभिनयसे संतुष्ट हुए दानववीर उनकी भूरि-भूरि प्रशंसा करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: नेत्रे तुदति तस्यैव वक्त्रेणामिषगृद्धिना ॥ ६२ ॥
verses.transliteration: netre tudati tasyaiva vaktreṇāmiṣagṛddhinā || 62 ||
verses.hindi: २. यहाँ नान्दि शब्द एक वाचद्यविशेषका वाचक है। यह चमड़ेके थैलेके समान होता है और उसके मुखपर शिववाहन नन्‍्दीके मुखकी आकृति बनी रहती है, इसीलिये उसे नानन्‍दी कहते हैं  कुछ लोगोंके मतमें बारह पटहों (नगाड़ों)-की ध्वनिको ही नान्दि कहते हैं। कहीं-कहीं नान्दिकी जगह नान्दी पाठ है। देवताओं और द्विजों आदिकी शुभाशंसा करनेवाली जो पद्य अथवा गीतमयी वाक्यावली है, जो नाटकके पूर्व रंगमें प्रार्थनाके रूपमें पढ़ी जाती है, उसका नाम नान्दी है। उस नान्दीके अन्तमें सूत्रधार नाटककी प्रस्तावना करता है। विमानानि विचित्राणि रथांश्वाकाशगामिन: । गजानाकाशगांश्वेव दिव्यनागकुलोद्धवान् चिन्तामणीनुदारांश्चव चिन्तिते सर्वकामदान्। प्रेक्षासु तासु बह्लीषु ददनतो दानवास्तथा गतास्मि द्वारकां रम्यां भेमगुप्तामनिन्दिते

verses.sanskrit: वसुदेवस्तथैवायं सपुत्रज्ञातिबान्धवः । छिनत्ति मम मूलानि भुङ्क्ते च मम पार्श्वतः ॥ ६३ ॥
verses.transliteration: vasudevastathaivāyaṃ saputrajñātibāndhavaḥ | chinatti mama mūlāni bhuṅkte ca mama pārśvataḥ || 63 ||

verses.sanskrit: भ्रूणहत्यापि सन्तार्या गोवधः स्त्रीवधोऽपि वा । न कृतघ्नस्य लोकोऽस्ति बान्धवस्य विशेषतः ॥ ६४ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhrūṇahatyāpi santāryā govadhaḥ strīvadho'pi vā | na kṛtaghnasya loko'sti bāndhavasya viśeṣataḥ || 64 ||
verses.hindi: तस्मिन् कृते संविधाने काममानयितुं ययौ। प्रभावतीमनुज्ञाप्प हंसी वायुसमा गतौ नटवेषधरं काम गत्वोवाच शुचिस्मिता। अद्य भूत: स भगवन् समयो वर्तते निशि वर्तुलाकार मणिसे विद्ध एवं वैदूर्यमणिसे विभूषित हार दिये॥ ३३॥ विचित्र विमान, आकाशगामी रथ और दिव्य नागोंके कुलमें उत्पन्न हुए आकाशचारी हाथी भी प्रदान किये॥ ३४॥ भरतनन्दन ! उन दानवोंने यादवकुमारोंको सुगन्धित पदार्थ तथा चिन्तन करनेमात्रसे सम्पूर्ण कामनाओंको
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Thus accosted by Krishna the king Muchukunda issued out of the cave. And having accomplished his object the intelligent Vāsudeva too followed him (64). Having come out from the mouth of the cave he saw that the earth had been covered with men of short stature and of limited energy, strength and prowess and that his kingdom had been occupied by others (65). Having seen all this and resolved upon practising hard penances the king dismissed Krishna and entered into thickets of the Himalaya (66). Having carried on austerities there he died and repaired to the celestial region acquired by his own good actions (67). Having brought about the destruction of his own enemy through this expedient, the pious-souled and intelligent Vāsudeva went to his soldiers and set out with that army consisting of cars, elephants and horses, who had their master slain (68–69). Having thus attained to the consummate accomplishment of his object and conferred upon the king Ugrasena that four-fold army Janārddana embellished the city of Dwarkā with wealth acquired by him (70).
verses.explanation: तस्मिन् कृते संविधाने काममानयितुं ययौ। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: तस्मिन् कृते संविधाने काममानयितुं ययौ। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: पतितानुगतं मार्गं निषेवत्यचिरेण सः । यः कृतघ्नोऽनुबन्धेन प्रीतिं वहति दारुणाम् ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.transliteration: patitānugataṃ mārgaṃ niṣevatyacireṇa saḥ | yaḥ kṛtaghno'nubandhena prītiṃ vahati dāruṇām || 65 ||
verses.hindi: नरेश्वर! वहाँ बहुत बार नाटक देखनेको अवसर मिले। उन सभी अवसरोंपर दानवों तथा प्रधान-प्रधान दानवोंकी स्त्रियोंने इतने उपहार दिये कि वे सब-के-सब प्रभावतीकी सखी हंसीने प्रभावतीसे कहा-- ' अनिन्दिते ! मैं यादवोंद्वारा सुरक्षित रमणीय द्वारकापुरीमें गयी थी “चारुलोचने! वहाँ एकान्तमें मैंने प्रद्युम्नने भेंट की। शुचिस्मिते ! तुम्हारी प्रद्युम्नके प्रति जो भक्ति है, उसकी भी मैंने उनसे चर्चा कौ॥३९॥ 'कमललोचने! मेरी बात सुनकर उन्हें बड़ी प्रसन्नता हुई और उन्होंने आज ही प्रदोषकालमें तुमसे मिलनेका समय निश्चित किया है॥४०॥ 'अत: सुश्रोणि! आज ही तुम्हारी अपने प्राणवल्लभसे भेंट होगी; क्योंकि यदुकुलमें उत्पन्न हुए पुरुष अपने प्रेमीजनोंके प्रति कोई मिथ्या संदेश नहीं देते हैं'॥ ४१॥ यह सुनकर प्रभावतीको बड़ा हर्ष हुआ। वह उस हंसीसे इस प्रकार बोली--'सुन्दरि ! तुम पहले भी मेरे घरमें रह चुकी हो। उसी तरह आज भी मेरे ही महलमें शयन करो॥ ४२॥ “विहड्मे! आज इस

verses.sanskrit: नरकाध्युषितः पन्था गन्तव्यस्तेन दारुणः । अपापे पापहृदयो यः पापमनुतिष्ठति ॥ ६६ ॥
verses.transliteration: narakādhyuṣitaḥ panthā gantavyastena dāruṇaḥ | apāpe pāpahṛdayo yaḥ pāpamanutiṣṭhati || 66 ||
verses.hindi: घरमें तुम्हारे साथ रहकर ही मैं केशवकुमार प्रद्युम्नका दर्शन करना चाहती हूँ। तुम्हारे साथ होनेसे मैं निर्भय रहूँगी'॥ ४३॥ तब आकाशचारिणी हंसीने अपनी कमललोचना सखी प्रभावतीसे कहा--'बहुत अच्छा, आज यहीं सोकँगी।' फिर वह प्रभावतीकी अट्टालिकापर आरूढ़ हुई॥ ४४ ॥ विश्वकर्माके बनाये हुए प्रासादपृष्ठमें प्रभावतीने शीघ्र ही प्रद्युम्के आगमनके योग्य सजावट कर दी॥ ४५॥ वह सजावट हो जानेपर वायुके समान तीव्र वेगसे चलनेवाली हंसी प्रभावतीसे पूछकर प्रद्युश्नको ले आनेके लिये गयी ॥ ४६ ॥ पवित्र मुसकानवाली वह हंसी नटवेषधारी प्रद्युम्नके पास जाकर बोली--' भगवन् ! आपने पहलेसे जो समय निश्चित कर रखा है, वह आजकी ही रातमें आ रहा है'

verses.sanskrit: अहं वा स्वजनः श्लाघ्यः स वा श्लाघ्यतरः सुतः । नियमैर्गुणवृत्तेन त्वया बान्धवकाम्यया ॥ ६७ ॥
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ vā svajanaḥ ślāghyaḥ sa vā ślāghyataraḥ sutaḥ | niyamairguṇavṛttena tvayā bāndhavakāmyayā || 67 ||
verses.hindi: तथेति प्राह तां कामः सा निवृत्ताथ पक्षिणी। निलिल्ये तत्र माल्ये तु भूत्वा मधुकरस्तदा। प्रभावत्या नीयमाने विदितार्थ: प्रतापवान् प्रवेशितं च तन्माल्यं स्त्रीभिर्मधुकरायुतम् । उपनीतं प्रभावत्य स्त्रीभिस्तद् भ्रमरावृतम् भ्रमरास्ते ययु: सौम्य संध्याकाले ह्यपस्थिते कर्णोत्पले प्रभावत्या निलिल्ये शनकैरिव

verses.sanskrit: हस्तिनां कलहे घोरे वधमृच्छन्ति वीरुधः । युद्धव्युपरमे ते तु सहाश्नन्ति महावने ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.transliteration: hastināṃ kalahe ghore vadhamṛcchanti vīrudhaḥ | yuddhavyuparame te tu sahāśnanti mahāvane || 68 ||
verses.hindi: औत्सुक्यं हदि चातीव को5यं व्याधिरनौषध: दधद् द्विगुणमौत्सुक्यमसौ पूर्णनिशाकरः। नवोदिता: शीतरश्मि: सख्यं हरति च प्रिय: न दृष्टपूर्वो हि मया श्रुतमात्रेण काड्क्षितः । अहो धूमयतेउड्रानि स्त्रीस्वभावस्थ धिक् खलु तब प्रद्युम्नने उससे कहा--'बहुत अच्छा' उनका यह उत्तर सुनकर पक्षिणी लौट गयी। महलमें लौटकर हंसीने प्रभावतीसे कहा--'विशाललोचने ! धीरज धारण करो। वे रुक्मिणीनन्दन तुम्हारे पास आ रहे हैं'

verses.transliteration: bāndhavānāmapi tathā bhedakāle samutthite | vadhyate yo'ntaraprepsuḥ svajano yadi vetaraḥ || 69 ||

verses.sanskrit: कालस्त्वं हि विनाशाय मया पुष्टो विजानता । वसुदेव कुलस्यास्य यद् विरोधयसे भृशम् ॥ ७० ॥
verses.transliteration: kālastvaṃ hi vināśāya mayā puṣṭo vijānatā | vasudeva kulasyāsya yad virodhayase bhṛśam || 70 ||
verses.hindi: जिसे मैंने पहले कभी देखा नहीं है, केवल नाम सुनकर उसे चाहने लगी हूँ तो भी वह मेरे सारे अड्भोंमें आग सुलगा रहा है। मुझे धूमाच्छन्‍न किये देता है। नारीके इस स्वभावको धिककार है॥ ५७॥ 'जैसा कि मैं बुद्धिसे सोच रही हूँ, यदि मेरे प्रियतम नहीं आये तो मैं अकिद्जन नारी उसी मार्गको अपनाऊँगी, जिसपर कुमुद्ठती चल चुकी है अर्थात् प्रिययम पतिके जीते जी ही युवावस्थामें मुझे अपने प्राणोंका परित्याग करना पड़ेगा। हा! यह कितने कष्टकी बात है ?7॥ ५८॥  हाय! हाय !! मुझ मनस्विनी नारीको कामदेवरूपी विषधर सर्पने डँस लिया है, अन्यथा शीतलता ही जिनकी शक्ति है, जो स्वभावसे ही जगत्को आह्ाद एवं सुख प्रदान करनेवाली हैं, वे चन्द्रमाकी किरणें मेरे अज्जोंको क्‍यों जला रही हैं ?

verses.explanation: जिसे मैंने पहले कभी देखा नहीं है, केवल नाम सुनकर उसे चाहने लगी हूँ तो भी वह मेरे सारे अड्भोंमें आग सुलगा रहा है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
