verses.sanskrit: तां ददर्श तदा कृष्णो लक्ष्मीं साक्षादिव स्थिताम् । रूपेणाग्र्येण सम्पन्नां देवतायतनान्तिके ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dadarśa tadā kṛṣṇo lakṣmīṃ sākṣādiva sthitām | rūpeṇāgryeṇa sampannāṃ devatāyatanāntike || 35 ||
verses.hindi: उस यात्राके समय देवमन्दिसके निकट परम सुन्दर रूपसे सम्पन्न साक्षात्‌ लक्ष्मी-सी खड़ी हुई रुक्मिणीको भगवान्‌ श्रीकृष्णने देखा

verses.sanskrit: वह्नेरिव शिखां दीप्तां मायां भूमिगतामिव । पृथिवीमिव गम्भीरामुत्थितां पृथिवीतलात् ॥ ३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: vahneriva śikhāṃ dīptāṃ māyāṃ bhūmigatāmiva | pṛthivīmiva gambhīrāmutthitāṃ pṛthivītalāt || 36 ||
verses.hindi: वह प्रज्वलित हुई अग्निकी शिखा, पृथ्वीपर उतरी हुई देवमाया तथा भूतलसे उठी हुई गम्भीर स्वभाववाली मूर्तिमती भूदेवीके समान जान पड़ती थी

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिमिव सोमस्य सौम्यां स्त्रीविग्रहां भुवि । श्रीमिवाग्र्यां विना पद्मं भविष्यां श्रीसहायिनीम् । कृष्णेन मनसा दृष्टां दुर्निरीक्ष्यां सुरैरपि ॥ ३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: marīcimiva somasya saumyāṃ strīvigrahāṃ bhuvi | śrīmivāgryāṃ vinā padmaṃ bhaviṣyāṃ śrīsahāyinīm | kṛṣṇena manasā dṛṣṭāṃ durnirīkṣyāṃ surairapi || 37 ||
verses.hindi: उसे देखकर ऐसा प्रतीत होता था, मानो चन्द्रमाकी सौम्य किरण सुन्दरी नारीका रूप धारण करके पृथ्वीपर उतरी हो, बिना कमलकी श्रेष्ठ लक्ष्मी हो अथवा भविष्यमें होनेवाली लक्ष्मीकी सहायिका हो । देवताओंके लिये भी जिसका दर्शन होना अत्यन्त कठिन था, उस रुक्मिणीको श्रीकृष्णने जी भरकर देखा

verses.sanskrit: श्यामावदाता सा ह्यासीत्पृथुचार्वायतेक्षणा । ताम्रौष्ठनयनापाङ्गी पीनोरुजघनस्तनी ॥ ३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: śyāmāvadātā sā hyāsītpṛthucārvāyatekṣaṇā | tāmrauṣṭhanayanāpāṅgī pīnorujaghanastanī || 38 ||
verses.hindi: उसकी सोलह वर्षकी अवस्था थी। अज्ञोंकी कान्ति गौरवर्णकी थी । उसके नेत्र बहुत ही मनोहर एवं विशाल थे। ओठ तथा नयनोंके प्रान्तभाग ताँबेके समान लाल थे। जाँघ, नितम्ब और स्तन मोटे एवं मांसल थे

verses.explanation: आद्ययोर्युगयोब्रहान् ब्रह्मप्राप्तस्य सर्वशः उपपन्नेन मनसा हैवप्रत्ययसाधिना ऋद्धिं प्राप्तस्तु भगवान् योगात्मा ब्रह्मसम्भव:। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: आद्ययोर्युगयोब्रहान् ब्रह्मप्राप्तस्य सर्वशः उपपन्नेन मनसा हैवप्रत्ययसाधिना ऋद्धिं प्राप्तस्तु भगवान् योगात्मा ब्रह्मसम्भव:। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बृहती चारुसर्वाङ्गी तन्वी शशिसितानना । ताम्रतुङ्गनखी सुभ्रूर्नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजा ॥ ३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhatī cārusarvāṅgī tanvī śaśisitānanā | tāmratuṅganakhī subhrūrnīlakuñcitamūrdhajā || 39 ||
verses.hindi: वह पतले और लंबे कदकी स्त्री थी। उसके सारे अज्ञ बड़े ही मनोहर थे। उसका मुख चन्द्रमाके समान गौर कान्तिसे सुशोभित था। नख लाल और ऊँचे थे। भौंहें सुन्दर तथा सिरके बाल काले और घुँघराले थे

verses.sanskrit: अत्यर्थं रूपतः कान्ता पीनश्रोणिपयोधरा । तीक्ष्णशुक्लैः समैर्दन्तैः प्रभासद्भिरलङ्कृता ॥ ४० ॥
verses.transliteration: atyarthaṃ rūpataḥ kāntā pīnaśroṇipayodharā | tīkṣṇaśuklaiḥ samairdantaiḥ prabhāsadbhiralaṅkṛtā || 40 ||

verses.sanskrit: अनन्या प्रमदा लोके रूपेण यशसा श्रिया । रुक्मिणी रूपिणी देवी पाण्डुरक्षौमवासिनी ॥ ४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: ananyā pramadā loke rūpeṇa yaśasā śriyā | rukmiṇī rūpiṇī devī pāṇḍurakṣaumavāsinī || 41 ||
verses.hindi: रूप, यश और शोभाकी दृष्टिसे संसारमें दूसरी कोई युवती उसके समान नहीं थी । उज्वल रेशमी साड़ी पहने हुए राजकुमारी रुक्मिणी रूपवती देवी-सी जान पड़ती थी

verses.explanation: जनमेजयने कहा--ब्रह्मन्! महामुने! दोनों आदि युगोंमें ब्रह्मभावको प्राप्त हुए योगी ब्रह्माकी पहले जो कार्य-संतति रही है, उसका मैं पूर्णतः विस्तारके साथ वर्णन स…। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: जनमेजयने कहा--ब्रह्मन्! महामुने! दोनों आदि युगोंमें ब्रह्मभावको प्राप्त हुए योगी ब्रह्माकी पहले जो कार्य-संतति रही है, उसका मैं पूर्णतः विस्तारके साथ वर्णन स…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा ववृधे कामः कृष्णस्य प्रियदर्शनाम् । हविषेवानलस्यार्चिर्मनस्तस्यां समादधत् ॥ ४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vavṛdhe kāmaḥ kṛṣṇasya priyadarśanām | haviṣevānalasyārcirmanastasyāṃ samādadhat || 42 ||
verses.hindi: जैसे घीकी आहुति डालनेसे अग्निकी ज्वाला प्रज्वलित हो उठती है, उसी प्रकार उस प्रियदर्शना राजकन्याकों देखकर श्रीकृष्णकी उसे पानेके लिये कामना बहुत बढ़ गयी । उन्होंने अपना हृदय उसीपर निछावर कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: रामेण सह निश्चित्य केशवस्तु महाबलः । तत्प्रमाथेऽकरोद्बुद्धिं वृष्णिभिः प्रणिधाय च ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāmeṇa saha niścitya keśavastu mahābalaḥ | tatpramāthe'karodbuddhiṃ vṛṣṇibhiḥ praṇidhāya ca || 43 ||
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर महाबली श्रीकृष्णने वृष्णिवंशियोंके साथ सलाह और बलरामजीके साथ कर्तव्यका निश्चय करके रुक्मिणीको हर लेनेका विचार किया

verses.sanskrit: कृते तु देवताकार्ये निष्क्रामन्तीं सुरालयात् । उन्मथ्य सहसा कृष्णः स्वं निनाय रथोत्तमम् ॥ ४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛte tu devatākārye niṣkrāmantīṃ surālayāt | unmathya sahasā kṛṣṇaḥ svaṃ nināya rathottamam || 44 ||
verses.hindi: इतनेमें ही देवपूजाका कार्य सम्पन्न करके रुक्मिणी देवालयसे निकलने लगी। उसी समय श्रीकृष्णने सहसा पहुँचकर उसे गोदमें उठा लिया और अपने उत्तम रथपर पहुँचा दिया

verses.explanation: एष शब्दो महानाद: पुराणो ब्रह्मसम्भव:। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: एष शब्दो महानाद: पुराणो ब्रह्मसम्भव:। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षमुत्पाट्य रामोऽपि जघानापततः परान् । समनह्यन्त दाशार्हास्तदाज्ञप्ताश्च सर्वशः ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣamutpāṭya rāmo'pi jaghānāpatataḥ parān | samanahyanta dāśārhāstadājñaptāśca sarvaśaḥ || 45 ||
verses.hindi: इधर बलरामने भी एक पेड़ उखाड़कर आक्रमण करनेवाले शत्रुओंका उसीसे संहार कर डाला । उस समय बलरामकी आज्ञा पाकर समस्त यदुवंशी वीर युद्धके लिये कमर कसकर तैयार हो गये

verses.sanskrit: ते रथैर्विविधाकारैः समुच्छ्रितमहाध्वजैः । वाजिभिर्वारणैश्चैव परिवव्रुर्हलायुधम् ॥ ४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: te rathairvividhākāraiḥ samucchritamahādhvajaiḥ | vājibhirvāraṇaiścaiva parivavrurhalāyudham || 46 ||
verses.hindi: वे उँचे एवं विशाल ध्वजोंसे युक्त भाँति-भाँतिके रथों, घोड़ों और हाथियोंद्वारा बलरामजीको चारों ओरसे घेरकर खड़े हो गये

verses.sanskrit: आदाय रुक्मिणीं कृष्णो जगामाशु पुरीं प्रति । रामे भारं तमासज्य युयुधाने च वीर्यवान् ॥ ४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: ādāya rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇo jagāmāśu purīṃ prati | rāme bhāraṃ tamāsajya yuyudhāne ca vīryavān || 47 ||
verses.hindi: + ६७ बलवान्‌ श्रीकृष्ण युद्धका सारा भार बलराम तथा सात्यकिपर छोड़कर रुक्मिणीको साथ ले शीघ्र ही द्वारकापुरीको चल दिये

verses.sanskrit: अक्रूरे विपृथौ चैव गदे च कृतवर्मणि । चक्रदेवे सुदेवे च सारणे च महाबले ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.transliteration: akrūre vipṛthau caiva gade ca kṛtavarmaṇi | cakradeve sudeve ca sāraṇe ca mahābale || 48 ||
verses.hindi: मधुसूदन श्रीकृष्णने युद्धका वह गुरुतर भार (बलराम और सात्यकिके सिवा) अक्रूर, विपृथु, गद, कृतवर्मा, चक्रदेव, सुदेव, महाबली सारण, निवृत्तशत्रु, पराक्रमी भड्भकार, विदूरथ, उग्रसेनकुमार कड्ठ, शतद्युम्न, राजाधिदेव, मृदुर, प्रसेन, चित्रक, अतिदान्त, बृहद्दुर्ग, श्रफल्क, सत्यक, पृथु तथा अन्यान्य वृष्णि और अन्धकवंशके प्रमुख बीरोंपर रखकर द्वारकापुरीकी ओर प्रस्थान किया

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तशत्रौ विक्रान्ते भङ्गकारे विदूरथे । उग्रसेनात्मजे कङ्के शतद्युम्ने च केशवः ॥ ४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: nivṛttaśatrau vikrānte bhaṅgakāre vidūrathe | ugrasenātmaje kaṅke śatadyumne ca keśavaḥ || 49 ||

verses.explanation: धातुभिर्मो क्षकाले च महात्मा सम्प्रदृश्यते। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: धातुभिर्मो क्षकाले च महात्मा सम्प्रदृश्यते। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: राजाधिदेवे मृदुरे प्रसेने चित्रके तथा । अतिदान्ते बृहद्दुर्गे श्वफल्के सत्यके पृथौ ॥ ५० ॥
verses.transliteration: rājādhideve mṛdure prasene citrake tathā | atidānte bṛhaddurge śvaphalke satyake pṛthau || 50 ||

verses.sanskrit: वृष्ण्यन्धकेषु चान्येषु मुख्येषु मधुसूदनः । गुरुमासज्य तं भारं ययौ द्वारवतीं प्रति ॥ ५१ ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛṣṇyandhakeṣu cānyeṣu mukhyeṣu madhusūdanaḥ | gurumāsajya taṃ bhāraṃ yayau dvāravatīṃ prati || 51 ||

verses.explanation: हैं, उनमेंसे कुछ तो शीतल होती हैं और कुछ उष्ण; इस प्रकार वह विकारग्रस्त हो जाता है॥ २३--२६॥ वह महासागरमें पड़कर दग्ध होने लगता है, किंतु उसमें डूबता नहीं है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: दन्तवक्त्रो जरासन्धः शिशुपालश्च वीर्यवान् । सन्नद्धा निर्ययुः क्रुद्धा जिघांसन्तो जनार्दनम् ॥ ५२ ॥
verses.transliteration: dantavaktro jarāsandhaḥ śiśupālaśca vīryavān | sannaddhā niryayuḥ kruddhā jighāṃsanto janārdanam || 52 ||
verses.hindi: उधर दन्तवक्‍्त्र, जरासंध और पराक्रमी शिशुपाल कवच बाँधकर श्रीकृष्णको मार डालनेकी इच्छासे क्रोधमें भरे हुए निकले

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गवङ्गकलिङ्गैश्च सार्द्धं पौण्ड्रैश्च वीर्यवान् । निर्ययौ चेदिराजस्तु भ्रातृभिः स महारथैः ॥ ५३ ॥
verses.transliteration: aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgaiśca sārddhaṃ pauṇḍraiśca vīryavān | niryayau cedirājastu bhrātṛbhiḥ sa mahārathaiḥ || 53 ||
verses.hindi: पराक्रमी चेदिराज शिशुपाल अड्ग, बड़, कलिज्॒ तथा पुण्ड्रदेशीय योद्धाओं और अपने महारथी भाइयोंके साथ युद्धके लिये निकला

verses.sanskrit: तान् प्रत्यगृह्णन् संरब्धा वृष्णिवीरा महारथाः । सङ्कर्षणं पुरस्कृत्य वासवं मरुतो यथा ॥ ५४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tān pratyagṛhṇan saṃrabdhā vṛṣṇivīrā mahārathāḥ | saṅkarṣaṇaṃ puraskṛtya vāsavaṃ maruto yathā || 54 ||

verses.science: मेघरूपमें परिणत हो जाता है॥ ३२॥ वह सामर्थ्यशाली सिद्ध योगी योगसे नाना प्रकारके रसोंकी सृष्टि करता है तथा योगप्राप्त-हेतुसे समस्त प्राणियोंके शरीरके उपयोगके ल…। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: आपतन्तं हिं वेगेन जरासन्धं महाबलम् । षड्भिर्विव्याध नाराचैर्युयुधानो महामृधे ॥ ५५ ॥
verses.transliteration: āpatantaṃ hiṃ vegena jarāsandhaṃ mahābalam | ṣaḍbhirvivyādha nārācairyuyudhāno mahāmṛdhe || 55 ||
verses.hindi: उस महासमरमें वेगसे आगे बढ़ते हुए महाबली जरासंधको सात्यकिने छः नाराचोंसे मारकर घायल कर दिया

verses.explanation: सब-के-सब स्त्रियोंक रूप धारणकर योगीसे संयुक्त हो जाते और उसके गलेमें लिपटने या लटकने लगते हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: सब-के-सब स्त्रियोंक रूप धारणकर योगीसे संयुक्त हो जाते और उसके गलेमें लिपटने या लटकने लगते हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: अक्रूरो दन्तवक्त्रं तु विव्याध नवभिः शरैः । तं प्रत्यविद्ध्यत् कारूषो बाणैर्दशभिराशुगैः ॥ ५६ ॥
verses.transliteration: akrūro dantavaktraṃ tu vivyādha navabhiḥ śaraiḥ | taṃ pratyaviddhyat kārūṣo bāṇairdaśabhirāśugaiḥ || 56 ||
verses.hindi: अक्रूरने दन्तवक्‍्त्रको नौ बाणोंसे वेध दिया, तब करूषराज दन्तवक्‍्त्रने दस शीघ्रगामी बाणोंद्वारा अक्रूरको भी बींधकर बदला चुकाया

verses.sanskrit: विपृथुः शिशुपालं तु शरैर्विव्याध सप्तभिः । अष्टभिः प्रत्यविद्ध्यत् तं शिशुपालः प्रतापवान् ॥ ५७ ॥
verses.transliteration: vipṛthuḥ śiśupālaṃ tu śarairvivyādha saptabhiḥ | aṣṭabhiḥ pratyaviddhyat taṃ śiśupālaḥ pratāpavān || 57 ||
verses.hindi: विपृथुने सात बाणोंसे शिशुपालको घायल कर दिया, तब प्रतापी शिशुपालने आठ बाणोंसे विपृथुको क्षत-विशक्षत कर दिया

Worked up with anger the beautiful lord of Shoubha killed Shālwa, grasping firmly a bow, the Yavana Indradyumna and Kasherunām. Having scattered thousands of mountains the lotus-eyed Purusottama struck Dyumutsena with his discus. Having killed Maya in battle with knotty arrows Krishna, of wonderful deeds, has released the son of Indrasena (12). The highly powerful Varuna, with all the acquatic animals, has been defeated in battle by Krishna repairing to Lohitakuta (under water) (13). Having gone to Indra's palace, he, although prevented by the highly powerful celestials, disregarding their king, carried away the Pārijāta tree (14). The intelligent Janārddana has slain the kings of Pandya, Poundrya, Kalinga, Matsa and Banga (15). Having killed hundreds of highly powerful kings he married his beautiful queen Gāndhāri. But the Lord Madhusudana has crowned the foremost of Bharatas, Arjuna, the holder of Gāndiva bow who used to play before Kunti, with success (16–17). This foremost of men has defeated, in battle, Drona, Drauni, Karna, Bhishma, Suyodhana and other warriors. verses.explanation: अलोभाच्छिद्यते सद्यो वेषमानोनुकी त्यते। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: अलोभाच्छिद्यते सद्यो वेषमानोनुकी त्यते। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गवेषणस्तु चैद्यं तु षडभिर्विव्याध मार्गणैः । अतिदान्तस्तथाष्टाभिर्बृहद्दुर्गश्च पञ्चभिः ॥ ५८ ॥
verses.transliteration: gaveṣaṇastu caidyaṃ tu ṣaḍabhirvivyādha mārgaṇaiḥ | atidāntastathāṣṭābhirbṛhaddurgaśca pañcabhiḥ || 58 ||
verses.hindi: तब गवेषणने छः, अतिदान्तने आठ और बृहद्दुर्गने पाँच बाणोंसे चेदिराज शिशुपालको गहरी चोट पहुँचायी

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिविव्याध तांश्चैद्यः पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः शरैः । जघानाश्वांश्च चतुरश्चतुर्भिर्विपृथोः शरैः ॥ ५९ ॥
verses.transliteration: prativivyādha tāṃścaidyaḥ pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ | jaghānāśvāṃśca caturaścaturbhirvipṛthoḥ śaraiḥ || 59 ||
verses.hindi: शिशुपालने भी उन सबको पाँच-पाँच बाण मारकर बदला चुकाया और चार बाणोंसे विपृथुके चारों घोड़ोंको मार डाला

verses.explanation: अन्य विषयोंसे वह शीघ्र ही सम्बन्ध स्थापित कर लेता है तथा उनके द्वारा विक्षेपमें पड़कर उसकी प्रगति रुक जाती है॥ ४९ ॥ तदनन्तर पार्थिव ऐश्वर्यका सेवन करता हुआ व…। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्दुर्गस्य भल्लेन शिरश्चिच्छेद चारिहा । गवेषणस्य सूतं तु प्राहिणोद् यमसादनम् ॥ ६० ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhaddurgasya bhallena śiraściccheda cārihā | gaveṣaṇasya sūtaṃ tu prāhiṇod yamasādanam || 60 ||
verses.hindi: इतना ही नहीं, शत्रुसूदन शिशुपालने एक भल्लसे बृहद्दुर्गका सिर काट लिया और गवेषणके सारथिको यमलोक पहुँचा दिया। तब महाबली एवं पराक्रमी विपृथु अपने अश्वहीन रथको त्यागकर शीघ्र ही बृहद्दुर्गके रथपर जा चढ़े

verses.sanskrit: हताश्वं तु रथं त्यक्त्वा विपृथुस्तु महाबलः । आरुरोह रथं शीघ्रं बृहद्दुर्गस्य वीर्यवान् ॥ ६१ ॥
verses.transliteration: hatāśvaṃ tu rathaṃ tyaktvā vipṛthustu mahābalaḥ | āruroha rathaṃ śīghraṃ bṛhaddurgasya vīryavān || 61 ||

verses.sanskrit: विपृथोः सारथिश्चापि गवेषणरथं द्रुतम् । आरुह्य जवनानश्वान् नियन्तुमुपचक्रमे ॥ ६२ ॥
verses.transliteration: vipṛthoḥ sārathiścāpi gaveṣaṇarathaṃ drutam | āruhya javanānaśvān niyantumupacakrame || 62 ||
verses.hindi: विपृथुका सारधि भी तुरंत ही गवेषणके रथपर जा बैठा और उसके वेगशाली घोड़ोंको काबूमें रखनेकी चेष्टा करने लगा

verses.sanskrit: ते क्रुद्धाः शरवर्षेण सुनीथं समवाकिरन् । नृत्यन्तं रथमार्गेषु चापहस्ताः कलापिनः ॥ ६३ ॥
verses.transliteration: te kruddhāḥ śaravarṣeṇa sunīthaṃ samavākiran | nṛtyantaṃ rathamārgeṣu cāpahastāḥ kalāpinaḥ || 63 ||
verses.hindi: फिर तो वे कुपित हो धनुष और बाण हाथमें लेकर रथमार्गोपर नृत्य-सा करते हुए सुनीथपुत्र शिशुपालपर बाणोंकी बौछार करने लगे
verses.translation: Narada said:—Moreover, the nooses made by Mura have been cut, Nisumva and Naraka have been slain and the road to the city of Pragyotish has been freed from all dangers. Even the proud kings of the world have been frightened in battle by this descendant of Shura (Krishna) with the twang of his bow and the sound of his conch-shell Panchajanya. Having vanquished easily the highly powerful Rukshmi well protected by the Decean car-warriors resembling clouds, the foremost of Vrishnis Keshava carried away Rukshmini (1–3). Afterwards Hari, the holder of conch-shell, discus and club, brought Bhoja's daughter into his house in a car effulgent like the sun and producing a rattle like unto the muttering of clouds and married her. In the city of Jāruthi he defeated Ahdriti, Kratha and Shishupala and vanquished Dantavakra and Shatadhanwā with all their soldiers. Worked up with anger the beautiful lord of Shoubha killed Shālwa, grasping firmly a bow, the Yavana Indradyumna and Kasherunām. Having scattered thousands of mountains the lotus-eyed Purusottama struck Dyumutsena with his discus. In the city of Irāvati on the summit of the mount Mahendra there lived two followers of Rāvana Gopati and Tālaketu, who could disappear form view within the twinkling of an eye and were effulgent like sun and fire. The foremost of men, Keshava, the holder of Srānga bow, killed them both, within the twinkling of an eye, the Dānavas Hansa and Dimvaka have been also slain by Krishna with their followers. Vārānashi (Benares) has been burnt down by the high souled Keshava and the king with his followers has been slain (4-11). Having killed Maya in battle with knotty arrows Krishna, of wonderful deeds, has released the son of Indrasena (12). The highly powerful Varuna, with all the acquatic animals, has been defeated in battle by Krishna repairing to Lohitakuta (under water) (13). Having gone to Indra's palace, he, although prevented by the highly powerful celestials, disregarding their king, carried away the Pārijāta tree (14). The intelligent Janārddana has slain the kings of Pandya, Poundrya, Kalinga, Matsa and Banga (15). Having killed hundreds of highly powerful kings he married his beautiful queen Gāndhāri. But the Lord Madhusudana has crowned the foremost of Bharatas, Arjuna, the holder of Gāndiva bow who used to play before Kunti, with success (16–17). This foremost of men has defeated, in battle, Drona, Drauni, Karna, Bhishma, Suyodhana and other warriors. For pleasing Vabhru the powerful Hari, the holder of conch-shell, discus and club, carried away by force the daughter of the king of Suveera (18-19). When Venudāri trampled over the entire earth with his horses, cars and elephants Purusottama defeated him with great care (20). Acquiring, by his ascetic penances, energy, strength and power in his pristine dwarfish form Mādhava stole away from Bali the three worlds. Even when he was attacked in the city of Prāgyotish by the Dānavas with thunderbolts, clubs and swords Death could not near him (20-22). Bali's son, the highly powerful, energetic and rich Bāna has been defeated by Krishna with all his followers. The highly powerful Janārddana has killed Peetha, Paithika and Asitomā the courtiers of the long-armed Kansa (23–24). The highly illustrious Mādhava, the foremost of men, has killed the Daityas Jambha, Airāvata and Virupa, assuming the semblance of a man (25). Having defeated in water the highly powerful Nāga king Kālya, the lotus-eyed (Krishna) has despatched him to the sea (26). Having vanquished Vivaswān's son Yama, Hari, the foremost of men, has restored to life the dead son of Sāndipani (27). O Emperor Janamejaya, in this way, this high-souled one chastises those wicked souls who injure the Brāhmanas and the gods. Having slain Bhumi's son Naraka he has brought the pair of ear-rings and given them to the mother of gods for pleasing the holder of thunder-bolt (28–29). The highly illustrious Lord Vishnu, the master of all the worlds, is a terror to the Daityas and declares fearlessness to the celestials (30). Having established virtue amongst the mortals by performing various sacrifices and accomplished the great work of the gods he will return to his own region. Then the highly illustrious Krishna will make the ocean devour the cities Bhogavati, a favourite resort of the Rishis, and Dwārakā (31–33). This city of Dwārakā, filled with various jewels and sacrificial grounds, will enter, with its gardens, into the abode (sea) of Varuna (33). The ocean, conversant with the desire of Krishna, the holder of Shrānga bow, will inundate this city of Dwārakā constructed by Vāsudeva and resembling the residence of the sun. There is none amongst the gods, Asuras, and men and none will be, except the slayer of Madhu, who will be able to live
verses.explanation: धारणा करके हँसते हुए-से ब्रह्मयोगसे युक्त हो मानसिक संकल्पके द्वारा प्रजाओंकी सृष्टि की ॥ २॥ उन भगवानूने नेत्रसे रूपवती अप्सराओंको उत्पन्न किया और नासिकाके अ…। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: धारणा करके हँसते हुए-से ब्रह्मयोगसे युक्त हो मानसिक संकल्पके द्वारा प्रजाओंकी सृष्टि की ॥ २॥ उन भगवानूने नेत्रसे रूपवती अप्सराओंको उत्पन्न किया और नासिकाके अ…। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: चक्रदेवो दन्तवक्त्रं बिभेदोरसि पत्रिणा । षड्रथं पञ्चभिश्चैव विव्याध युधि मार्गणैः ॥ ६४ ॥
verses.transliteration: cakradevo dantavaktraṃ bibhedorasi patriṇā | ṣaḍrathaṃ pañcabhiścaiva vivyādha yudhi mārgaṇaiḥ || 64 ||
verses.hindi: तब उन दोनोंने भी पैनी धारवाले दस मर्मभेदी बाणोंद्वारा चक्रदेवको गहरी चोट पहुँचायी। फिर शिशुपालके भाई बलीने भी चक्रदेवको दस बाण मारे

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां स विद्धो दशभिर्बाणैर्मर्मातिगैः शितैः । ततो बली चक्रदेवं बिभेद दशभिः शरैः ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tābhyāṃ sa viddho daśabhirbāṇairmarmātigaiḥ śitaiḥ | tato balī cakradevaṃ bibheda daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ || 65 ||

verses.explanation: ऋषिं त्वड्धिरसं चैव मुनिं ज्वलिततेजसम्। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ऋषिं त्वड्धिरसं चैव मुनिं ज्वलिततेजसम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चभिश्चापि विव्याध सोऽपि दूराद्विदूरथम् । विदूरथोऽपि तं षड्भिर्विव्याधाजौ शितैः शरैः ॥ ६६ ॥
verses.transliteration: pañcabhiścāpi vivyādha so'pi dūrādvidūratham | vidūratho'pi taṃ ṣaḍbhirvivyādhājau śitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 66 ||
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात्‌ उसने दूरसे ही पाँच बाण मारकर विदूरथको भी घायल कर दिया। विदूरथने भी छः पैने बाण मारकर युद्धमें बलीको आहत कर दिया

verses.explanation: व्यधत्त शतशो ब्रह्मा सर्वभूतपितामहः एष ब्रह्ममयो यज्ञों योग: सांख्यश्च तत्त्वतः। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिंशता प्रत्यविध्यत् तं बली बाणैर्महाबलम् । कृतवर्मा बिभेदाजौ राजपुत्रं त्रिभिः शरैः ॥ ६७ ॥
verses.transliteration: triṃśatā pratyavidhyat taṃ balī bāṇairmahābalam | kṛtavarmā bibhedājau rājaputraṃ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ || 67 ||
verses.hindi: तब बलीने महाबली विदूरथको बदलेमें तीस बाण मारे । दूसरी ओर कृतवर्मानि युद्धमें पौण्ड्रक वासुदेवके पुत्रको तीन बाणोंसे घायल कर दिया। साथ ही उसके सारथिको भी मार डाला और ऊँचे ध्वजको काट गिराया

verses.explanation: मुनिवर अज्भिराको योगेश्वर भगवान् ब्रह्माने योगबलके द्वार अपनी दोनों भौंहोंक बीचसे प्रकट किया। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: न्यहनत् सारथिं चास्य ध्वजं चिच्छेद सोच्छ्रितम् । प्रतिविव्याध तं क्रुद्धः पौण्ड्रः षड्भिः शिलीमुखैः ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.transliteration: nyahanat sārathiṃ cāsya dhvajaṃ ciccheda socchritam | prativivyādha taṃ kruddhaḥ pauṇḍraḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ śilīmukhaiḥ || 68 ||

verses.transliteration: dhanuściccheda cāpyasya bhallena kṛtavarmaṇaḥ | nivṛttaśatruḥ kāliṅgaṃ bibheda niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ | tomareṇāṃsadeśe taṃ nirbibheda kaliṅgarāṭ || 69 ||
verses.hindi: निवृत्तशत्रुने बहुत-से पैने बाण मारकर कलिज़राजकी बींध डाला। तब कलिऑद्भराजने एक तोमरका प्रहार करके उसके कंधेपर घाव कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: गजेनासाद्य कङ्कस्तु गजमङ्गस्य वीर्यवान् । तोमरेण बिभेदाङ्गं बिभेदाङ्गश्च तं शरैः ॥ ७० ॥
verses.transliteration: gajenāsādya kaṅkastu gajamaṅgasya vīryavān | tomareṇa bibhedāṅgaṃ bibhedāṅgaśca taṃ śaraiḥ || 70 ||
verses.hindi: पराक्रमी कड्ने हाथीके द्वारा आक्रमण करके अज्भराजके हाथी और अड्रराजको भी तोमरसे घायल कर दिया। तब अड्राजने भी अनेक बाणोंद्वारा कड्डको चोट पहुँचायी

verses.sanskrit: चित्रकश्च श्वफल्कश्च सत्यकश्च महारथः । कलिङ्गस्य तथानीकं नाराचैर्बिभिदुः शतैः ॥ ७१ ॥
verses.transliteration: citrakaśca śvaphalkaśca satyakaśca mahārathaḥ | kaliṅgasya tathānīkaṃ nārācairbibhiduḥ śataiḥ || 71 ||
verses.hindi: उधर चित्रक, श्रफल्क और महारथी सत्यकने कलिड्राजकी सेनाको सौ नाराचों से मारकर विदीर्ण कर डाला

verses.sanskrit: तं निसृष्टद्रुमेणाजौ वङ्गराजस्य कुञ्जरम् । जघान रामः सङ्क्रुद्धो वङ्गराजं च संयुगे ॥ ७२ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṃ nisṛṣṭadrumeṇājau vaṅgarājasya kuñjaram | jaghāna rāmaḥ saṅkruddho vaṅgarājaṃ ca saṃyuge || 72 ||
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर क्रोधमें भरे हुए बलरामने एक पत्रहीन वृक्षके द्वारा युद्धस्थलमें वड़्राजके हाथी और वज़राजको भी कालके गालमें भेज दिया

verses.sanskrit: तं हत्वा रथमारुह्य धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् । सङ्कर्षणो जघानोग्रैर्नाराचैः कैशिकान् बहून् ॥ ७३ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṃ hatvā rathamāruhya dhanurādāya vīryavān | saṅkarṣaṇo jaghānograirnārācaiḥ kaiśikān bahūn || 73 ||
verses.hindi: वड्भराजका वध करके पराक्रमी संकर्षणने धनुष हाथमें ले रथपर आरूढ़ हो भयंकर नाराचोंद्वारा बहुत-से कैशिकोंका संहार कर डाला

verses.sanskrit: षड्भिर्निहत्य कारूषान् महेष्वासान् स वीर्यवान् । शतं जघान सङ्क्रुद्धो मागधानां महाबले ॥ ७४ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍbhirnihatya kārūṣān maheṣvāsān sa vīryavān | śataṃ jaghāna saṅkruddho māgadhānāṃ mahābale || 74 ||
verses.hindi: अत्यन्त कुपित हुए पराक्रमी बलरामने छ;: बाणोंसे करूष देशके अनेक महाधनुर्धरोंका वध करके मागधोंकी विशाल सेनामेंसे सौ चुने हुए वीरोंको यमलोक पहुँचा दिया

verses.sanskrit: निहत्य तान् महाबाहुर्जरासन्धं ततोऽभ्ययात् । तमापतन्तं विव्याध नाराचैर्मागधस्त्रिभिः ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.transliteration: nihatya tān mahābāhurjarāsandhaṃ tato'bhyayāt | tamāpatantaṃ vivyādha nārācairmāgadhastribhiḥ || 75 ||
verses.hindi: उन सबका संहार करके महाबाहु बलरामने जरासंधपर धावा किया। अपनी ओर आते हुए बलरामको मगधराजने तीन नाराचोंसे घायल कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: तं बिभेदाष्टभिः क्रुद्धो नाराचैर्मुसलायुधः । चिच्छेद चास्य भल्लेन ध्वजं हेमपरिष्कृतम् ॥ ७६ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṃ bibhedāṣṭabhiḥ kruddho nārācairmusalāyudhaḥ | ciccheda cāsya bhallena dhvajaṃ hemapariṣkṛtam || 76 ||
verses.hindi: तब मूसलधारी बलदेवने कुपित हो आठ नाराचोंसे जरासंधको क्षत-विक्षत कर दिया और उसके सुवर्णभूषित ध्वजको एक भल्लसे काट गिराया
verses.translation: Narada said:—Moreover, the nooses made by Mura have been cut, Nisumva and Naraka have been slain and the road to the city of Pragyotish has been freed from all dangers. Even the proud kings of the world have been frightened in battle by this descendant of Shura (Krishna) with the twang of his bow and the sound of his conch-shell Panchajanya. Having vanquished easily the highly powerful Rukshmi well protected by the Decean car-warriors resembling clouds, the foremost of Vrishnis Keshava carried away Rukshmini (1–3). Afterwards Hari, the holder of conch-shell, discus and club, brought Bhoja's daughter into his house in a car effulgent like the sun and producing a rattle like unto the muttering of clouds and married her. In the city of Jāruthi he defeated Ahdriti, Kratha and Shishupala and vanquished Dantavakra and Shatadhanwā with all their soldiers. Worked up with anger the beautiful lord of Shoubha killed Shālwa, grasping firmly a bow, the Yavana Indradyumna and Kasherunām. Having scattered thousands of mountains the lotus-eyed Purusottama struck Dyumutsena with his discus. In the city of Irāvati on the summit of the mount Mahendra there lived two followers of Rāvana Gopati and Tālaketu, who could disappear form view within the twinkling of an eye and were effulgent like sun and fire. The foremost of men, Keshava, the holder of Srānga bow, killed them both, within the twinkling of an eye, the Dānavas Hansa and Dimvaka have been also slain by Krishna with their followers. Vārānashi (Benares) has been burnt down by the high souled Keshava and the king with his followers has been slain (4-11). Having killed Maya in battle with knotty arrows Krishna, of wonderful deeds, has released the son of Indrasena (12). The highly powerful Varuna, with all the acquatic animals, has been defeated in battle by Krishna repairing to Lohitakuta (under water) (13). Having gone to Indra's palace, he, although prevented by the highly powerful celestials, disregarding their king, carried away the Pārijāta tree (14). The intelligent Janārddana has slain the kings of Pandya, Poundrya, Kalinga, Matsa and Banga (15). Having killed hundreds of highly powerful kings he married his beautiful queen Gāndhāri. But the Lord Madhusudana has crowned the foremost of Bharatas, Arjuna, the holder of Gāndiva bow who used to play before Kunti, with success (16–17). This foremost of men has defeated, in battle, Drona, Drauni, Karna, Bhishma, Suyodhana and other warriors. For pleasing Vabhru the powerful Hari, the holder of conch-shell, discus and club, carried away by force the daughter of the king of Suveera (18-19). When Venudāri trampled over the entire earth with his horses, cars and elephants Purusottama defeated him with great care (20). Acquiring, by his ascetic penances, energy, strength and power in his pristine dwarfish form Mādhava stole away from Bali the three worlds. Even when he was attacked in the city of Prāgyotish by the Dānavas with thunderbolts, clubs and swords Death could not near him (20-22). Bali's son, the highly powerful, energetic and rich Bāna has been defeated by Krishna with all his followers. The highly powerful Janārddana has killed Peetha, Paithika and Asitomā the courtiers of the long-armed Kansa (23–24). The highly illustrious Mādhava, the foremost of men, has killed the Daityas Jambha, Airāvata and Virupa, assuming the semblance of a man (25). Having defeated in water the highly powerful Nāga king Kālya, the lotus-eyed (Krishna) has despatched him to the sea (26). Having vanquished Vivaswān's son Yama, Hari, the foremost of men, has restored to life the dead son of Sāndipani (27). O Emperor Janamejaya, in this way, this high-souled one chastises those wicked souls who injure the Brāhmanas and the gods. Having slain Bhumi's son Naraka he has brought the pair of ear-rings and given them to the mother of gods for pleasing the holder of thunder-bolt (28–29). The highly illustrious Lord Vishnu, the master of all the worlds, is a terror to the Daityas and declares fearlessness to the celestials (30). Having established virtue amongst the mortals by performing various sacrifices and accomplished the great work of the gods he will return to his own region. Then the highly illustrious Krishna will make the ocean devour the cities Bhogavati, a favourite resort of the Rishis, and Dwārakā (31–33). This city of Dwārakā, filled with various jewels and sacrificial grounds, will enter, with its gardens, into the abode (sea) of Varuna (33). The ocean, conversant with the desire of Krishna, the holder of Shrānga bow, will inundate this city of Dwārakā constructed by Vāsudeva and resembling the residence of the sun. There is none amongst the gods, Asuras, and men and none will be, except the slayer of Madhu, who will be able to live
verses.explanation: लोकमें चार भागोंमें विभक्त हो गयी। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: लोकमें चार भागोंमें विभक्त हो गयी। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: तद् युद्धमभवद् घोरं तेषां देवासुरोपमम् । सृजतां शरवर्षाणि निघ्नतामितरेतरम् ॥ ७७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tad yuddhamabhavad ghoraṃ teṣāṃ devāsuropamam | sṛjatāṃ śaravarṣāṇi nighnatāmitaretaram || 77 ||
verses.hindi: बाणोंकी वृष्टि करते और एक-दूसरेको मारते हुए उन बीरोंमें देवासुरसंग्रामके समान घोर युद्ध होने लगा

verses.sanskrit: गजैर्गजा हि सङ्क्रुद्धाः सन्निपेतुः सहस्रशः । रथै रथाश्च संरब्धाः सादिनश्चापि सादिभिः ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.transliteration: gajairgajā hi saṅkruddhāḥ sannipetuḥ sahasraśaḥ | rathai rathāśca saṃrabdhāḥ sādinaścāpi sādibhiḥ || 78 ||
verses.hindi: ध्याय; * प्‌ क्रोधसे भरे हुए सहस्त्रों हाथी हाथियोंसे, रथ रथोंसे और रोषावेशसे युक्त घुड्सवार घुड़सवारोंसे भिड़ गये

verses.sanskrit: पदातयः पदातींश्च शक्तिचर्मासिपाणयः । छिन्दन्तश्चोत्तमाङ्गानि विचेरुर्युधि ते पृथक् ॥ ७९ ॥
verses.transliteration: padātayaḥ padātīṃśca śakticarmāsipāṇayaḥ | chindantaścottamāṅgāni viceruryudhi te pṛthak || 79 ||
verses.hindi: हाथोंमें शक्ति, ढाल और तलवार लिये हुए पैदल वीर पैदलोंसे जूझते और उनके मस्तक काटते हुए युद्धमें पृथक्‌-पृथकू विचरने लगे

verses.sanskrit: असीनां पात्यमानानां कवचेषु महास्वनः । शराणां पततां शब्दः पक्षिणामिव शुश्रुवे ॥ ८० ॥
verses.transliteration: asīnāṃ pātyamānānāṃ kavaceṣu mahāsvanaḥ | śarāṇāṃ patatāṃ śabdaḥ pakṣiṇāmiva śuśruve || 80 ||
verses.hindi: कवचों पर गिरायी जाती हुई तलवारों और गिरते हुए बाणोंका महान्‌ शब्द पक्षियोंके चहचहानेके समान सुनायी पड़ता था

verses.sanskrit: भेरीशङ्खमृदङ्गानां वेणूनां च मृधे ध्वनिम् । जुगूह घोषः शस्त्राणां ज्याघोषश्च महात्मनाम् ॥ ८१ ॥
verses.transliteration: bherīśaṅkhamṛdaṅgānāṃ veṇūnāṃ ca mṛdhe dhvanim | jugūha ghoṣaḥ śastrāṇāṃ jyāghoṣaśca mahātmanām || 81 ||
verses.hindi: युद्धस्थलमें महामनस्वी वीरोंकी प्रत्यज्ञाके खींचने और शस्त्रोंके टकरानेका शब्द भेरी, शड्ड, मृदज़ और वेणुओंकी ध्वनिको आच्छादित कर देता था
verses.translation: Narada said:—Moreover, the nooses made by Mura have been cut, Nisumva and Naraka have been slain and the road to the city of Pragyotish has been freed from all dangers. Even the proud kings of the world have been frightened in battle by this descendant of Shura (Krishna) with the twang of his bow and the sound of his conch-shell Panchajanya. Having vanquished easily the highly powerful Rukshmi well protected by the Decean car-warriors resembling clouds, the foremost of Vrishnis Keshava carried away Rukshmini (1–3). Afterwards Hari, the holder of conch-shell, discus and club, brought Bhoja's daughter into his house in a car effulgent like the sun and producing a rattle like unto the muttering of clouds and married her. In the city of Jāruthi he defeated Ahdriti, Kratha and Shishupala and vanquished Dantavakra and Shatadhanwā with all their soldiers. Worked up with anger the beautiful lord of Shoubha killed Shālwa, grasping firmly a bow, the Yavana Indradyumna and Kasherunām. Having scattered thousands of mountains the lotus-eyed Purusottama struck Dyumutsena with his discus. In the city of Irāvati on the summit of the mount Mahendra there lived two followers of Rāvana Gopati and Tālaketu, who could disappear form view within the twinkling of an eye and were effulgent like sun and fire. The foremost of men, Keshava, the holder of Srānga bow, killed them both, within the twinkling of an eye, the Dānavas Hansa and Dimvaka have been also slain by Krishna with their followers. Vārānashi (Benares) has been burnt down by the high souled Keshava and the king with his followers has been slain (4-11). Having killed Maya in battle with knotty arrows Krishna, of wonderful deeds, has released the son of Indrasena (12). The highly powerful Varuna, with all the acquatic animals, has been defeated in battle by Krishna repairing to Lohitakuta (under water) (13). Having gone to Indra's palace, he, although prevented by the highly powerful celestials, disregarding their king, carried away the Pārijāta tree (14). The intelligent Janārddana has slain the kings of Pandya, Poundrya, Kalinga, Matsa and Banga (15). Having killed hundreds of highly powerful kings he married his beautiful queen Gāndhāri. But the Lord Madhusudana has crowned the foremost of Bharatas, Arjuna, the holder of Gāndiva bow who used to play before Kunti, with success (16–17). This foremost of men has defeated, in battle, Drona, Drauni, Karna, Bhishma, Suyodhana and other warriors. For pleasing Vabhru the powerful Hari, the holder of conch-shell, discus and club, carried away by force the daughter of the king of Suveera (18-19). When Venudāri trampled over the entire earth with his horses, cars and elephants Purusottama defeated him with great care (20). Acquiring, by his ascetic penances, energy, strength and power in his pristine dwarfish form Mādhava stole away from Bali the three worlds. Even when he was attacked in the city of Prāgyotish by the Dānavas with thunderbolts, clubs and swords Death could not near him (20-22). Bali's son, the highly powerful, energetic and rich Bāna has been defeated by Krishna with all his followers. The highly powerful Janārddana has killed Peetha, Paithika and Asitomā the courtiers of the long-armed Kansa (23–24). The highly illustrious Mādhava, the foremost of men, has killed the Daityas Jambha, Airāvata and Virupa, assuming the semblance of a man (25). Having defeated in water the highly powerful Nāga king Kālya, the lotus-eyed (Krishna) has despatched him to the sea (26). Having vanquished Vivaswān's son Yama, Hari, the foremost of men, has restored to life the dead son of Sāndipani (27). O Emperor Janamejaya, in this way, this high-souled one chastises those wicked souls who injure the Brāhmanas and the gods. Having slain Bhumi's son Naraka he has brought the pair of ear-rings and given them to the mother of gods for pleasing the holder of thunder-bolt (28–29). The highly illustrious Lord Vishnu, the master of all the worlds, is a terror to the Daityas and declares fearlessness to the celestials (30). Having established virtue amongst the mortals by performing various sacrifices and accomplished the great work of the gods he will return to his own region. Then the highly illustrious Krishna will make the ocean devour the cities Bhogavati, a favourite resort of the Rishis, and Dwārakā (31–33). This city of Dwārakā, filled with various jewels and sacrificial grounds, will enter, with its gardens, into the abode (sea) of Varuna (33). The ocean, conversant with the desire of Krishna, the holder of Shrānga bow, will inundate this city of Dwārakā constructed by Vāsudeva and resembling the residence of the sun. There is none amongst the gods, Asuras, and men and none will be, except the slayer of Madhu, who will be able to live
verses.explanation: वैशम्पायनजीने कहा--रणजन्! पुरुषोत्तम दक्ष योगबलसे स्त्रीशरीरको प्राप्त हो गये। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: वैशम्पायनजीने कहा--रणजन्! पुरुषोत्तम दक्ष योगबलसे स्त्रीशरीरको प्राप्त हो गये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकृष्णेन रुक्मेः पराजयम्, रुक्मिण्याद्या सह श्रीकृष्णस्य विवाहः, तेभ्यः उत्पन्नानां सन्तानानां सङ्क्षेपतः परिचयं कृष्णेन ह्रियमाणां तां रुक्मी श्रुत्वा तु रुक्मिणीम् । प्रतिज्ञामकरोत क्रुद्धः समक्षं भीष्मकस्य ह ॥ १ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrīkṛṣṇena rukmeḥ parājayam, rukmiṇyādyā saha śrīkṛṣṇasya vivāhaḥ, tebhyaḥ utpannānāṃ santānānāṃ saṅkṣepataḥ paricayaṃ kṛṣṇena hriyamāṇāṃ tāṃ rukmī śrutvā tu rukmiṇīm | pratijñāmakarota kruddhaḥ samakṣaṃ bhīṣmakasya ha || 1 ||
verses.hindi: वैशम्पायनजी कहते हैं—जनमेजय! रुक्मीने जब सुना कि श्रीकृष्ण रुक्मिणीको हरकर लिये जा रहे हैं, उसने कुपित होकर भीष्मकके सामने ही यह प्रतिज्ञा की

verses.sanskrit: अहत्वा युधि गोविन्दमनानीय च रुक्मिणीम् । कुण्डिनं न प्रवेक्ष्यामि सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥ २ ॥
verses.transliteration: ahatvā yudhi govindamanānīya ca rukmiṇīm | kuṇḍinaṃ na pravekṣyāmi satyametad bravīmyaham || 2 ||
verses.hindi: रुक्मी बोला—मैं युद्धमें श्रीकृष्णका वध किये बिना तथा रुक्मिणीको वापस लाये बिना कुण्डिनपुरमें प्रवेश नहीं करूँगा; यह मैं सत्य कहता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: आस्थाय स रथं वीरः समुदग्रायुधध्वजम् । जवेन प्रययौ क्रुद्धो बलेन महता वृतः ॥ ३ ॥
verses.transliteration: āsthāya sa rathaṃ vīraḥ samudagrāyudhadhvajam | javena prayayau kruddho balena mahatā vṛtaḥ || 3 ||
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:–0 reverend Sir, of the many thousand wives of Krishna you have duly mentioned the names of eight. Do you now give an account of their children (1).
verses.hindi: ऐसी प्रतिज्ञा करके क्रोधमें भरा हुआ वीर रुक्मी प्रचण्ड आयुध और ऊँचे ध्वजसे सुशोभित रथपर आरूढ़ हो विशाल सेनाके साथ बड़े वेगसे आगे बढ़ा
verses.commentary: Sense: Vaishampāyana said:–0 reverend Sir, of the many thousand wives of Krishna you have duly mentioned the names of eight. Do you now give an account of their children (1).
verses.science: कश्यपको तेरह और सोमको सत्ताईस कन्याएँ इसलिये दीं कि वे इन्हें अपनी धर्मपत्नी बना लें॥७॥ उन कन्याओंका दान करनेके पश्चात् दक्ष मुनि ब्रह्माजीके क्षेत्र प्रयागम…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तमन्वयुर्नृपाश्चैव दक्षिणापथवर्तिनः । क्राथोंऽशुमाञ्छ्रुतर्वा च वेणुदारिश्च वीर्यवान् ॥ ४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tamanvayurnṛpāścaiva dakṣiṇāpathavartinaḥ | krāthoṃ'śumāñchrutarvā ca veṇudāriśca vīryavān || 4 ||
verses.hindi: उसके पीछे दक्षिण भारतके बहुत-से नरेश, क्रथपुत्र अंशुमान्‌, श्रुतर्वा तथा पराक्रमी बेणुदारि भी चले । भीष्मकके अन्य पुत्र भी, जो रथियोंमें श्रेष्ठ थे, रथके द्वारा रुक्मीके साथ गये । क्रथकैशिकदेशके सभी मुख्य महारथियोंने भी रुक्मीका साथ दिया

verses.sanskrit: भीष्मकस्य सुताश्चान्ये रथेन रथिनां वराः । क्रथकैशिकमुख्याश्च सर्व एव महारथाः ॥ ५ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhīṣmakasya sutāścānye rathena rathināṃ varāḥ | krathakaiśikamukhyāśca sarva eva mahārathāḥ || 5 ||

verses.sanskrit: ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं सरितं नर्मदामनु । गोविन्दं ददृशुः क्रुद्धाः सहैव प्रियया स्थितम् ॥ ६ ॥
verses.transliteration: te gatvā dūramadhvānaṃ saritaṃ narmadāmanu | govindaṃ dadṛśuḥ kruddhāḥ sahaiva priyayā sthitam || 6 ||
verses.hindi: उन सबने दूरतक रास्ता तै करके नर्मदा नदीके किनारे अपनी प्रियतमा रुक्मिणीके साथ रथपर बैठे हुए श्रीकृष्णको क्रोधपूर्वक देखा

verses.sanskrit: अवस्थाप्य च तत्सैन्यं रुक्मी मदबलान्वितः । चिकीर्षुर्द्वैरथं युद्धमभ्ययान्मधुसूदनम् ॥ ७ ॥
verses.transliteration: avasthāpya ca tatsainyaṃ rukmī madabalānvitaḥ | cikīrṣurdvairathaṃ yuddhamabhyayānmadhusūdanam || 7 ||
verses.hindi: रुक्मीको अपने बलका बड़ा घमंड था । उसने अपने साथ आयी हुई सारी सेनाको एक जगह खड़ी करके दट्वैरथ युद्ध करनेकी इच्छासे स्वयं ही भगवान्‌ मधुसूदनपर आक्रमण किया

verses.sanskrit: स विव्याध चतुःषष्ट्या गोविन्दं निशितैः शरैः । तं प्रत्यविध्यत् सप्तत्या बाणैर्युधि जनार्दनः ॥ ८ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa vivyādha catuḥṣaṣṭyā govindaṃ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ | taṃ pratyavidhyat saptatyā bāṇairyudhi janārdanaḥ || 8 ||
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Kāma (Cupid) of firm vows, in order to kill Shamvara, took his birth from Rukshmini, the incarnation of Lakshmi, and Vāsudeva as his beautiful son Pradyumna. On the seventh day at dead of night Kalashamvara stole away that infant son of Krishna from the lying-in room (2-3). Krishna, who followed the celestial Māyā, knew every thing and therefore he did not kill at that time the Dānava, invincible in battle (4). As if urged on by Death the great Asura stole away Krishna's son. And throwing him upon his arms he took him to his own city. His beautiful and accomplished wife Māyāvati, as if the very incarnation of Māyā, had no offspring so that Dānava, as if commissioned by Death, gave over that son of Vasudeva to her like his own (5–7). Seeing him she was filled with joy and her hairs stood erect: she looked at him repeatedly with delight (8). Casting her looks on him in this way she recollected that he was her favourite husband. Remembering it she again thought (9) "He is my lord for whom I am day and night plunged into the lake of anxiety and sorrow and have not been able to enjoy mental felicity any where (10). He was formerly reduced to ashes by the divine trident handed deity stricken with sorrow for Sati. Now he has been seen by me in another birth (11). However, being his wife and knowing him as my husband how can I give him milk and address him as my
verses.hindi: उसने चौंसठ पैने बाणों से श्रीकृष्णको बींध डाला । तब जनार्दनने भी समरमें सत्तर बाण मारकर रुक्मीसे बदला चुका लिया
verses.wordMeaning: Vaishampāyana said:—Kāma (Cupid) of firm vows, in order to kill Shamvara, took his birth from Rukshmini, the incarnation of Lakshmi, and Vāsudeva as his beautiful son Pradyumna.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vaishampāyana said:—Kāma (Cupid) of firm vows, in order to kill Shamvara, took his birth from Rukshmini, the incarnation of Lakshmi, and Vāsudeva as his beautiful son Pradyumna.…
verses.science: सुन्दर वस्त्रधारी किन्नर, अन्यान्य पशुगणोंके साथ गौएँ, मनुष्य, चराचर प्राणी, पृथ्वीको धारण करनेवाले पर्वत, बैल और मृग, चार दाँतवाले तथा कमलकी-सी कान्तिवाले श…। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: यतमानस्य चिच्छेद ध्वजं चास्य महाबलः । जहार च शिरः कायात्सारथेस्तस्य वीर्यवान् ॥ ९ ॥
verses.transliteration: yatamānasya ciccheda dhvajaṃ cāsya mahābalaḥ | jahāra ca śiraḥ kāyātsārathestasya vīryavān || 9 ||
verses.translation: Thinking thus Māyāvati handed over the baby to the nurse and soon reared him up with nourishing tonics. Informed by the nurse and out of ignorance Rukshmini's son knew Māyāvati as his mother (13–14). Having brought up that lotus-eyed son of the Lord of Kamalā Māyāvati too, stricken with lust, instructed him in all forms of illusion (15). When gradually crossing the limit of youth Pradyumna looked highly beautiful, became an expert in the use of all sorts of weapons and in deciphering the movements of women, Māyāvati, assuming the semblance of a beautiful woman, sought the company of her beloved consort and tempted him with her gestures. Seeing that sweet-smiling lady attached to him Pradyumna said to her:—"What is this? Why do you, casting off your maternal feelings, behave in this perverse way? Alas, how wicked are women. How fickle is their mind. Possessed by lust you are not regarding me as your son and behaving otherwise. O gentle lady, what is the cause of such a perversity of nature? Am I not then your son? Why do you behave in this way? I wish to learn the secret of this from you. The nature of women is fickle like lightning. As the clouds are attached to the summits of a mountain so they are attached to men. O gentle lady, it matters little whether I am your son or not. I wish to learn from your own mouth the object of your movements." Thus addressed that timid damsel, having her heart stricken with lust, said to her lover, Keshava's son in a solitary place. "You are not my son, nor Shamvara is your father (17–23). You are a powerful and beautiful descendant of Vrishni; you are the delightful son of Vāsudeva and Rukshmini. After your birth on the seventh day you were brought here. When you were a helpless baby in the lying-in chamber you were stolen by my powerful husband. Tresspassing into the house of your father Vāsudeva, resembling Vasava himself, Shamvara stole you away. Stricken with sorrow for a son like you your mother is bewailing like a cow estranged from its calf. Because you were brought here in your very infancy your father, having the emblem of Garuda on his flag, and more powerful than even Shakra himself, does not know it. O lord, you are a Vrishni prince and not a son of Shamvara. Besides the Dānavas cannot beget a son like yourself. O gentle one, I seek you as my lover, because I have not given birth to you. Seeing your beauty my weak heart is drooping. Besides O Vrishni hero, you should seek in my heart what desire is there. I have thus described to you how you are not a son of myself and Shamvara and how I have grown attached to you (24-33)." Pradyumna, the son of the holder of discus, had mastered all forms of illusion. So thus addressed by Māyāvati and worked up with anger, he, exclaiming his own name, called Shamvara. He said:—"Alas shall I remain here fearing that wicked-souled Dānava who has stolen away the infant son of Keshava? How may that sinful wretch become angry? How can I slay him? I should do what excites his anger. With my sharpened spear I will strike down the wonderful standard with a flying pennon having the emblem of a lion which stands like the mount Sumeru on his gate. If he comes to know of the spoliation of his standard Shamvara will surely come out. I will then kill him in battle and return to Dwārakā." Having said this the large-armed Pradyumna stringed his bow, took up arrows and struck down that jewel of a standard belonging to Shamvara. Hearing of the spoliation of his standard by the high-souled Pradyumna, Shamvara, filled with anger, ordered his sons, saying:—"O ye great heroes, do you soon kill Rukshmini's son (34-41). I do not wish to see him who has done me this wrong." Hearing the words of Shamvara, his sons, Chitrasena, Atisena, Vishwaksenajit, Shrutasena, Sushena, Somasena, Mana, Senāni, Sainyahanta, Senahā, Sainika, Senaskandha, Atisena, Senaka, Janaka, Sukala, Vikala, Shānta, Shāntāntakara, Vibhu, Kumbhaketu, Sudangstra and Keshi, well-armed and delighted, set out for killing Pradyumna. Taking up discuses, Tomaras, tridents, Pattishas, swords, Paraswadhas, and worked up with anger, they, inviting Pradyumna, went to the battle-field (42-47). Thereupon taking up his bow the large-armed Pradyumna speedily ascended his car and drove towards the battle-field (48). Thereupon there took place a dreadful and hair-stirring encounter between Keshava's son and those of Shamvara (49). In order to witness that battle, the Gandharvas, Uragas and Chāranas with all the gods headed by their king stationed themselves in the sky (50). Nārada, Tumvuru, Hāhā, Huhu and other songsters, encircled by Apsaras, also stationed themselves there (51). Then the Gandharva Advutanāma, attached to the court of the king of gods, said to Vāsudeva, the wielder of thunder-bolt: "The sons of Shamvara are a hundred in number and Krishna's son is alone. How can he, fighting alone with many, acquire victory?" (52–53) Hearing his words, Vāsava, the slayer of Bali, smilingly said:—"Hear of his prowess. In his pristine body he was Kāma and consumed by Hara's fiery anger. Afterwards propitiated by his wife the three-eyed deity conferred on her, a boon, saying:—'When Vishnu, assuming the semblance of a man, will live in the city of Dwāraka, he will take his birth as his son and become your husband. This your highly powerful and energetic husband, although celebrated in the three worlds, as Ananga _limbless_, will take his birth there and kill Shamvara, for the seventh day after Pradyumna's birth, Shamvara, resorting to this illusory powers, will steal him away from Rukshmini's lap (54-58). Therefore go to Shamvara's house; and hidden under your illusory body do you become his wife Mayavati and please him. There nourish your baby husband. When he will attain to youth he will kill Shamvara. Afterwards Ananga will go with you to Dwarakā and he will enjoy with you in the same way as I do with _Girijā_.' Having said this the king of gods Hara repaired to the mount Kailāsha resorted to by Siddhas and Charanas and resembling Sumeru. Kāma's wife too, having saluted Uma's husband, waited at Shamvara's residence for the termination of the appointed time. O Pratihara, the large-armed Pradyumna will surely kill Shamvara. He has been destined as the destroyer of that wicked Danava and his sons
verses.hindi: महाबली और पराक्रमी श्रीकृष्णने विजयके लिये प्रयलशील रुक्मीके ध्वजको काट डाला तथा उसके सारथिके सिरको धड़से काट लिया
verses.wordMeaning: Thinking thus Māyāvati handed over the baby to the nurse and soon reared him up with nourishing tonics. Informed by the nurse and out of ignorance Rukshmini's son knew Māyāvati as his mother (13–14). Having brought up that lotus-eyed son of the Lord of Kamalā Māyāvati too,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thinking thus Māyāvati handed over the baby to the nurse and soon reared him up with nourishing tonics. Informed by the nurse and out of ignorance Rukshmini's son knew Māyāvati as his mother (13–14). Having brought up that lotus-eyed son of the Lord of Kamalā Māyāvati too,…
verses.science: नरेश्वर! जो दूसरे गृहस्थ तपस्यासे सिद्ध होते हैं ब्रह्मचर्येण संसिद्धाः परिचर्या गता गुरोः ॥ २६ अथवा जो ब्रह्मचारी गुरुकी सेवा करके ब्रह्मचर्य- क्लेशाधिकै: क…। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं कृच्छ्रगतमाज्ञाय परिवव्रुर्जनार्दनम् । दाक्षिणात्या जिघांसन्तो राजानः सर्व एव हि ॥ १० ॥
verses.transliteration: taṃ kṛcchragatamājñāya parivavrurjanārdanam | dākṣiṇātyā jighāṃsanto rājānaḥ sarva eva hi || 10 ||
verses.hindi: उसे संकटमें पड़ा जान दक्षिण दिशाके समस्त राजाओंने श्रीकृष्णको मार डालनेकी इच्छा रखते हुए उन्हें चारों ओरसे घेर लिया

verses.sanskrit: तमंशुमान् महाबाहुर्विव्याध दशभिः शरैः । श्रुतर्वा पञ्चभिः क्रुद्धो वेणुदारिश्च सप्तभिः ॥ ११ ॥
verses.transliteration: tamaṃśumān mahābāhurvivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ | śrutarvā pañcabhiḥ kruddho veṇudāriśca saptabhiḥ || 11 ||
verses.translation: Shamvara, determined to fight and encircled by thousands of soldiers, struck Pradyumna with thousands of arrows. He, however, displaying quick-handedness, cut those arrows off before they could reach him. And bending his bow he shot arrows that there was none in the army who was not struck with one (24–33). Thus assailed with arrows by Pradyumna Shamvara's men returned to him in fear. Beholding his men take to their heels, Shamvara, beside himself with anger, ordered his ministers. "At my mandate do ye proceed and strike my enemy's son. Do not neglect him but kill him at once. If neglected he will ultimately ruin us like a disease disregarded in the beginning. If you wish to please me kill this sinful wretch of a wicked soul" (34–37).
verses.hindi: महाबाहु अंशुमानने दस, श्रुतर्वाने पाँच और क्रोधमें भरे हुए वेणुदारिने सात बाणों से उन्हें घायल कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Shamvara, determined to fight and encircled by thousands of soldiers, struck Pradyumna with thousands of arrows. He, however, displaying quick-handedness, cut those arrows off before they could reach him.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Shamvara, determined to fight and encircled by thousands of soldiers, struck Pradyumna with thousands of arrows. He, however, displaying quick-handedness, cut those arrows off before they could reach him.…
verses.science: ब्रह्मजीके महायज्ञका वर्णन धातुसंर्चितशिले समे निस्तृणकण्टके त्रयाणां ब्रह्मवेदानां पश्चञस्वरविराजिते। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽशुमन्तं गोविन्दो बिभेदोरसि वीर्यवान् । निषसाद रथोपस्थे व्यथितः स नराधिपः ॥ १२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato'śumantaṃ govindo bibhedorasi vīryavān | niṣasāda rathopasthe vyathitaḥ sa narādhipaḥ || 12 ||
verses.translation: Obeying Shamvara's command and filled with anger the ministers drove their cars showering arrows. Seeing them run towards the battle-field the powerful Pradyumna was worked up with anger. Quickly taking up his bow he stood there. The highly powerful Pradyumna, the enhancer of the delight of Rukshmini, in anger, struck Durdhara with twenty-five arrows, Ketumāli with sixty three, Satruhanta with seventy and Pramarddana with eighty two. Thereat filled with anger the ministers covered Pradyumna with a downpour of arrows. Indeed it appeared highly wonderful. Each of them shot at him severally one hundred and twenty arrows (38–42). Makaradwaja (Pradyumna) cut them all off before they could hurt him. Afterwards, taking up a crescent-shaped arrow he killed with it Durdhara's charioteer before the very eyes of the soldiers and warriors. The very next moment with four beautiful Kanka-feathered arrows he killed his four horses, with one arrow he cut off the umbrella and rein, with another the standard and crest and with sixty other arrows the axles, wheels and poles. Thereupon taking up another powerful Kanka-feathered arrow he shot it at the breast of the short-lived Durdhara. Deprived of his life, beauty, vitality and lustre the Danava fell down from his car like a planet of waning piety.
verses.hindi: तब पराक्रमी गोविन्दने एक बाणसे अंशुमान्‌की छाती छेद डाली । इससे व्यथित होकर राजा अंशुमानू रथके पिछले भागमें जा बैठा

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतर्वणो जघानाश्वांश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरः शरैः । वेणुदारेर्ध्वजं छित्त्वा भुजं विव्याध दक्षिणम् ॥ १३ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrutarvaṇo jaghānāśvāṃścaturbhiścaturaḥ śaraiḥ | veṇudārerdhvajaṃ chittvā bhujaṃ vivyādha dakṣiṇam || 13 ||
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात्‌ श्रीकृष्णने चार बाणोंसे श्रुतवाकि चारों घोड़ोंको मार डाला और वेणुदारिकी ध्वजा काटकर उसकी दाहिनी बाँहमें गहरी चोट पहुँचायी

verses.science: त्रिधा प्रणीतो ज्वलनो मुनिभिर्वेदपारगैः। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथैव च श्रुतर्वाणं शरैर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः । शिश्रिये स ध्वजं शान्तो न्यषीदच्च व्यथान्वितः ॥ १४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tathaiva ca śrutarvāṇaṃ śarairvivyādha pañcabhiḥ | śiśriye sa dhvajaṃ śānto nyaṣīdacca vyathānvitaḥ || 14 ||
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार श्रुतर्वाको भी पाँच बाणोंसे घायल कर दिया । श्रुतर्वा व्यथासे पीड़ित हो ध्वजका सहारा ले शान्त होकर बैठ गया

The highly powerful Pradyumna, the enhancer of the delight of Rukshmini, in anger, struck Durdhara with twenty-five arrows, Ketumāli with sixty three, Satruhanta with seventy and Pramarddana with eighty two. verses.explanation: स ब्रह्मा प्रथमं तस्मिन्नग्रिमयं प्रवर्तयत् न ह्ाल्पं विहितं द्रव्यं यथाग्रिर्यज्ञकर्मणि। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: स ब्रह्मा प्रथमं तस्मिन्नग्रिमयं प्रवर्तयत् न ह्ाल्पं विहितं द्रव्यं यथाग्रिर्यज्ञकर्मणि। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: मुञ्चन्तः शरवर्षाणि वासुदेवं ततोऽभ्ययुः । क्रथकैशिकमुख्याश्च सर्व एव महारथाः ॥ १५ ॥
verses.transliteration: muñcantaḥ śaravarṣāṇi vāsudevaṃ tato'bhyayuḥ | krathakaiśikamukhyāśca sarva eva mahārathāḥ || 15 ||
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात्‌ क्रथकैशिक देशके सभी मुख्य महारथी बाणोंकी वर्षा करते हुए भगवान्‌ श्रीकृष्णपर चढ़ आये

verses.sanskrit: बाणैर्बाणांश्च चिच्छेद तेषां युधि जनार्दनः । जघान चैषां संरब्धः पतमानांश्च ताञ्छरान् ॥ १६ ॥
verses.transliteration: bāṇairbāṇāṃśca ciccheda teṣāṃ yudhi janārdanaḥ | jaghāna caiṣāṃ saṃrabdhaḥ patamānāṃśca tāñcharān || 16 ||
verses.hindi: श्रीकृष्णने युद्धस्थलमें अपने बाणोंद्वारा उन सबके बाण काट डाले तथा रोषावेशमें भरकर उन्होंने शत्रु ओंके उन गिरते हुए बाणोंको नष्ट कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: पुनरन्यांश्चतुःषष्ट्या जघान निशितैः शरैः । क्रुद्धानापततो वीरानद्रिवत् स महाबलः ॥ १७ ॥
verses.transliteration: punaranyāṃścatuḥṣaṣṭyā jaghāna niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ | kruddhānāpatato vīrānadrivat sa mahābalaḥ || 17 ||
verses.hindi: पर्वतके समान अविचल भावसे खड़े हुए उन महाबली श्रीकृष्णने पुनः चौंसठ पैने बाणोंद्वारा क्रोधमें भरकर अपनेपर आक्रमण करनेवाले शत्रुपक्षके अन्य वीरोंको मार गिराया

verses.sanskrit: विद्रुतं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा रुक्मी क्रोधवशङ्गतः । पञ्चभिर्निशितैर्बाणैर्विव्याधोरसि केशवम् ॥ १८ ॥
verses.transliteration: vidrutaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā rukmī krodhavaśaṅgataḥ | pañcabhirniśitairbāṇairvivyādhorasi keśavam || 18 ||
verses.hindi: अपनी सेनाको भागती देख रुक्मी क्रोधके वशीभूत हो गया। उसने पाँच तीखे बाणोंसे श्रीकृष्णकी छातीमें गहरी चोट पहुँचायी
verses.translation: Obeying Shamvara's command and filled with anger the ministers drove their cars showering arrows. Seeing them run towards the battle-field the powerful Pradyumna was worked up with anger. Quickly taking up his bow he stood there. The highly powerful Pradyumna, the enhancer of the delight of Rukshmini, in anger, struck Durdhara with twenty-five arrows, Ketumāli with sixty three, Satruhanta with seventy and Pramarddana with eighty two. Thereat filled with anger the ministers covered Pradyumna with a downpour of arrows. Indeed it appeared highly wonderful. Each of them shot at him severally one hundred and twenty arrows (38–42). Makaradwaja (Pradyumna) cut them all off before they could hurt him. Afterwards, taking up a crescent-shaped arrow he killed with it Durdhara's charioteer before the very eyes of the soldiers and warriors. The very next moment with four beautiful Kanka-feathered arrows he killed his four horses, with one arrow he cut off the umbrella and rein, with another the standard and crest and with sixty other arrows the axles, wheels and poles. Thereupon taking up another powerful Kanka-feathered arrow he shot it at the breast of the short-lived Durdhara. Deprived of his life, beauty, vitality and lustre the Danava fell down from his car like a planet of waning piety.
verses.explanation: कर्म प्राप्रैश्व वसुभि: कर्मभिश्च परान्वितै:। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: कर्म प्राप्रैश्व वसुभि: कर्मभिश्च परान्वितै:। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: सारथिं चास्य विव्याध सायकैर्निशितैस्त्रिभिः । आजघान शरेणास्य ध्वजं च नतपर्वणा ॥ १९ ॥
verses.transliteration: sārathiṃ cāsya vivyādha sāyakairniśitaistribhiḥ | ājaghāna śareṇāsya dhvajaṃ ca nataparvaṇā || 19 ||
verses.hindi: साथ ही तीन पैने सायकोंसे उनके सारथिको भी घायल कर दिया और झुकी हुई गाँठवाले एक बाणसे उनके ध्वजपर भी आघात किया

verses.sanskrit: केशवस्त्वरितं दृष्ट्वा क्रुद्धो विव्याध मार्गणैः । धनुश्चिच्छेद चाप्यस्य यतमानस्य रुक्मिणः ॥ २० ॥
verses.transliteration: keśavastvaritaṃ dṛṣṭvā kruddho vivyādha mārgaṇaiḥ | dhanuściccheda cāpyasya yatamānasya rukmiṇaḥ || 20 ||
verses.hindi: रुक्मीको शीघ्रतापूर्वक बाण मारते देख श्रीकृष्ण कुपित हो उठे। उन्होंने अपने बाणोंसे रुक्मीको घायल कर दिया और विजयके लिये प्रय्रशील हुए रुक्मीके धनुषको भी काट डाला

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय रुक्मी कृष्णजिघांसया । प्रादुश्चकार चान्यानि दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि वीर्यवान् ॥ २१ ॥
verses.transliteration: athānyad dhanurādāya rukmī kṛṣṇajighāṃsayā | prāduścakāra cānyāni divyānyastrāṇi vīryavān || 21 ||
verses.hindi: फिर तो पराक्रमी रुक्मी दूसरा धनुष हाथमें लेकर श्रीकृष्णको मार डालनेकी इच्छासे दूसरे-दूसरे दिव्यास्त्र प्रकट करने लगा

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य तस्य कृष्णो महाबलः । पुनश्चिच्छेद तच्चापं रथेषां च त्रिभिः शरैः ॥ २२ ॥
verses.transliteration: astrairastrāṇi saṃvārya tasya kṛṣṇo mahābalaḥ | punaściccheda taccāpaṃ ratheṣāṃ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ || 22 ||
verses.hindi: महाबली श्रीकृष्णने अपने अस्त्रोंद्वारा उसके अस्त्रोंका निवारण करके पुन: तीन बाणोंद्वारा उसके धनुष और रथके हरसेको काट डाला

verses.sanskrit: स च्छिन्नधन्वा विरथः खड्गमादाय चर्म च । उत्पपात रथाद् वीरो गरुत्मानिव वीर्यवान् ॥ २३ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa cchinnadhanvā virathaḥ khaḍgamādāya carma ca | utpapāta rathād vīro garutmāniva vīryavān || 23 ||
verses.hindi: धनुष कट जानेपर रथहीन हुआ पराक्रमी वीर रुक्मी हाथमें ढाल और तलवार लेकर उस टूटे रथसे गरुड़की भाँति कूद पड़ा

verses.sanskrit: तस्याभिपततः खड्गं चिच्छेद युधि केशवः । नाराचैश्च त्रिभिः क्रुद्धो बिभेदैनमथोरसि ॥ २४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasyābhipatataḥ khaḍgaṃ ciccheda yudhi keśavaḥ | nārācaiśca tribhiḥ kruddho bibhedainamathorasi || 24 ||
verses.hindi: युद्धमें अपने सामने आते हुए रुक्मीकी तलवारको श्रीकृष्णने काट डाला और कुपित होकर तीन नाराचोंसे उसकी छाती छेद डाली
verses.translation: Obeying Shamvara's command and filled with anger the ministers drove their cars showering arrows. Seeing them run towards the battle-field the powerful Pradyumna was worked up with anger. Quickly taking up his bow he stood there. The highly powerful Pradyumna, the enhancer of the delight of Rukshmini, in anger, struck Durdhara with twenty-five arrows, Ketumāli with sixty three, Satruhanta with seventy and Pramarddana with eighty two. Thereat filled with anger the ministers covered Pradyumna with a downpour of arrows. Indeed it appeared highly wonderful. Each of them shot at him severally one hundred and twenty arrows (38–42). Makaradwaja (Pradyumna) cut them all off before they could hurt him. Afterwards, taking up a crescent-shaped arrow he killed with it Durdhara's charioteer before the very eyes of the soldiers and warriors. The very next moment with four beautiful Kanka-feathered arrows he killed his four horses, with one arrow he cut off the umbrella and rein, with another the standard and crest and with sixty other arrows the axles, wheels and poles. Thereupon taking up another powerful Kanka-feathered arrow he shot it at the breast of the short-lived Durdhara. Deprived of his life, beauty, vitality and lustre the Danava fell down from his car like a planet of waning piety.
verses.explanation: परिग्रह शुभं धर्ममविद्यालक्षणं विदुः यदि चेन्मुनिशब्देन गृह्मते ब्रह्मगादिभि: आते-जाते दिखायी देते थे। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: परिग्रह शुभं धर्ममविद्यालक्षणं विदुः यदि चेन्मुनिशब्देन गृह्मते ब्रह्मगादिभि: आते-जाते दिखायी देते थे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स पपात महाबाहुर्वसुधामनुनादयन् । विसंज्ञो मूर्च्छितो राजा वज्रेणेव महासुरः ॥ २५ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa papāta mahābāhurvasudhāmanunādayan | visaṃjño mūrcchito rājā vajreṇeva mahāsuraḥ || 25 ||
verses.hindi: तब संज्ञाशून्य हुआ महाबाहु राजा रुक्मी पृथ्वीको प्रतिध्वनित करता हुआ मूर्च्छित होकर गिर पड़ा, मानो कोई महान्‌ असुर वज़से मारा गया हो

verses.sanskrit: तांश्च राज्ञः शरैः सर्वान् पुनर्विव्याध माधवः । रुक्मिणं पतितं दृष्ट्वा व्यद्रवन्त नराधिपाः ॥ २६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāṃśca rājñaḥ śaraiḥ sarvān punarvivyādha mādhavaḥ | rukmiṇaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyadravanta narādhipāḥ || 26 ||
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर माधवने पुन: अपने बाणोंद्वारा उन सब नरेशोंको घायल करना आरम्भ किया। रुक्मीको धराशायी हुआ देख सब नरेश भाग खड़े हुए

verses.sanskrit: विचेष्टमानं तं भूमौ भ्रातरं वीक्ष्य रुक्मिणी । पादयोर्न्यपतद् विष्णोर्भ्रातुर्जीवितकाङ्क्षिणी ॥ २७ ॥
verses.transliteration: viceṣṭamānaṃ taṃ bhūmau bhrātaraṃ vīkṣya rukmiṇī | pādayornyapatad viṣṇorbhrāturjīvitakāṅkṣiṇī || 27 ||
verses.hindi: अपने भाईको भूमिपर छटपटाते देख उसके जीवनकी इच्छा रखनेवाली रुक्मिणी भगवान्‌ श्रीकृष्णके पैरॉपर गिर पड़ी

verses.sanskrit: तामुत्थाप्य परिष्वज्य सान्त्वयामास केशवः । अभयं रुक्मिणे दत्त्वा प्रययौ स्वपुरीं ततः ॥ २८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāmutthāpya pariṣvajya sāntvayāmāsa keśavaḥ | abhayaṃ rukmiṇe dattvā prayayau svapurīṃ tataḥ || 28 ||
verses.hindi: तब भगवान्‌ श्रीकृष्णने उसे उठाकर हृदयसे लगा लिया और भलीभाँति सान्त्वना दी। फिर रुक्मीको अभय देकर वे अपनी पुरीको चले गये
verses.translation: Obeying Shamvara's command and filled with anger the ministers drove their cars showering arrows. Seeing them run towards the battle-field the powerful Pradyumna was worked up with anger. Quickly taking up his bow he stood there. The highly powerful Pradyumna, the enhancer of the delight of Rukshmini, in anger, struck Durdhara with twenty-five arrows, Ketumāli with sixty three, Satruhanta with seventy and Pramarddana with eighty two. Thereat filled with anger the ministers covered Pradyumna with a downpour of arrows. Indeed it appeared highly wonderful. Each of them shot at him severally one hundred and twenty arrows (38–42). Makaradwaja (Pradyumna) cut them all off before they could hurt him. Afterwards, taking up a crescent-shaped arrow he killed with it Durdhara's charioteer before the very eyes of the soldiers and warriors. The very next moment with four beautiful Kanka-feathered arrows he killed his four horses, with one arrow he cut off the umbrella and rein, with another the standard and crest and with sixty other arrows the axles, wheels and poles. Thereupon taking up another powerful Kanka-feathered arrow he shot it at the breast of the short-lived Durdhara. Deprived of his life, beauty, vitality and lustre the Danava fell down from his car like a planet of waning piety.
verses.explanation: हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: हैं। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: वृष्णयोऽपि जरासन्धं भङ्क्त्वा तांश्चैव पार्थिवान् । प्रययुर्द्वारकां हृष्टाः पुरस्कृत्य हलायुधम् ॥ २९ ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛṣṇayo'pi jarāsandhaṃ bhaṅktvā tāṃścaiva pārthivān | prayayurdvārakāṃ hṛṣṭāḥ puraskṛtya halāyudham || 29 ||
verses.hindi: वृष्णिवंशी भी जरासंध तथा उन राजाओंको पीछे हटाकर हर्षसे उल्लसित हो बलरामजीको आगे करके द्वारकापुरीकी ओर चल दिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रयाते पुण्डरीकाक्षे श्रुतर्वाभ्येत्य सङ्गरे । रुक्मिणं रथमारोप्य प्रययौ स्वां पुरीं प्रति ॥ ३० ॥
verses.transliteration: prayāte puṇḍarīkākṣe śrutarvābhyetya saṅgare | rukmiṇaṃ rathamāropya prayayau svāṃ purīṃ prati || 30 ||
verses.hindi: कमलनयन श्रीकृष्णके चले जानेपर श्रुतर्वा रणभूमिमें आया और रुक्मीको रथपर बिठाकर अपनी पुरीकी ओर ले चला

verses.sanskrit: अनानीय स्वसारं तु रुक्मी मानमदान्वितः । हीनप्रतिज्ञो नैच्छत् स प्रवेष्टुं कुण्डिनं पुरम् ॥ ३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: anānīya svasāraṃ tu rukmī mānamadānvitaḥ | hīnapratijño naicchat sa praveṣṭuṃ kuṇḍinaṃ puram || 31 ||
verses.hindi: अभिमान और मदसे उन्मत्त रहनेवाला रुक्मी अपनी बहिनको लौटाकर न ला सका, इसलिये उसकी प्रतिज्ञा भड्भ हो गयी । इसीसे उसने कुण्डिनपुरमें प्रवेश करनेकी इच्छा नहीं की

verses.sanskrit: विदर्भेषु निवासार्थं निर्ममेऽन्यत् पुरं महत् । तद् भोजकटमित्येव बभूव भुवि विश्रुतम् ॥ ३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: vidarbheṣu nivāsārthaṃ nirmame'nyat puraṃ mahat | tad bhojakaṭamityeva babhūva bhuvi viśrutam || 32 ||
verses.hindi: उसने विदर्भ देशमें अपने रहनेके लिये दूसरे विशाल नगरका निर्माण किया, जो इस भूतलपर भोजकटके नामसे विख्यात हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तत्रौजसा महातेजा दक्षिणां दिशमन्वगात् । भीष्मकः कुण्डिने चैव राजोवास महाभुजः ॥ ३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatraujasā mahātejā dakṣiṇāṃ diśamanvagāt | bhīṣmakaḥ kuṇḍine caiva rājovāsa mahābhujaḥ || 33 ||
verses.hindi: उस महातेजस्वी वीरने वहाँ बलपूर्वक रहकर दक्षिण दिशाका शासन किया और महाबाहु राजा भीष्मक कुण्डिनपुरमें रहने लगे

verses.sanskrit: द्वारकां चापि सम्प्राप्ते रामे वृष्णिबलान्विते । रुक्मिण्याः केशवः पाणिं जग्राह विधिवत्प्रभुः ॥ ३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: dvārakāṃ cāpi samprāpte rāme vṛṣṇibalānvite | rukmiṇyāḥ keśavaḥ pāṇiṃ jagrāha vidhivatprabhuḥ || 34 ||
verses.hindi: वृष्णिवंशियोंकी सेनाके साथ जब बलरामजी द्वारकामें पहुँचे, तब भगवान्‌ श्रीकृष्णने विधिपूर्वक रुक्मिणीका पाणिग्रहण किया

verses.sanskrit: ततः सह तया रेमे प्रियया प्रीयमाणया । सीतयेव पुरा रामः पौलोम्येव पुरन्दरः ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saha tayā reme priyayā prīyamāṇayā | sītayeva purā rāmaḥ paulomyeva purandaraḥ || 35 ||
verses.hindi: पूर्वकालमें जैसे श्रीरामचन्द्रजी सीता और देवराज इन्द्र पुलोमकुमारी शचीके साथ सानन्द रमण करते थे, उसी प्रकार भगवान्‌ श्रीकृष्ण प्रसन्न हुई प्रिय पत्नी रुक्मिणीके साथ रमण करने लगे
verses.translation: Obeying Shamvara's command and filled with anger the ministers drove their cars showering arrows. Seeing them run towards the battle-field the powerful Pradyumna was worked up with anger. Quickly taking up his bow he stood there. The highly powerful Pradyumna, the enhancer of the delight of Rukshmini, in anger, struck Durdhara with twenty-five arrows, Ketumāli with sixty three, Satruhanta with seventy and Pramarddana with eighty two. Thereat filled with anger the ministers covered Pradyumna with a downpour of arrows. Indeed it appeared highly wonderful. Each of them shot at him severally one hundred and twenty arrows (38–42). Makaradwaja (Pradyumna) cut them all off before they could hurt him. Afterwards, taking up a crescent-shaped arrow he killed with it Durdhara's charioteer before the very eyes of the soldiers and warriors. The very next moment with four beautiful Kanka-feathered arrows he killed his four horses, with one arrow he cut off the umbrella and rein, with another the standard and crest and with sixty other arrows the axles, wheels and poles. Thereupon taking up another powerful Kanka-feathered arrow he shot it at the breast of the short-lived Durdhara. Deprived of his life, beauty, vitality and lustre the Danava fell down from his car like a planet of waning piety.
verses.explanation: जो जंगली फल-मूलोंसे जीवन-निर्वाह करते हुए वानप्रस्थोचित कर्म करते थे, अग्रिहोत्रके नियममें निष्णात थे, क्रोधको जीतकर चित्तको एकाग्र रखनेवाले थे, वे ब्राह्मणश…। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: जो जंगली फल-मूलोंसे जीवन-निर्वाह करते हुए वानप्रस्थोचित कर्म करते थे, अग्रिहोत्रके नियममें निष्णात थे, क्रोधको जीतकर चित्तको एकाग्र रखनेवाले थे, वे ब्राह्मणश…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सा हि तस्याभवज्ज्येष्ठा पत्नी कृष्णस्य भामिनी । पतिव्रता गुणोपेता रूपशीलगुणान्विता ॥ ३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sā hi tasyābhavajjyeṣṭhā patnī kṛṣṇasya bhāminī | pativratā guṇopetā rūpaśīlaguṇānvitā || 36 ||
verses.hindi: वह श्रीकृष्णकी ज्येष्ठ पत्नी थी। भामिनी रुक्मिणी पतित्रता, सद्गुणवती, रूपवती, सुशीला तथा अन्यान्य उत्तम गुणोंसे सम्पन्न थी

Seeing them run towards the battle-field the powerful Pradyumna was worked up with anger. Quickly taking up his bow he stood there. The highly powerful Pradyumna, the enhancer of the delight of Rukshmini, in anger, struck Durdhara with twenty-five arrows, Ketumāli with sixty three, Satruhanta with seventy and Pramarddana with eighty two. verses.sanskrit: तस्यामुत्पादयामास पुत्रान् दश महारथान् । चारुदेष्णं सुदेष्णं च प्रद्युम्नं च महाबलम् ॥ ३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasyāmutpādayāmāsa putrān daśa mahārathān | cārudeṣṇaṃ sudeṣṇaṃ ca pradyumnaṃ ca mahābalam || 37 ||
verses.hindi: बल और पराक्रमसे युक्त श्रीकृष्णने रुक्मिणीके गर्भसे दस पराक्रमी पुत्र उत्पन्न किये, जिनके नाम इस प्रकार हैं—चारुदेष्ण, सुदेष्ण, महाबली प्रद्युप्र, सुषेण, चारुगुप्त, चारुबाहु, चारुविन्द, सुचारु, भद्रचारु तथा बलवानोंमें श्रेष्ठ चारु। इनके सिवा एक कन्याको भी उन्होंने जन्म दिया, जिसका नाम चारुमती था। वे सभी पुत्र धर्म और अर्थमें कुशल, अस्त्र-शस्त्रोंके ज्ञाता तथा युद्धमें उन्मत्त होकर लड़नेवाले वीर थे

Seeing them run towards the battle-field the powerful Pradyumna was worked up with anger. Quickly taking up his bow he stood there. verses.sanskrit: महिषीरष्ट कल्याणीस्ततोऽन्या मधुसूदनः । उपयेमे महाबाहुर्गुणोपेताः कुलोद्भवाः ॥ ४० ॥
verses.transliteration: mahiṣīraṣṭa kalyāṇīstato'nyā madhusūdanaḥ | upayeme mahābāhurguṇopetāḥ kulodbhavāḥ || 40 ||
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर महाबाहु मधुसूदनने कल्याणस्वरूपा सद्गुणवती तथा उत्तम कुलमें उत्पन्न हुई अन्य आठ पटरानियोंके साथ विवाह किया, जिनके नाम इस प्रकार हैं- १, (सूर्य-पुत्री) कालिन्दी, २. (श्रीकृष्णकी बुआ राजाधिदेवीके गर्भसे अवन्ती देशमें उत्पन्न हुई) मित्रविन्दा, ३. ( अयोध्यानरेश) नग्रजित्‌की पुत्री सत्या, ४, जाम्बवानूकी पुत्री जाम्बवती, ५. इच्छानुसार रूप धारण करनेवाली रोहिणी (जिसका दूसरा नाम भद्रा था। केकयनरेशकी पुत्री होनेसे यही कैकेयी कहलाती थी। यह श्रीकृष्णकी बुआ श्रुतकीर्तिकी कन्या थी।), ६. मद्रराजकी सुशीला एवं शुभलोचना पुत्री मनोहर मुसकानवाली लक्ष्मणा, ७. सत्राजित्‌की पुत्री सत्यभामा, ८. राजा शैब्यकी तन्वद्जी पुत्री (गान्धारी), जो रूपमें अप्सराके समान थी। इनके सिवा सोलह हजार और स्त्रियाँ थीं। उन सबके साथ अतुल पराक्रमी श्रीकृष्णने एक ही समय उतने ही रूप धारण करके विवाह किया था॥ ४०-४३ ड ॥ उन सबके वस्त्र और आभूषण बहुमूल्य थे । वे सब-के-सब सम्पूर्ण मनोवाज्छित भोगोंसे सम्पन्न तथा सुख भोगनेके योग्य थीं। उन सबके गर्भसे श्रीकृष्णके सहस्त्रों वीर पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए थे

verses.transliteration: śaibyasya ca sutāṃ tanvīṃ rūpeṇāpsarasopamām | strīsahasrāṇi cānyāni ṣoḍaśātulavikramaḥ || 43 ||

verses.science: विष्णुमेवाग्रणी रुद्रमाह्ययद् युद्धकोविद:। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रुक्मेः पुत्र्या शुभाङ्ग्या स्वयंवरे प्रद्युम्नस्य वरणम्, प्रद्युम्नपुत्र अनिरुद्धस्य रुक्मेः पौत्र्याः रुक्मवत्या सह विवाहं एवं बलरामेण रुक्मेः वधं ततः काले व्यतीते तु रुक्मी महति वीर्यवान् । दुहितुः कारयामास स्वयंवरमरिन्दमः ॥ १ ॥
verses.transliteration: rukmeḥ putryā śubhāṅgyā svayaṃvare pradyumnasya varaṇam, pradyumnaputra aniruddhasya rukmeḥ pautryāḥ rukmavatyā saha vivāhaṃ evaṃ balarāmeṇa rukmeḥ vadhaṃ tataḥ kāle vyatīte tu rukmī mahati vīryavān | duhituḥ kārayāmāsa svayaṃvaramarindamaḥ || 1 ||

verses.sanskrit: तत्राहूता हि राजानो राजपुत्राश्च रुक्मिणा । समाजग्मुर्महावीर्या नानादिग्भ्यः श्रियान्विताः ॥ २ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatrāhūtā hi rājāno rājaputrāśca rukmiṇā | samājagmurmahāvīryā nānādigbhyaḥ śriyānvitāḥ || 2 ||
verses.translation: Beholding Ketumāli slain Shatruhantā and Pramarddana, surrounded by a huge army, ran towards Pradyumna (55). They all hurled at Krishna's son clubs, maces, discuses, nooses, Tomaras, arrows, Bhindhipālas, axes and other weapons simultaneously for killing him. However the heroic Kāma, displaying light-handedness, sundered them with his arrows into many pieces. In anger he so struck with arrows the thousands of elephants, elephant-drives, cars, charioteers and horses that none was seen there who was not wounded (56-59). Grinding their soldiers Pradyumna created a dreadful river there having blood for its water. Pearl necklaces were its many waves, flesh, fat and marrow were the mud, the discuses were the islands, the arrows the whirlpools the cars the beautiful bank, bracelets and ear-rings were tortoises, the flags were the fishes and the elephants were other acquatic animals. The river had the horses for its acquatic animals, the hairs for its mosses, the waist threads for its lotus-stalks, the beautiful faces for its lotuses, the chowries for its swans, the heads for its Timi fishes and the blood for its water. Nobody, especially the weak, could cross that river created by Ananga. If was dreadful, impassable and full of weapons, and it extended the territories of Yama. Having agitated the other bowmen the beautiful son of Rukshmini shot in numerable arrows at Shatruhantā. He too, filled with anger, discharged arrows which fell on Pradyumna's breast. Although wounded with that arrow the powerful son of Keshava did not tremble. He took a mace for killing Shatruhantā who was on the point of death (60-68). That burning Sakti, making a sound like that of Indra's thunder-bolt, discharged by Rukshmini's son, fell down piercing the heart of the enemy (69). With it the heart of the highly powerful Shatruhantā was cut off, his limbs were mutilated and his vital parts and joints were separated. And he fell down vomitting forth blood (70).
verses.hindi: विष्णुश्चाभ्यहनद् हैत्यं कराग्रेण स्तनान्तरे। स पपात महीं तूर्ण जानुभ्यां रुधिरं वमन् न चेैन॑ पतितं हन्ति विष्णुर्युद्धविशारद:ः। बाहुयुद्धे हि समयं मत्वाचिन्त्यपराक्रमः दृढप्रहारिणौ वीरावन्योन्यं विचकर्षतु:। शैलेन्द्राविव युद्धयन्ती पक्षे: पाषाणसंनिभे: विकर्षन्तौ वमन्‍्तौ च अन्योन्यं वसुधातले। गजाविव विषाणाग्रै्नखाग्रैश्व विचेरतु:
verses.wordMeaning: Beholding Ketumāli slain Shatruhantā and Pramarddana, surrounded by a huge army, ran towards Pradyumna (55). They all hurled at Krishna's son clubs, maces, discuses, nooses, Tomaras, arrows, Bhindhipālas, axes and other weapons simultaneously for killing him.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्राजगाम प्रद्युम्नः कुमारैरपरैर्वृतः । सा हि तं चकमे कन्या स च तां शुभलोचनाम् ॥ ३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatrājagāma pradyumnaḥ kumārairaparairvṛtaḥ | sā hi taṃ cakame kanyā sa ca tāṃ śubhalocanām || 3 ||

verses.sanskrit: शुभाङ्गी नाम वैदर्भी कान्तिद्युतिसमन्विता । पृथिव्यामभवत् ख्याता रुक्मिणस्तनया तदा ॥ ४ ॥
verses.transliteration: śubhāṅgī nāma vaidarbhī kāntidyutisamanvitā | pṛthivyāmabhavat khyātā rukmiṇastanayā tadā || 4 ||
verses.translation: Having said this Pramarddana quickly struck Rukshmini's son with his _parigha_. Wounded thus the highly powerful and energetic son of Rukshmini threw up his car with his hands, struck it down to the ground and crushed it. Leaping down then from his car the Danava stood on the ground as a foot-soldier. And taking up his club he hurled it at Keshava's son. Kāma, on the other hand, crushed down Pramarddana with
verses.hindi: उस समय ऋषियोंके मनमें कुछ व्यथा हुई। वे संतप्तचित्त पितामहको आगे करके क्षणभरमें वहाँसे अन्तर्धान हो गये॥ ११ ॥ इधर क्रोधमें भरे हुए मधु-जैसे पिड्नल नेत्रवाले मधुने भगवान् विष्णुके पास पहुँचकर अपने हाथसे उनकी नहीं हुए॥१२॥ तत्पश्चात् भगवान् विष्णुने भी अपने हाथके अग्रभागसे उस हैत्यकी छातीमें चोट की; फिर तो वह रक्त वमन करता हुआ घुटनोंके बल तुरंत पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़ा॥ १३॥ अचिन्त्य पराक्रमी युद्धविशारद भगवान् विष्णुने बाहुयुद्धक्ा अवसर उपस्थित जानकर पृथ्वीपर गिरे हुए उस हैत्यको नहीं मारा॥ १४॥ तदनन्तर मधुका हृदय रोषसे भर गया। वह घुटनोंके सहारे पृथ्वीतलसे उठकर खड़ा हो गया, मानो किसीने इन्द्रध्वज फहरा दिया हो। उस समय वह विष्णुकी ओर इस तरह देख रहा था, मानो अपने नेत्रसे उन्हें जला देगा ॥ १५ ॥ तत्पश्चात् वे दोनों कठोर बातें कहते हुए एक-दूसरेके सामने गर्जने लगे; फिर दोनों दोनोंके वधकी इच्छासे बाहुयुद्धमें परस्पर
