verses.explanation: आरम्भ किया॥ ३२॥ परंतु त्वष्टाने सुवर्णनिर्मित, झुकी हुई गाँठवाले, प्रजजलित तथा महान् वेगशाली सायकोंद्वारा हैत्यके उन बाणोंको काट डाला॥ ३३॥ वे दोनों बलवानू वी…। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: आरम्भ किया॥ ३२॥ परंतु त्वष्टाने सुवर्णनिर्मित, झुकी हुई गाँठवाले, प्रजजलित तथा महान् वेगशाली सायकोंद्वारा हैत्यके उन बाणोंको काट डाला॥ ३३॥ वे दोनों बलवानू वी…। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: सोऽब्रवीत्सहसा देवीं रुक्मिणीं देवतामिव । अयं स देवि सम्प्राप्तः सुतश्चापधरस्तव ॥ २२ ॥
verses.transliteration: so'bravītsahasā devīṃ rukmiṇīṃ devatāmiva | ayaṃ sa devi samprāptaḥ sutaścāpadharastava || 22 ||
verses.hindi: वे सहसा देवताके समान दीप्तिमती देवी वि्मिणीसे बोले-'देवि! यह वही तुम्हारा पुत्र है, जो स समय धनुष धारण करके तुम्हारे पास आया है

verses.sanskrit: अनेन शम्बरं हत्वा मायायुद्धविशारदम् । हृता मायाश्च ताः सर्वा याभिर्देवानबाधयत् ॥ २३ ॥
verses.transliteration: anena śambaraṃ hatvā māyāyuddhaviśāradam | hṛtā māyāśca tāḥ sarvā yābhirdevānabādhayat || 23 ||
verses.hindi: सने मायायुद्धविशारद शम्बरासुरका वध करके उसकी सारी मायाएँ भी हर ली हैं, जिनके बलपर वह देवताओंको पताया करता था

verses.sanskrit: सती चेयं शुभा साध्वी भार्या वै तनयस्य ते । मायावतीति विख्याता शम्बरस्य गृहोषिता ॥ २४ ॥
verses.transliteration: satī ceyaṃ śubhā sādhvī bhāryā vai tanayasya te | māyāvatīti vikhyātā śambarasya gṛhoṣitā || 24 ||
verses.hindi: यह तुम्हारे पुत्रकी सती साध्वी [भलक्षणा पत्नी है। इसका नाम मायावती है। यह शम्बरासुरके रमें चिकालतक रही है
verses.translation: Krishna, at Nārada's request, had already stopped his going. Now seeing the high-souled Kumbhānda before and promising him protection he said:—"O Kumbhānda, I have been pleased with hearing of your good deeds. You will now become the king of this kingdom. I confer this kingdom on you. Live you for ever under my protection and be happy and self-controlled with all your kinsmen." Having thus conferred the kingdom on the high-souled Kumbhānda Janārddana celebrated the wedding festival of Aniruddha. The Divine Regent of fire was present there in person (25–28). After Aniruddha, along with his wife, had bathed himself and been adorned with various ornaments the Apsaras began to cut diverse jokes with him. The Gandharvas sang melodious and auspicious songs and the Apsaras danced thus beautifying that marriage party. Having thus celebrated Aniruddha's nuptials and honored Rudra, the giver of boons, adored even by the celestials the greatly wise Upendra, the victor of enemy's cities and the slayer of his enemies, desired to go away accompanied by the celestials. Beholding Krishna, the destroyer of his enemies, about to start for Dwārakā Kumbhānda, with folded hands, said:—"Hear, O lotus-eyed slayer of Madhu, I have something to communicate unto thee. O Mādhava, Vāna has some cows in charge of Varuna. They give nectar-like milk, drinking which a man becomes highly powerful and invincible in battle" (29–35). After Kumbhānda had said this Hari's mind was filled with joy. And bent on going there he expressed his desire. Thereupon having blessed Keshava the divine Brahmā departed for his own region with the inhabitants thereof. Indra and Maruts, desirous of achieving victory, set out for Dwārakā where Krishna resides. Seated by the goddess on a peacock Ushā, encircled by her friends, started also for Dwārakā. Thereupon Baladeva, Krishna, the highly powerful Pradyumna and energetic Aniruddha sat on Garuda's back. Uprooting the trees and shaking the earth, Garuda, the foremost of birds, went on. When Garuda proceeded all the quarters were agitated, the sky was filled with dust and the sun was shorn of its rays. Having thus vanquished Vāna and ridden on Garuda those foremost of men wended a long distance. Proceeding a long way towards Varuna's region by the etherial way they saw those cows yielding celestial milk. Those cows, of various colours, were grazing in a forest situate on the bank of an ocean. Reading the signs described by Kumbhānda they at once recognized them. Beholding those cows of Vāna the eternal Krishna, the prime cause of the universe, well read in the essence of things and the foremost of strikers, felt a desire for possessing them and said to Garuda (36–46).
verses.explanation: पहले ही गदासे मार डाला था॥ ३९-४०॥ त्वष्टाने धराशायी कर दिये गये, तब वे अश्वहीन रथ और धरतीपर पड़े हुए सारथिको वहीं छोड़कर अपने महान् धनुषको टंकारते हुए पृथ्वी…। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: पहले ही गदासे मार डाला था॥ ३९-४०॥ त्वष्टाने धराशायी कर दिये गये, तब वे अश्वहीन रथ और धरतीपर पड़े हुए सारथिको वहीं छोड़कर अपने महान् धनुषको टंकारते हुए पृथ्वी…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मा च ते शम्बरस्येयं पत्नीति भवतु व्यथा । मन्मथे तु गते नाशं गते चानङ्गतां पुरा ॥ २५ ॥
verses.transliteration: mā ca te śambarasyeyaṃ patnīti bhavatu vyathā | manmathe tu gate nāśaṃ gate cānaṅgatāṃ purā || 25 ||
verses.hindi: यह कहीं शम्बरासुरकी त्री न हो, ऐसी बात सोचकर तुम मनमें व्यथित न होना। र्वकालमें जब कामदेवका शरीर नष्ट हो गया और वे पनज़ हो गये, उस समय उनकी प्यारी पत्नी जो रति पी, वही यह मायावती है। यह शम्बरासुरकी वल्लभा कभी नहीं रही है। यह शुभलक्षणा सुन्दरी सदा मायामयरूपसे री उस दैत्यको मोहमें डाले रखती थी । यह कुमारावस्थामें कभी उसके वशमें नहीं हुई। अपनी मायासे ही एक मनोहर नारीका रूप रचकर उसीको शम्बरासुरके शयनागारमें पविष्ट करती थी'

verses.sanskrit: कामपत्नीं न कान्तैषा शम्बरस्य रतिः प्रिया । मायारूपेण तं दैत्यं मोहयत्यसकृच्छुभा ॥ २६ ॥
verses.transliteration: kāmapatnīṃ na kāntaiṣā śambarasya ratiḥ priyā | māyārūpeṇa taṃ daityaṃ mohayatyasakṛcchubhā || 26 ||

verses.sanskrit: न चैषा तस्य कौमारे वशे तिष्ठति शोभना । आत्ममायामयं कृत्वा रूपं शम्बरमाविशत् ॥ २७ ॥
verses.transliteration: na caiṣā tasya kaumāre vaśe tiṣṭhati śobhanā | ātmamāyāmayaṃ kṛtvā rūpaṃ śambaramāviśat || 27 ||

verses.sanskrit: पत्न्येषा मम पुत्रस्य स्नुषा तव वराङ्गना । लोककान्तस्य साहाय्यं करिष्यति मनोमयम् ॥ २८ ॥
verses.transliteration: patnyeṣā mama putrasya snuṣā tava varāṅganā | lokakāntasya sāhāyyaṃ kariṣyati manomayam || 28 ||
verses.hindi: यह सुन्दरी मेरे पुत्रकी पत्नी तथा तुम्हारी ब्रहू है। यह लोककमनीय रूपवाले प्रद्युम्नकी मनोमय (संकल्पमय) सहायता करेगी

verses.explanation: थे, त्वष्टको घायल कर दिया। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: थे, त्वष्टको घायल कर दिया। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवेशयैनां भवनं पूज्यां ज्येष्ठां स्नुषां मम । चिरं प्रणष्टं च सुतं भजस्व पुनरागतम् ॥ २९ ॥
verses.transliteration: praveśayaināṃ bhavanaṃ pūjyāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ snuṣāṃ mama | ciraṃ praṇaṣṭaṃ ca sutaṃ bhajasva punarāgatam || 29 ||
verses.hindi: यह मेरी आदरणीय ज्येष्ठ बहू है, इसे घरके भीतर ले चलो। चिरकालसे पष्ट हुआ तुम्हारा पुत्र फिर आ गया । इसे अपनाओ '

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं देवी कृष्णेनोदाहृतं तदा । प्रहर्षमतुलं लब्ध्वा रुक्मिणी वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥ ३० ॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ devī kṛṣṇenodāhṛtaṃ tadā | praharṣamatulaṃ labdhvā rukmiṇī vākyamabravīt || 30 ||
verses.hindi: वैशम्पायनजी कहते हैं—जनमेजय ! श्रीकृष्णका पह कथन सुनकर उस समय देवी रुक्मिणीको अनुपम डर्ष प्राप्त हुआ। वे बोलीं—

verses.sanskrit: अहो धन्यतरास्मीति वीरपुत्रसमागमात् । अद्य मे सफलः कामः पूर्णो मेऽद्य मनोरथः ॥ ३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: aho dhanyatarāsmīti vīraputrasamāgamāt | adya me saphalaḥ kāmaḥ pūrṇo me'dya manorathaḥ || 31 ||
verses.translation: Krishna said:—"O Garuda, those are the precious kine of Vāna drinking whose milk a man becomes immortal. Do thou soon go there. Satyabhāmā has asked me to take those cows drinking whose milk the great Asuras are not possessed by decrepitude and creatures are freed from fever. She has asked me to take these kine if it does not eface virtue and not to be covetous if it stands in the way of my work. O son of Vinatā, surely these are the kine of which Satyā spoke to me" (47-50).
verses.hindi: अहो! आज अपने तीर पुत्रके मिल जानेसे मैं परम धन्य हो गयी। अब मेरी कामना सफल हो गयी। सम्पूर्ण मनोरथ पूर्ण हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: Krishna said:—"O Garuda, those are the precious kine of Vāna drinking whose milk a man becomes immortal. Do thou soon go there. Satyabhāmā has asked me to take those cows drinking whose milk the great Asuras are not possessed by decrepitude and creatures are freed from fever.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Krishna said:—"O Garuda, those are the precious kine of Vāna drinking whose milk a man becomes immortal. Do thou soon go there. Satyabhāmā has asked me to take those cows drinking whose milk the great Asuras are not possessed by decrepitude and creatures are freed from fever.…
verses.science: विव्याध हैत्यं विंशत्या विशिखेैर्नतपर्वभि:। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: चिरप्रणष्टपुत्रस्य दर्शनं प्रियया सह । आगच्छ पुत्र भवनं सभार्यः प्रविशेह च ॥ ३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: cirapraṇaṣṭaputrasya darśanaṃ priyayā saha | āgaccha putra bhavanaṃ sabhāryaḥ praviśeha ca || 32 ||
verses.hindi: चिरकालसे खोये हुए पुत्रका आज मुझे उसकी पत्नीके साथ दर्शन हुआ। बेटा! आओ, अपनी पत्नीके साथ इस घरके भीतर प्रवेश करो

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽभिवाद्य चरणौ गोविन्दं मातरं च ताम् । प्रद्युम्नः पूजयामास हलिनं च महाबलम् ॥ ३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato'bhivādya caraṇau govindaṃ mātaraṃ ca tām | pradyumnaḥ pūjayāmāsa halinaṃ ca mahābalam || 33 ||
verses.hindi: नदनन्तर प्रद्युम्नने अपने पिता श्रीकृष्ण और माता क्मिणीके चरणोंमें प्रणाम करके अपने ताऊ महाबली डलधरका भी पूजन किया

verses.sanskrit: उत्थाप्य तं परिष्वज्य मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय वीर्यवान् । प्रद्युम्नं बलिनां श्रेष्ठं केशवः परवीरहा ॥ ३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: utthāpya taṃ pariṣvajya mūrdhnyupāghrāya vīryavān | pradyumnaṃ balināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ keśavaḥ paravīrahā || 34 ||
verses.hindi: शत्रुवीरोंका संहार करनेवाले पराक्रमी भगवान्‌ श्रीकृष्णने बलवानोंमें श्रेष्ठ र्युम्नको उठाकर हृदयसे लगाया और मस्तक सूँघकर अपना स्नेह प्रदान किया

verses.sanskrit: स्नुषां चोत्थाप्य तां देवी रुक्मिणी रुक्मभूषणा । परिष्वज्योपसङ्गृह्य स्नेहाद् गद्गदभाषिणी ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: snuṣāṃ cotthāpya tāṃ devī rukmiṇī rukmabhūṣaṇā | pariṣvajyopasaṅgṛhya snehād gadgadabhāṣiṇī || 35 ||
verses.hindi: सोनेके आभूषणोंसे विभूषित हुई देवी रुक्मिणीने अपनी उस पुत्रवधूको उठाकर हृदयसे लगा लिया और उसे सर्वतोभावेन अपनाकर स्नेहसे गदूगद वाणीद्वारा उसका स्वागत केया

verses.sanskrit: समेत्य भवनं पत्न्या शचीन्द्रमदितिर्यथा । प्रवेशयामास तदा रुक्मिणी सुतमागतम् ॥ ३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sametya bhavanaṃ patnyā śacīndramaditiryathā | praveśayāmāsa tadā rukmiṇī sutamāgatam || 36 ||
verses.hindi: जैसे देवमाता अदितिने शची और इन्द्रको रेवभवनमें प्रविष्ट किया था, उसी प्रकार रुक्मिणीने पत्नीके साथ आये हुए पुत्रसे मिलकर उसका भवनके भीतर प्रवेश कराया

verses.sanskrit: बलदेवेन प्रद्युम्नाय आह्निकस्तोत्रस्य उपदेशं अत्राश्चर्यात्मकं स्तोत्रमाह्निकं जयतां वर । प्रद्युम्ने द्वारकां प्राप्ते हत्वा तं कालशम्बरम् ॥ १ ॥
verses.transliteration: baladevena pradyumnāya āhnikastotrasya upadeśaṃ atrāścaryātmakaṃ stotramāhnikaṃ jayatāṃ vara | pradyumne dvārakāṃ prāpte hatvā taṃ kālaśambaram || 1 ||

verses.sanskrit: बलदेवेन रक्षार्थं प्रोक्तमाह्निकमुच्यते । यञ्जप्त्वा तु नृपश्रेष्ठ सायं पूतात्मतां व्रजेत् ॥ २ ॥
verses.transliteration: baladevena rakṣārthaṃ proktamāhnikamucyate | yañjaptvā tu nṛpaśreṣṭha sāyaṃ pūtātmatāṃ vrajet || 2 ||

verses.sanskrit: कीर्तितं बलदेवेन विष्णुना चैव कीर्तितम् । धर्मकामैश्च मुनिभिरृषिभिश्चापि कीर्तितम् ॥ ३ ॥
verses.transliteration: kīrtitaṃ baladevena viṣṇunā caiva kīrtitam | dharmakāmaiśca munibhirṛṣibhiścāpi kīrtitam || 3 ||

verses.sanskrit: कर्हिचिद् रुक्मिणीपुत्रो हलिना संयुतो गृहे । उपविष्टः प्रणम्याथ तमुवाच कृताञ्जलिः ॥ ४ ॥
verses.transliteration: karhicid rukmiṇīputro halinā saṃyuto gṛhe | upaviṣṭaḥ praṇamyātha tamuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ || 4 ||

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णानुज महाभाग रोहिणीतनय प्रभो । किञ्चित्स्तोत्रं मम ब्रूहि यज्जप्त्वा निर्भयोऽभवम् ॥ ५ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇānuja mahābhāga rohiṇītanaya prabho | kiñcitstotraṃ mama brūhi yajjaptvā nirbhayo'bhavam || 5 ||

verses.sanskrit: सुरासुरगुरुर्ब्रह्मा पातु मां जगतः पतिः । अथोङ्कारवषट्कारौ सावित्री विधयस्त्रयः ॥ ६ ॥
verses.transliteration: surāsuragururbrahmā pātu māṃ jagataḥ patiḥ | athoṅkāravaṣaṭkārau sāvitrī vidhayastrayaḥ || 6 ||

verses.sanskrit: ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि छन्दांस्याथर्वणानि च । चत्वारस्त्वखिला वेदाः सरहस्याः सविस्तराः ॥ ७ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni chandāṃsyātharvaṇāni ca | catvārastvakhilā vedāḥ sarahasyāḥ savistarāḥ || 7 ||

verses.sanskrit: पुराणमितिहासश्चाखिलान्युपखिलानि च । अङ्गान्युपाङ्गानि तथा व्याख्यातानि च पान्तु माम् ॥ ८ ॥
verses.transliteration: purāṇamitihāsaścākhilānyupakhilāni ca | aṅgānyupāṅgāni tathā vyākhyātāni ca pāntu mām || 8 ||

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम् । इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिस्तथा सत्त्वं रजस्तमः ॥ ९ ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam | indriyāṇi mano buddhistathā sattvaṃ rajastamaḥ || 9 ||

verses.sanskrit: व्यानोदानौ समानश्च प्राणोऽपानश्च पञ्चमः । वायवः सप्त चैवान्ये येष्वायत्तमिदं जगत् ॥ १० ॥
verses.transliteration: vyānodānau samānaśca prāṇo'pānaśca pañcamaḥ | vāyavaḥ sapta caivānye yeṣvāyattamidaṃ jagat || 10 ||

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिरङ्गिरात्रिश्च पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः । भृगुर्वसिष्ठो भगवान् पान्तु ते मां महर्षयः ॥ ११ ॥
verses.transliteration: marīciraṅgirātriśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | bhṛgurvasiṣṭho bhagavān pāntu te māṃ maharṣayaḥ || 11 ||

verses.sanskrit: कश्यपाद्याश्च मुनयश्चतुर्दश दिशो दश । नरनारायणौ देवौ सगणौ पान्तु मां सदा ॥ १२ ॥
verses.transliteration: kaśyapādyāśca munayaścaturdaśa diśo daśa | naranārāyaṇau devau sagaṇau pāntu māṃ sadā || 12 ||

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राश्चैकादश प्रोक्ता आदित्या द्वादशैव तु । अष्टौ च वसवो देवा अश्विनौ द्वौ प्रकीर्तितौ ॥ १३ ॥
verses.transliteration: rudrāścaikādaśa proktā ādityā dvādaśaiva tu | aṣṭau ca vasavo devā aśvinau dvau prakīrtitau || 13 ||

verses.sanskrit: ह्रीःश्रीर्लक्ष्मीः स्वधा पुष्टिर्मेधा तुष्टिः स्मृतिर्धृतिः । अदितिर्दितिर्दनुश्चैव सिंहिका दैत्यमातरः ॥ १४ ॥
verses.transliteration: hrīḥśrīrlakṣmīḥ svadhā puṣṭirmedhā tuṣṭiḥ smṛtirdhṛtiḥ | aditirditirdanuścaiva siṃhikā daityamātaraḥ || 14 ||

verses.sanskrit: हिमवान् हेमकूटश्च निषधः श्वेतपर्वतः । ऋषभः पारियात्रश्च विन्ध्यो वैडूर्यपर्वतः ॥ १५ ॥
verses.transliteration: himavān hemakūṭaśca niṣadhaḥ śvetaparvataḥ | ṛṣabhaḥ pāriyātraśca vindhyo vaiḍūryaparvataḥ || 15 ||

verses.sanskrit: सह्योदयश्च मलयो मेरुमन्दरदर्दुराः । क्रौञ्चकैलासमैनाकाः पान्तु मां धरणीधराः ॥ १६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sahyodayaśca malayo merumandaradardurāḥ | krauñcakailāsamainākāḥ pāntu māṃ dharaṇīdharāḥ || 16 ||

verses.sanskrit: शेषश्च वासुकिश्चैव विशालाक्षश्च तक्षकः । एलापत्रः शुक्लवर्णः कम्बलाश्वतरावुभौ ॥ १७ ॥
verses.transliteration: śeṣaśca vāsukiścaiva viśālākṣaśca takṣakaḥ | elāpatraḥ śuklavarṇaḥ kambalāśvatarāvubhau || 17 ||

verses.sanskrit: हस्तिभद्रः पिटरकः कर्कोटकधनञ्जयौ । तथा पूरणकश्चैव नागश्च करवीरकः ॥ १८ ॥
verses.transliteration: hastibhadraḥ piṭarakaḥ karkoṭakadhanañjayau | tathā pūraṇakaścaiva nāgaśca karavīrakaḥ || 18 ||

verses.sanskrit: सुमनास्यो दधिमुखस्तथा शृङ्गारपिण्डकः । मणिनागश्च भगवांस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः ॥ १९ ॥
verses.transliteration: sumanāsyo dadhimukhastathā śṛṅgārapiṇḍakaḥ | maṇināgaśca bhagavāṃstriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ || 19 ||

verses.sanskrit: नागराडधिकर्णश्च तथा हारिद्रकोऽपरः । एते चान्ये च बहवो ये चान्ये नानुकीर्तिताः ॥ २० ॥
verses.transliteration: nāgarāḍadhikarṇaśca tathā hāridrako'paraḥ | ete cānye ca bahavo ye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ || 20 ||

verses.sanskrit: भूधराः सत्यधर्माणः पान्तु मां भुजगेश्वराः । समुद्राः पान्तु चत्वारो गङ्गा च सरितां वरा ॥ २१ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhūdharāḥ satyadharmāṇaḥ pāntu māṃ bhujageśvarāḥ | samudrāḥ pāntu catvāro gaṅgā ca saritāṃ varā || 21 ||

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वती चन्द्रभागा शतद्रुर्देविका शिवा । द्वारावती विपाशा च सरयूर्यमुना तथा ॥ २२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sarasvatī candrabhāgā śatadrurdevikā śivā | dvārāvatī vipāśā ca sarayūryamunā tathā || 22 ||

verses.sanskrit: कल्माषी च रथोष्मा च बाहुदा च हिरण्यदा । प्लक्षा चेक्षुमती चैव स्रवन्ती च बृहद्रथा ॥ २३ ॥
verses.transliteration: kalmāṣī ca rathoṣmā ca bāhudā ca hiraṇyadā | plakṣā cekṣumatī caiva sravantī ca bṛhadrathā || 23 ||

verses.sanskrit: ख्याता चर्मण्वती चैव पुण्या चैव वधूसरा । एताश्चान्याश्च सरितो याश्चान्या नानुकीर्तिताः ॥ २४ ॥
verses.transliteration: khyātā carmaṇvatī caiva puṇyā caiva vadhūsarā | etāścānyāśca sarito yāścānyā nānukīrtitāḥ || 24 ||

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरापथगामिन्यः सलिलैः स्नपयन्तु माम् । वेणी गोदावरी सीता कावेरी कौङ्कणावती ॥ २५ ॥
verses.transliteration: uttarāpathagāminyaḥ salilaiḥ snapayantu mām | veṇī godāvarī sītā kāverī kauṅkaṇāvatī || 25 ||

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णा वेणा शुक्तिमती तमसा पुष्पवाहिनी । ताम्रपर्णी ज्योतिरथा उत्फलोदुम्बरावती ॥ २६ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇā veṇā śuktimatī tamasā puṣpavāhinī | tāmraparṇī jyotirathā utphalodumbarāvatī || 26 ||

verses.sanskrit: नदी वैतरणी पुण्या विदर्भा नर्मदा शुभा । वितस्ता भीमरथ्या च ऐला चैव महानदी ॥ २७ ॥
verses.transliteration: nadī vaitaraṇī puṇyā vidarbhā narmadā śubhā | vitastā bhīmarathyā ca ailā caiva mahānadī || 27 ||

verses.sanskrit: कालिन्दी गोमती पुण्या नदः शोणश्च विश्रुतः । एताश्चान्याश्च वै नद्यो याश्चान्या न तु कीर्तिताः ॥ २८ ॥
verses.transliteration: kālindī gomatī puṇyā nadaḥ śoṇaśca viśrutaḥ | etāścānyāśca vai nadyo yāścānyā na tu kīrtitāḥ || 28 ||

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणापथवाहिन्यः सलिलैः स्नपयन्तु माम् । क्षिप्रा चर्मण्वती पुण्या मही शुभ्रवती तथा ॥ २९ ॥
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāpathavāhinyaḥ salilaiḥ snapayantu mām | kṣiprā carmaṇvatī puṇyā mahī śubhravatī tathā || 29 ||

verses.sanskrit: सिन्धुर्वेत्रवती चैव भोजान्ता वनमालिका । पूर्वभद्रा पराभद्रा ऊर्मिला च परद्रुमा ॥ ३० ॥
verses.transliteration: sindhurvetravatī caiva bhojāntā vanamālikā | pūrvabhadrā parābhadrā ūrmilā ca paradrumā || 30 ||

verses.sanskrit: ख्याता वेत्रवती चैव चापदासीति विश्रुता । प्रस्थावती कुण्डनदी नदी पुण्या सरस्वती ॥ ३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: khyātā vetravatī caiva cāpadāsīti viśrutā | prasthāvatī kuṇḍanadī nadī puṇyā sarasvatī || 31 ||

verses.sanskrit: चित्रघ्नी चेन्दुमाला च तथा मधुमती नदी । उमा गुरुनदी चैव तापी च विमलोदका ॥ ३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: citraghnī cendumālā ca tathā madhumatī nadī | umā gurunadī caiva tāpī ca vimalodakā || 32 ||

verses.sanskrit: विमला विमलोदा च मत्तगङ्गा पयस्विनी । एताश्चान्याश्च वै नद्यो याश्चान्या नानुकीर्तिताः ॥ ३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: vimalā vimalodā ca mattagaṅgā payasvinī | etāścānyāśca vai nadyo yāścānyā nānukīrtitāḥ || 33 ||

verses.sanskrit: ता मां समभिषिञ्चन्तु पश्चिमामाश्रिता दिशम् । भागीरथी पुण्यजला प्राच्यां दिशि समाश्रिता ॥ ३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tā māṃ samabhiṣiñcantu paścimāmāśritā diśam | bhāgīrathī puṇyajalā prācyāṃ diśi samāśritā || 34 ||

verses.sanskrit: सा तु दहतु मे पापं कीर्तिता शम्भुना धृता । प्रभासं च प्रयागं च नैमिषं पुष्कराणि च ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: sā tu dahatu me pāpaṃ kīrtitā śambhunā dhṛtā | prabhāsaṃ ca prayāgaṃ ca naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca || 35 ||

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गातीर्थं कुरुक्षेत्रं श्रीकण्ठं गौतमाश्रमम् । रामह्रदं विनशनं रामतीर्थं तथैव च ॥ ३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: gaṅgātīrthaṃ kurukṣetraṃ śrīkaṇṭhaṃ gautamāśramam | rāmahradaṃ vinaśanaṃ rāmatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca || 36 ||

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाद्वारं कनखलं सोमो वै यत्र चोत्थितः । कपालमोचनं तीर्थं जम्बूमार्गं च विश्रुतम् ॥ ३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: gaṅgādvāraṃ kanakhalaṃ somo vai yatra cotthitaḥ | kapālamocanaṃ tīrthaṃ jambūmārgaṃ ca viśrutam || 37 ||

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णबिन्दुं विख्यातं तथा कनकपिङ्गलम् । दशाश्वमेधिकं चैव पुण्याश्रमविभूषितम् ॥ ३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: suvarṇabinduṃ vikhyātaṃ tathā kanakapiṅgalam | daśāśvamedhikaṃ caiva puṇyāśramavibhūṣitam || 38 ||

verses.sanskrit: बदरी चैव विख्याता नरनारायणाश्रमः । विख्यातं फल्गुतीर्थं च तीर्थं चन्द्रवटं तथा ॥ ३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: badarī caiva vikhyātā naranārāyaṇāśramaḥ | vikhyātaṃ phalgutīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ candravaṭaṃ tathā || 39 ||

verses.sanskrit: कोकामुखं पुण्यतमं गङ्गासागरमेव च । मगधेषु तपोदश्च गङ्गोद्भेदश्च विश्रुतः ॥ ४० ॥
verses.transliteration: kokāmukhaṃ puṇyatamaṃ gaṅgāsāgarameva ca | magadheṣu tapodaśca gaṅgodbhedaśca viśrutaḥ || 40 ||

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थान्येतानि पुण्यानि सेवितानि महर्षिभिः । मां प्लावयन्तु सलिलैः यानि मे कीर्तितानि वै ॥ ४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tīrthānyetāni puṇyāni sevitāni maharṣibhiḥ | māṃ plāvayantu salilaiḥ yāni me kīrtitāni vai || 41 ||

verses.sanskrit: सूकरं योगमार्गं च श्वेतद्वीपं तथैव च । ब्रह्मतीर्थं रामतीर्थं वाजिमेधशतोपमम् ॥ ४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sūkaraṃ yogamārgaṃ ca śvetadvīpaṃ tathaiva ca | brahmatīrthaṃ rāmatīrthaṃ vājimedhaśatopamam || 42 ||

verses.sanskrit: धारासम्पातसंयुक्ता गङ्गा किल्बिषनाशिनी । गङ्गा वैकुण्ठकेदारं सूकरोदभेदनं परम् । तच्छापमोचनं तीर्थं पुनन्त्वेतानि किल्बिषात् ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: dhārāsampātasaṃyuktā gaṅgā kilbiṣanāśinī | gaṅgā vaikuṇṭhakedāraṃ sūkarodabhedanaṃ param | tacchāpamocanaṃ tīrthaṃ punantvetāni kilbiṣāt || 43 ||

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थकामविषयो यशःप्राप्तिः शमो दमः । वरुणेशोऽथ धनदो यमो नियम एव च ॥ ४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: dharmārthakāmaviṣayo yaśaḥprāptiḥ śamo damaḥ | varuṇeśo'tha dhanado yamo niyama eva ca || 44 ||

verses.sanskrit: कालो नयः सन्नतिश्च क्रोधो मोहः क्षमा धृतिः । विद्युतोऽभ्राण्यथौषध्यः प्रमादोन्मादविग्रहाः ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: kālo nayaḥ sannatiśca krodho mohaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ | vidyuto'bhrāṇyathauṣadhyaḥ pramādonmādavigrahāḥ || 45 ||

verses.sanskrit: यक्षाः पिशाचा गन्धर्वाः किन्नराः सिद्धचारणाः । नक्तञ्चराः खेचरिणो दंष्ट्रिणः प्रियविग्रहाः ॥ ४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: yakṣāḥ piśācā gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ | naktañcarāḥ khecariṇo daṃṣṭriṇaḥ priyavigrahāḥ || 46 ||

verses.sanskrit: लम्बोदराश्च बलिनः पिङ्गाक्षा विश्वरूपिणः । मरुतः सहपर्जन्याः कलात्रुटिलवाः क्षणाः ॥ ४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: lambodarāśca balinaḥ piṅgākṣā viśvarūpiṇaḥ | marutaḥ sahaparjanyāḥ kalātruṭilavāḥ kṣaṇāḥ || 47 ||

verses.sanskrit: नक्षत्राणि ग्रहाश्चैव ऋतवः शिशिरादयः । मासाहोरात्रयश्चैव सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ तथा ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.transliteration: nakṣatrāṇi grahāścaiva ṛtavaḥ śiśirādayaḥ | māsāhorātrayaścaiva sūryācandramasau tathā || 48 ||

verses.sanskrit: आमोदश्च प्रमोदश्च प्रहर्षः शोक एव च । रजस्तमस्तपः सत्यं शुद्धिर्बुद्धिर्धृतिः श्रुतिः ॥ ४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: āmodaśca pramodaśca praharṣaḥ śoka eva ca | rajastamastapaḥ satyaṃ śuddhirbuddhirdhṛtiḥ śrutiḥ || 49 ||

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राणी भद्रकाली च भद्रा ज्येष्ठा तु वारुणी । भासी च कालिका चैव शाण्डिली चेति विश्रुताः ॥ ५० ॥
verses.transliteration: rudrāṇī bhadrakālī ca bhadrā jyeṣṭhā tu vāruṇī | bhāsī ca kālikā caiva śāṇḍilī ceti viśrutāḥ || 50 ||

verses.sanskrit: आर्या कुहूः सिनीवाली भीमा चित्ररथी रतिः । एकानंशा च कूष्माण्डी देवी कात्यायनी च या ॥ ५१ ॥
verses.transliteration: āryā kuhūḥ sinīvālī bhīmā citrarathī ratiḥ | ekānaṃśā ca kūṣmāṇḍī devī kātyāyanī ca yā || 51 ||

verses.sanskrit: लोहित्या जनमाता च देवकन्यास्तु याः स्मृताः । गोनन्दा देवपत्नी च मां रक्षन्तु सबान्धवम् ॥ ५२ ॥
verses.transliteration: lohityā janamātā ca devakanyāstu yāḥ smṛtāḥ | gonandā devapatnī ca māṃ rakṣantu sabāndhavam || 52 ||

verses.sanskrit: नानाभरणवेशाश्च नानारूपाङ्किताननाः । नानादेशविचारिण्यो नानाशस्त्रोपशोभिताः ॥ ५३ ॥
verses.transliteration: nānābharaṇaveśāśca nānārūpāṅkitānanāḥ | nānādeśavicāriṇyo nānāśastropaśobhitāḥ || 53 ||

verses.sanskrit: मेदोमज्जाप्रियाश्चैव मद्यमांसवसाप्रियाः । मार्जारद्वीपिवक्त्राश्च गजसिंहनिभाननाः ॥ ५४ ॥
verses.transliteration: medomajjāpriyāścaiva madyamāṃsavasāpriyāḥ | mārjāradvīpivaktrāśca gajasiṃhanibhānanāḥ || 54 ||

verses.sanskrit: कङ्कवायसगृध्राणां क्रौञ्चतुल्याननास्तथा । व्यालयज्ञोपवीताश्च चर्मप्रावरणास्तद्या ॥ ५५ ॥
verses.transliteration: kaṅkavāyasagṛdhrāṇāṃ krauñcatulyānanāstathā | vyālayajñopavītāśca carmaprāvaraṇāstadyā || 55 ||

verses.sanskrit: क्षतजोक्षितवक्त्राश्च खरभेरीसमस्वनाः । मत्सराः क्रोधनाश्चैव प्रासादा रुचिरालयाः ॥ ५६ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣatajokṣitavaktrāśca kharabherīsamasvanāḥ | matsarāḥ krodhanāścaiva prāsādā rucirālayāḥ || 56 ||

verses.sanskrit: मत्तोन्मत्तप्रमत्ताश्च प्रहरन्त्यश्च धिष्ठिताः । पिङ्गाक्षाः पिङ्गकेशाश्च ततोऽन्या लूनमूर्धजाः ॥ ५७ ॥
verses.transliteration: mattonmattapramattāśca praharantyaśca dhiṣṭhitāḥ | piṅgākṣāḥ piṅgakeśāśca tato'nyā lūnamūrdhajāḥ || 57 ||

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वकेश्यः कृष्णकेश्यः श्वेतकेश्यस्तथावराः । नागायुतबलाश्चैव वायुवेगास्तथापराः ॥ ५८ ॥
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvakeśyaḥ kṛṣṇakeśyaḥ śvetakeśyastathāvarāḥ | nāgāyutabalāścaiva vāyuvegāstathāparāḥ || 58 ||

verses.sanskrit: एकहस्ता एकपादा एकाक्षाः पिङ्गला मताः । बहुपुत्राल्पपुत्राश्च द्विपुत्राः पुत्रमण्डिकाः ॥ ५९ ॥
verses.transliteration: ekahastā ekapādā ekākṣāḥ piṅgalā matāḥ | bahuputrālpaputrāśca dviputrāḥ putramaṇḍikāḥ || 59 ||

verses.sanskrit: मुखमण्डी बिडाली च पूतना गन्धपूतना । शीतवातोष्णवेताली रेवती ग्रहसंज्ञिताः ॥ ६० ॥
verses.transliteration: mukhamaṇḍī biḍālī ca pūtanā gandhapūtanā | śītavātoṣṇavetālī revatī grahasaṃjñitāḥ || 60 ||

verses.sanskrit: प्रियहास्याः प्रियक्रोधाः प्रियवासाः प्रियंवदाः । सुखप्रदाश्चासुखदाः सदा द्विजजनप्रियाः ॥ ६१ ॥
verses.transliteration: priyahāsyāḥ priyakrodhāḥ priyavāsāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ | sukhapradāścāsukhadāḥ sadā dvijajanapriyāḥ || 61 ||

verses.sanskrit: नक्तञ्चराः सुखोदर्काः सदा पर्वणि दारुणाः । मातरो मातृवत्पुत्रं रञ्जन्तु मम नित्यशः ॥ ६२ ॥
verses.transliteration: naktañcarāḥ sukhodarkāḥ sadā parvaṇi dāruṇāḥ | mātaro mātṛvatputraṃ rañjantu mama nityaśaḥ || 62 ||

verses.sanskrit: पितामहमुखोद्भूता रौद्रा रुद्राङ्गसम्भवाः । कुमारस्वेदजाश्चैव ज्वरा वै वैष्णवादयः ॥ ६३ ॥
verses.transliteration: pitāmahamukhodbhūtā raudrā rudrāṅgasambhavāḥ | kumārasvedajāścaiva jvarā vai vaiṣṇavādayaḥ || 63 ||

verses.sanskrit: महाभीमा महावीर्या दर्पोदभूता महाबलाः । क्रोधनाक्रोधनाः क्रूराः सुरविग्रहकारिणः ॥ ६४ ॥
verses.transliteration: mahābhīmā mahāvīryā darpodabhūtā mahābalāḥ | krodhanākrodhanāḥ krūrāḥ suravigrahakāriṇaḥ || 64 ||

verses.sanskrit: नक्तञ्चराः केसरिणो दंष्ट्रिणः प्रियविग्रहाः । लम्बोदरा जघनिनः पिङ्गाक्षा विश्वरूपिणः ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.transliteration: naktañcarāḥ kesariṇo daṃṣṭriṇaḥ priyavigrahāḥ | lambodarā jaghaninaḥ piṅgākṣā viśvarūpiṇaḥ || 65 ||

verses.sanskrit: शक्त्यृष्टिशूलपरिघप्रासचर्मासिपाणयः । पिनाकवज्रमुसलब्रह्मदण्डायुधप्रियाः ॥ ६६ ॥
verses.transliteration: śaktyṛṣṭiśūlaparighaprāsacarmāsipāṇayaḥ | pinākavajramusalabrahmadaṇḍāyudhapriyāḥ || 66 ||

verses.sanskrit: दण्डिनः कुण्डिनः शूरा जटामुकुटधारिणः । वेदवेदाङ्गकुशला नित्ययज्ञोपवीतिनः ॥ ६७ ॥
verses.transliteration: daṇḍinaḥ kuṇḍinaḥ śūrā jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇaḥ | vedavedāṅgakuśalā nityayajñopavītinaḥ || 67 ||

verses.sanskrit: व्यालापीडाः कुण्डलिनो वीराः केयूरधारिणः । नानावस्वनसंवीताश्चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनाः ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.transliteration: vyālāpīḍāḥ kuṇḍalino vīrāḥ keyūradhāriṇaḥ | nānāvasvanasaṃvītāścitramālyānulepanāḥ || 68 ||

verses.sanskrit: गजाश्वोष्ट्रर्क्षमार्जारसिंहव्याघ्रनिभाननाः । वराहोलूकगोमायुमृगाखुमहिषाननाः ॥ ६९ ॥
verses.transliteration: gajāśvoṣṭrarkṣamārjārasiṃhavyāghranibhānanāḥ | varāholūkagomāyumṛgākhumahiṣānanāḥ || 69 ||

verses.sanskrit: वामना विकटाः कुब्जाः कराला लूनमूर्धजाः । सहस्रशतशश्चान्ये सहस्रजटधारिणः ॥ ७० ॥
verses.transliteration: vāmanā vikaṭāḥ kubjāḥ karālā lūnamūrdhajāḥ | sahasraśataśaścānye sahasrajaṭadhāriṇaḥ || 70 ||

verses.sanskrit: श्वेताः कैलाससङ्काशाः केचिद् दिनकरप्रभाः । केचिज्जलदवर्णाभा नीलाञ्जनचयोपमाः ॥ ७१ ॥
verses.transliteration: śvetāḥ kailāsasaṅkāśāḥ kecid dinakaraprabhāḥ | kecijjaladavarṇābhā nīlāñjanacayopamāḥ || 71 ||

verses.sanskrit: एकपादा द्विपादाश्च तथा द्विशिरसोऽपरे । निर्मांसाः स्थूलजङ्घाश्च व्यादितास्या भयङ्कराः ॥ ७२ ॥
verses.transliteration: ekapādā dvipādāśca tathā dviśiraso'pare | nirmāṃsāḥ sthūlajaṅghāśca vyāditāsyā bhayaṅkarāḥ || 72 ||

verses.sanskrit: वापीतडागकूपेषु समुद्रेषु सरित्सु च । श्मशानशैलवृक्षेषु शून्यागारनिवासिनः ॥ ७३ ॥
verses.transliteration: vāpītaḍāgakūpeṣu samudreṣu saritsu ca | śmaśānaśailavṛkṣeṣu śūnyāgāranivāsinaḥ || 73 ||

verses.sanskrit: एते ग्रहाश्च सततं रक्षन्तु मम सर्वतः । महागणपतिर्नन्दी महाकालो महाबलः । माहेश्वरो वैष्णवश्च ज्वरौ लोकभयावहौ ॥ ७४ ॥
verses.transliteration: ete grahāśca satataṃ rakṣantu mama sarvataḥ | mahāgaṇapatirnandī mahākālo mahābalaḥ | māheśvaro vaiṣṇavaśca jvarau lokabhayāvahau || 74 ||

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामणीश्चैव गोपालो भृङ्गरीटिर्गणेश्वरः । देवश्च वामदेवश्च घण्टाकर्णः करन्धमः ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.transliteration: grāmaṇīścaiva gopālo bhṛṅgarīṭirgaṇeśvaraḥ | devaśca vāmadevaśca ghaṇṭākarṇaḥ karandhamaḥ || 75 ||

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतमोदः कपाली च जम्भकः शत्रुतापनः । मज्जनोन्मज्जनौ चोभौ सन्तापनविलापनौ ॥ ७६ ॥
verses.transliteration: śvetamodaḥ kapālī ca jambhakaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ | majjanonmajjanau cobhau santāpanavilāpanau || 76 ||

verses.sanskrit: निजघासोऽघसश्चैव स्थूणाकर्णः प्रशोषणः । उल्कामाली धमधमो ज्वालामाली प्रमर्दनः ॥ ७७ ॥
verses.transliteration: nijaghāso'ghasaścaiva sthūṇākarṇaḥ praśoṣaṇaḥ | ulkāmālī dhamadhamo jvālāmālī pramardanaḥ || 77 ||

verses.sanskrit: सङ्घट्टनः सङ्कुटनः काष्ठभूतः शिवङ्करः । कूष्माण्डः कुम्भमूर्धा च रोचनो वैकृतो ग्रहः ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.transliteration: saṅghaṭṭanaḥ saṅkuṭanaḥ kāṣṭhabhūtaḥ śivaṅkaraḥ | kūṣmāṇḍaḥ kumbhamūrdhā ca rocano vaikṛto grahaḥ || 78 ||

verses.sanskrit: अनिकेतः सुरारिघ्नः शिवश्चाशिव एव च । क्षेमकः पिशिताशी च सुरारिर्हरिलोचनः ॥ ७९ ॥
verses.transliteration: aniketaḥ surārighnaḥ śivaścāśiva eva ca | kṣemakaḥ piśitāśī ca surārirharilocanaḥ || 79 ||

verses.sanskrit: भीमको ग्राहकश्चैव तथैवाग्रमयो ग्रहः । उपग्रहोऽर्यकश्चैव तथा स्कन्दग्रहोऽपरः ॥ ८० ॥
verses.transliteration: bhīmako grāhakaścaiva tathaivāgramayo grahaḥ | upagraho'ryakaścaiva tathā skandagraho'paraḥ || 80 ||

verses.sanskrit: चपलोऽसमवेतालस्तामसः सुमहाकपिः । हृदयोद्वर्तनश्चैडः कुण्डाशी कङ्कणप्रियः ॥ ८१ ॥
verses.transliteration: capalo'samavetālastāmasaḥ sumahākapiḥ | hṛdayodvartanaścaiḍaḥ kuṇḍāśī kaṅkaṇapriyaḥ || 81 ||

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्मश्रुर्गरुत्मन्तो मनोमारुतरंहसः । पार्वत्या रोषसम्भूताः सहस्राणि शतानि च ॥ ८२ ॥
verses.transliteration: hariśmaśrurgarutmanto manomārutaraṃhasaḥ | pārvatyā roṣasambhūtāḥ sahasrāṇi śatāni ca || 82 ||

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिमन्तो धृतिमन्तो ब्रह्मण्याः सत्यसङ्गराः । सर्वकामापहन्तारो द्विषतां च मृधेमृधे ॥ ८३ ॥
verses.transliteration: śaktimanto dhṛtimanto brahmaṇyāḥ satyasaṅgarāḥ | sarvakāmāpahantāro dviṣatāṃ ca mṛdhemṛdhe || 83 ||

verses.sanskrit: रात्रावहनि दुर्गेषु कीर्तिताः सकलैर्गुणैः । तेषां गणानां पतयः सगणाः पान्तु मां सदा ॥ ८४ ॥
verses.transliteration: rātrāvahani durgeṣu kīrtitāḥ sakalairguṇaiḥ | teṣāṃ gaṇānāṃ patayaḥ sagaṇāḥ pāntu māṃ sadā || 84 ||

verses.sanskrit: नारदः पर्वतश्चैव गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः । पितरः कारणं कार्यमाधयो व्याधयस्तथा ॥ ८५ ॥
verses.transliteration: nāradaḥ parvataścaiva gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ | pitaraḥ kāraṇaṃ kāryamādhayo vyādhayastathā || 85 ||

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यो गालवो गार्ग्यः शक्तिर्धीम्यः पराशरः । कृष्णात्रेयश्च भगवानसितो देवलो बलः ॥ ८६ ॥
verses.transliteration: agastyo gālavo gārgyaḥ śaktirdhīmyaḥ parāśaraḥ | kṛṣṇātreyaśca bhagavānasito devalo balaḥ || 86 ||

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुतथ्यश्च मार्कण्डेयः श्रुतश्रवाः । द्वैपायनो विदर्भश्च जैमिनिर्माठरः कठः ॥ ८७ ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatirutathyaśca mārkaṇḍeyaḥ śrutaśravāḥ | dvaipāyano vidarbhaśca jaiminirmāṭharaḥ kaṭhaḥ || 87 ||

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रो वसिष्ठश्च लोमशश्च महामुनिः । उत्तङ्कश्चैव रैभ्यश्च पौलोमश्च द्वितस्त्रितः ॥ ८८ ॥
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitro vasiṣṭhaśca lomaśaśca mahāmuniḥ | uttaṅkaścaiva raibhyaśca paulomaśca dvitastritaḥ || 88 ||

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिर्वै कालवृक्षीयो मुनिर्मेधातिथिस्तथा । सारस्वतो यवक्रीतिः कुशिको गौतमस्तथा ॥ ८९ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣirvai kālavṛkṣīyo munirmedhātithistathā | sārasvato yavakrītiḥ kuśiko gautamastathā || 89 ||

verses.sanskrit: संवर्त ऋष्यशृङ्गश्च स्वस्त्यात्रेयो विभाण्डकः । ऋचीको जमदग्निश्च तथौर्वस्तपसां निधिः ॥ ९० ॥
verses.transliteration: saṃvarta ṛṣyaśṛṅgaśca svastyātreyo vibhāṇḍakaḥ | ṛcīko jamadagniśca tathaurvastapasāṃ nidhiḥ || 90 ||

verses.sanskrit: भरद्वाजः स्थूलशिराः कश्यपः पुलहः क्रतुः । बृहदग्निर्हरिश्मश्रुर्विजयः कण्व एव च ॥ ९१ ॥
verses.transliteration: bharadvājaḥ sthūlaśirāḥ kaśyapaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | bṛhadagnirhariśmaśrurvijayaḥ kaṇva eva ca || 91 ||

verses.sanskrit: वैतण्डी दीर्घतापश्च वेदगाथोंऽशुमाञ्छिवः । अष्टावक्रो दधीचिश्च श्वेतकेतुस्तथैव च ॥ ९२ ॥
verses.transliteration: vaitaṇḍī dīrghatāpaśca vedagāthoṃ'śumāñchivaḥ | aṣṭāvakro dadhīciśca śvetaketustathaiva ca || 92 ||

verses.sanskrit: उद्दालकः क्षीरपाणिः शृङ्गी गौरमुखस्तथा । अग्निवेश्यः शमीकश्च प्रमुचुर्मुमुचुस्तथा ॥ ९३ ॥
verses.transliteration: uddālakaḥ kṣīrapāṇiḥ śṛṅgī gauramukhastathā | agniveśyaḥ śamīkaśca pramucurmumucustathā || 93 ||

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च ऋषयो बहवः शंसितव्रताः । मुनयः शंसितात्मानो ये चान्ये नानुकीर्तिताः ॥ ९४ ॥
verses.transliteration: ete cānye ca ṛṣayo bahavaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ | munayaḥ śaṃsitātmāno ye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ || 94 ||

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोऽग्नयस्त्रयो वेदास्त्रैविद्याः कौस्तुभो मणिः ॥ ९५ ॥
verses.transliteration: trayo'gnayastrayo vedāstraividyāḥ kaustubho maṇiḥ || 95 ||

verses.sanskrit: उच्चैःश्रवा हयः श्रीमान् वैद्यो धन्वन्तरिर्हरिः । अमृतं गौः सुपर्णश्च दधि गौराश्च सर्षपाः ॥ ९६ ॥
verses.transliteration: uccaiḥśravā hayaḥ śrīmān vaidyo dhanvantarirhariḥ | amṛtaṃ gauḥ suparṇaśca dadhi gaurāśca sarṣapāḥ || 96 ||

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लाः सुमनसः कन्याः श्वेतच्छत्रं यवाक्षताः । दूर्वा हिरण्यं गन्धाश्च वालव्यजनमेव च ॥ ९७ ॥
verses.transliteration: śuklāḥ sumanasaḥ kanyāḥ śvetacchatraṃ yavākṣatāḥ | dūrvā hiraṇyaṃ gandhāśca vālavyajanameva ca || 97 ||

verses.sanskrit: तथाप्रतिहतं चक्रं महोक्षश्चन्दनं विषम् । श्वेतो वृषः करी मत्तः सिंहो व्याघ्रो हयो गिरिः ॥ ९८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tathāpratihataṃ cakraṃ mahokṣaścandanaṃ viṣam | śveto vṛṣaḥ karī mattaḥ siṃho vyāghro hayo giriḥ || 98 ||

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवी चोद्धृता लाजा ब्राह्मणा मधु पायसम् । स्वस्तिको वर्द्धमानश्च नन्द्यावर्तः प्रियङ्गवः ॥ ९९ ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛthivī coddhṛtā lājā brāhmaṇā madhu pāyasam | svastiko varddhamānaśca nandyāvartaḥ priyaṅgavaḥ || 99 ||

verses.sanskrit: श्रीफलं गोमयं मत्स्यो दुन्दुभिः पटहस्वनः । ऋषिपत्न्यश्च कन्याश्च श्रीमद् भद्रासनं धनुः । रोचना रुचकश्चैव नदीनां सङ्गमोदकम् ॥ १०० ॥
verses.transliteration: śrīphalaṃ gomayaṃ matsyo dundubhiḥ paṭahasvanaḥ | ṛṣipatnyaśca kanyāśca śrīmad bhadrāsanaṃ dhanuḥ | rocanā rucakaścaiva nadīnāṃ saṅgamodakam || 100 ||

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णाः शतपत्राश्च चकोरा जीवजीवकाः । नन्दीमुखो मयूरश्च बद्धमुक्तामणिध्वजाः ॥ १०१ ॥
verses.transliteration: suparṇāḥ śatapatrāśca cakorā jīvajīvakāḥ | nandīmukho mayūraśca baddhamuktāmaṇidhvajāḥ || 101 ||

verses.sanskrit: आयुधानि प्रशस्तानि कार्यसिद्धिकराणि च । पुण्यं वै विगतक्लेशं श्रीमद् वै मङ्गलान्वितम् ॥ १०२ ॥
verses.transliteration: āyudhāni praśastāni kāryasiddhikarāṇi ca | puṇyaṃ vai vigatakleśaṃ śrīmad vai maṅgalānvitam || 102 ||

verses.sanskrit: रामेणोदाहृतं पूर्वमायुःश्रीजयकाङ्क्षिणा । य इदं श्रावयेद् विद्वांस्तथैव शृणुयान्नरः ॥ १०३ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāmeṇodāhṛtaṃ pūrvamāyuḥśrījayakāṅkṣiṇā | ya idaṃ śrāvayed vidvāṃstathaiva śṛṇuyānnaraḥ || 103 ||

verses.sanskrit: मङ्गलाष्टशतं स्नातो जपन् पर्वणि पर्वणि । वधबन्धपरिक्लेशं व्याधिशोकपराभवम् ॥ १०४ ॥
verses.transliteration: maṅgalāṣṭaśataṃ snāto japan parvaṇi parvaṇi | vadhabandhaparikleśaṃ vyādhiśokaparābhavam || 104 ||

verses.sanskrit: न च प्राप्नोति वैकल्यं परत्रेह च शर्मदम् । धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं पवित्रं वेदसम्मितम् ॥ १०५ ॥
verses.transliteration: na ca prāpnoti vaikalyaṃ paratreha ca śarmadam | dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ pavitraṃ vedasammitam || 105 ||

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमत्स्वर्ग्यं सदा पुण्यमपत्यजननं शिवम् । शुभं क्षेमकरं नॄणां मेधाजननमुत्तमम् । सर्वरोगप्रशमनं स्वकीर्तिकुलवर्धनम् ॥ १०६ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrīmatsvargyaṃ sadā puṇyamapatyajananaṃ śivam | śubhaṃ kṣemakaraṃ nṝṇāṃ medhājananamuttamam | sarvarogapraśamanaṃ svakīrtikulavardhanam || 106 ||

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्दधानो दयोपेतो यः पठेदात्मवान्नरः । सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा लभते च शुभां गतिम् ॥ १०७ ॥
verses.transliteration: śraddadhāno dayopeto yaḥ paṭhedātmavānnaraḥ | sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā labhate ca śubhāṃ gatim || 107 ||

verses.sanskrit: साम्बस्य उत्पत्तिः अस्त्रशिक्षा च, द्वारकायां में आगतानां राजानां मध्ये नारदेन भगवतः श्रीकृष्णस्य धन्यतायाः प्रतिपादनं हृतो यदैव प्रद्युम्नः शाम्बरेणात्मघातिना । मासेऽस्मिन्नेव साम्बस्तु जाम्बवत्यामजायत ॥ १ ॥
verses.transliteration: sāmbasya utpattiḥ astraśikṣā ca, dvārakāyāṃ meṃ āgatānāṃ rājānāṃ madhye nāradena bhagavataḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya dhanyatāyāḥ pratipādanaṃ hṛto yadaiva pradyumnaḥ śāmbareṇātmaghātinā | māse'sminneva sāmbastu jāmbavatyāmajāyata || 1 ||

verses.sanskrit: बाल्यात्प्रभृति रामेण शस्त्रेषु विनियोजितः । रामादनन्तरश्चैव मानितः सर्ववृष्णिभिः ॥ २ ॥
verses.transliteration: bālyātprabhṛti rāmeṇa śastreṣu viniyojitaḥ | rāmādanantaraścaiva mānitaḥ sarvavṛṣṇibhiḥ || 2 ||

verses.sanskrit: जातमात्रे ततः कृष्णः शुभां तामवसत् पुरीम् । निहतामित्रसामन्तः शक्रोद्यानं यथामरः ॥ ३ ॥
verses.transliteration: jātamātre tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śubhāṃ tāmavasat purīm | nihatāmitrasāmantaḥ śakrodyānaṃ yathāmaraḥ || 3 ||

verses.sanskrit: यादवीं च श्रियं दृष्ट्वा स्वां श्रियं द्वेष्टि वासवः । जनार्दनभयाच्चैव न शान्तिं लेभिरे नृपाः ॥ ४ ॥
verses.transliteration: yādavīṃ ca śriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā svāṃ śriyaṃ dveṣṭi vāsavaḥ | janārdanabhayāccaiva na śāntiṃ lebhire nṛpāḥ || 4 ||
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Thus addressed by Varuna Krishna, the multiplier of the Yadu race thought, that what Varuna had said about the kine could not be gainsaid and was accordingly silenced. Thereupon Keshava, who could understand all, smilingly said to Varuna:—"O Lord Varuna, on account of your contract with Vāna you are saved. Specially you have expressed the truth in sweet and charming words. How can I then perform an iniquity by you? O lord of water, you are truthful and therefore for pleasing you I let loose Vāna's cows. And you too are released. There is no doubt about it. Depart now." Thereupon sounding bugles Varuna adored Keshava with _Arghya_. After the Yadu chief Keshava had accepted it from Varuna, the lord of waters, adored Baladeva with a controlled mind. Giving protection unto Varuna, Shouri, the heroic descendant of Shura, with Sachi's lord set out for Dwārakā. The Devas, Maruts, Sāddhyas, Siddhas, Chāranas, Gandharvas, Apsaras, Kinnaras followed Krishna, the eternal lord of all creatures in the etherial way, (95–102). When Keshava, on acquiring victory and fame, proceeded the Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, the two Ashwinis, Yakshas, Rākshasas, Siddhas, Chāranas, and Vidyadharas followed him. Pleased at seeing Vāna and Varuna defeated the great and ever quarrelsome Nārada, set out for Dwārakā. Thus proceeding Keshava, the holder of discus and club, saw from a distance the city of Dwarakā having many doors and adorned with blue-turreted, beautiful palaces resembling the summits of the mount Kailāsha and blew his conch-shell Pānchajanya. As the blare of Pānchajanya used to indicate Keshava's arrival and departure he, with it, communicated the news of his approach to the citizens of Dwārakā. Hearing the sound of Pānchajanya the inhabitants of Dwaraka adorned their respective habitations with profuse flowers, jars full of water and fried paddy. The streets of that prosperous city, abounding in many jems, were cleansed; the Brāhmanas and the elderly persons with arghya and exclaiming his many victories adored Mādhava. People bowed unto Krishna, highly beautiful and resembling a mass of collyrium who sat on Vinatā's son. The Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Sudras in order adored the highly powerful Ananta, the slayer of Keshi. Waiting in a garden of Dwārakā, the lotus-eyed Mādhava was eulogised by the Rishis, gods, Gandharvas and Chāranas. Seeing those wonders and the large-armed Krishna the great Dāshārhas attained to an excess of joy. Beholding the great Purusottama return after defeating Vāna, the inhabitants of Dwārakā began to talk on diverse topics. After the great Krishna, the greatest car-warrior amongst the Yadavas, had returned from that long distance whither he had gone through the help of Suparna they conversed amongst themselves. "Blessed and favoured are we since the kind lord of the universe, the long and mighty-armed Krishna is our protector. Riding on Vinatā's son the lotus-eyed deity defeated the irrepressible Vāna: and now returning to Dwārakā he has gladdened our hearts." While the inhabitants of Dwārakā thus conversed, the gods, the car-warriors, entered into Vasudeva's palace. Then coming down from Garuda's back Vāsudeva, Bahadeva, Pradyumna and Aniruddha entered into the palace. Celestial cars of various forms were then seen moving about in the sky. Drawn by swans, bulls, deer, elephants, horses, Sarasas and peacocks, those thousands of cars displayed a great beauty there (103-121).
verses.hindi: प्रतीत होते थे॥७४॥ उन महाकाय दानवोंके विदीर्ण किये हुए शरीरोंसे खूनकी एक भयंकर नदी बह चली, जिसका स्वरूप बड़ा ही रौद्र था॥७५॥ वह रणभूमिमें रक्तका स्रोत बहाती हुई भीरु पुरुषोंके मनमें भयकी वृद्धि कर रही थी। देवताओं और हैत्योंके हाथी- घोड़ोंके रक्तके प्रवाहसे जहाँ-तहाँ सहस्ीरों स्थानोंमें डूबी हुई वह रणभूमि बड़ी भयंकर प्रतीत हो रही थी॥ ७६॥ निर्जीव यक्ष, राक्षस तथा खेचरोंसे वह भूमि भरी हुई थी। उनके सेवक, ध्वजा, पताका, उपासड़ और रथ सभी वहाँ बिखरे पड़े थे उण्टोंसे विभूषित गजराज धराशायी हो गये थे, सुवर्णपुड्डैज्वलितै्नाराचैस्तिग्मतेजसै: ॥ ७८  उनके कुम्भस्थल फट गये थे। सोनेके पर लगे हुए

verses.commentary: Sense: Vaishampāyana said:—Thus addressed by Varuna Krishna, the multiplier of the Yadu race thought, that what Varuna had said about the kine could not be gainsaid and was accordingly silenced. Thereupon Keshava, who could understand all, smilingly said to Varuna:—"O Lord Varuna,…
verses.science: प्रतीत होते थे॥७४॥ उन महाकाय दानवोंके विदीर्ण किये हुए शरीरोंसे खूनकी एक भयंकर नदी बह चली, जिसका स्वरूप बड़ा ही रौद्र था॥७५॥ वह रणभूमिमें रक्तका स्रोत बहाती…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य पुरे वारणसाह्रये ! दुर्योधनस्य यज्ञे वै समीयुः सर्वपार्थिवाः ॥ ५ ॥
verses.transliteration: kasyacit tvatha kālasya pure vāraṇasāhraye ! duryodhanasya yajñe vai samīyuḥ sarvapārthivāḥ || 5 ||

verses.sanskrit: तां श्रुत्वा माधर्वीं लक्ष्मीं सपुत्रं च जनार्दनम् । पुरीं द्वारावतीं चैव निविष्टां सागरान्तरे ॥ ६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāṃ śrutvā mādharvīṃ lakṣmīṃ saputraṃ ca janārdanam | purīṃ dvārāvatīṃ caiva niviṣṭāṃ sāgarāntare || 6 ||
verses.translation: After the departure of Purandara for the celestial region the highly powerful and great lotus-navelled deity enquired after their well-being. Thereupon there arose on all sides tumult of persons for seeing the moon-like countenance of Keshava. Seeing their devotion the sinless Keshava was highly pleased. Having thus returned to Dwārakā, Krishna, obtaining all objects of desire, riches and prosperity, lived happily
verses.hindi: अग्निचक्रोपमं दीप मण्डलीकृतकार्मुकम् । तदासीद् दानवेन्द्रस्थ सव्यदक्षिणमस्यतः प्रचण्ड तेजवाले प्रज्बलित बाण, जिन्हें देवताओं और दानवोंने छोड़ा था, विषैले सर्पोके समान वहाँ पड़े हुए थे। प्रास, तोमर, नाराच, शक्ति, खड़ग, फरसे, सुवर्ण- निर्मित गदा, मुसल, पट्टिश, सोनेके बाजूबंद, केयूर, तथा रथसे रहित मरे हुए हैत्य तथा घायल होकर पड़े हुए सैकड़ों और हजारों सैनिकोंसे वह रणभूमि भर गयी थी। जहाँ बहुत-से ध्वज और रथ गिराये गये थे, घोड़े, हाथी और रथी मार डाले गये थे, वह देवताओं तथा हैत्योंका विमर्द (संग्राम) उनके कर्मके अनुरूप ही प्रतीत होता था। तदनन्तर हाथोंमें गदा और मुसल लिये हुए पौलोम नामवाले एक सहस्र हैत्योंने श्रीमान् महारथी पवनदेवको घेर लिया॥७८--८४॥ फिर तो लाखों श्रेष्ठ दानवोंने पबनदेवको मारना आरम्भ किया। वे चारों ओरसे बाण मारकर उन्हें चोट पहुँचाने लगे। शरीरमें धँसे हुए उन बाणोंसे उनकी अद्भुत शोभा हो रही थी॥ ८५॥ प्रभावशाली, महारथी, सुरश्रेष्ठ पवनदेवने
verses.wordMeaning: After the departure of Purandara for the celestial region the highly powerful and great lotus-navelled deity enquired after their well-being. Thereupon there arose on all sides tumult of persons for seeing the moon-like countenance of Keshava.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After the departure of Purandara for the celestial region the highly powerful and great lotus-navelled deity enquired after their well-being. Thereupon there arose on all sides tumult of persons for seeing the moon-like countenance of Keshava.…
verses.science: अग्निचक्रोपमं दीप मण्डलीकृतकार्मुकम्। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: दूतैस्तैः कृतसङ्घानाः पृथिव्यां सर्वपार्थिवाः । श्रियं द्रष्टुं दृषीकेशमाजग्मुः कृष्णमन्दिम् ॥ ७ ॥
verses.transliteration: dūtaistaiḥ kṛtasaṅghānāḥ pṛthivyāṃ sarvapārthivāḥ | śriyaṃ draṣṭuṃ dṛṣīkeśamājagmuḥ kṛṣṇamandim || 7 ||

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनमुखाः सर्वे धृतराष्ट्रवशानुगाः । पाण्डवप्रमुखाश्चैव धृष्टद्युम्नादयो नृपाः ॥ ८ ॥
verses.transliteration: duryodhanamukhāḥ sarve dhṛtarāṣṭravaśānugāḥ | pāṇḍavapramukhāścaiva dhṛṣṭadyumnādayo nṛpāḥ || 8 ||
verses.translation: After Ahuka had said this females, performing benedictory ceremonies, as laid down in the ritualistic code, conducted the beautiful Ushā to Aniruddha's house. Beholding Aniruddha Devaki, Revati and the Bidarbha princess Rukshmini shed tears of joy. Thus when Ushā was taken into the room, the beautiful damsels, blowing bugles, began to perform benedictory ceremonies. The beautiful Ushā too, under the shelter of the Yadu chiefs, lived in their palace and enjoyed best of happiness (12-16). After a few days, the Apsarā Chitralekha, who was living there under the guise of a woman, with the permission of Ushā and other companions, started for the celestial region. Thus after the departure of her companions Māyāvati first invited the beautiful Asura princess Ushā and took her to her own residence. Seeing her youthful and beautiful daughter-in law Ushā Pradyumna's wife welcomed her with costly jewels and dresses. Thereupon according to the custom of the family all the ladies of the Yadu race duly treated the new daughter in-law Ushā
verses.hindi: थे॥ ९०॥ दायें-बायें दोनों ओर बाण छोड़ते हुए उस दानवराजका दीपतिमान् धनुष मण्डलाकार होकर अलात- चक्रके समान प्रतीत होता था॥९१॥ उसके धनुषसे छूटे हुए तीखे बाणोंसे, जिनमें सोनेके पर लगे थे और जिन्हें सानपर चढ़ाकर तेज किया गया था, सम्पूर्ण दिशाएँ और सूर्यकी प्रभाएँ भी आच्छादित हो गयीं श्रेणीभूता: प्रकाशन्ते यान्तः एयेना इवाम्बरे॥ गृश्नपत्राउछलाधौतान् कार्तस्वरविभूषितान् । देहे समवकीर्यन्त पूष्ण: संनिहिता: शरा: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: After Ahuka had said this females, performing benedictory ceremonies, as laid down in the ritualistic code, conducted the beautiful Ushā to Aniruddha's house. Beholding Aniruddha Devaki, Revati and the Bidarbha princess Rukshmini shed tears of joy.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After Ahuka had said this females, performing benedictory ceremonies, as laid down in the ritualistic code, conducted the beautiful Ushā to Aniruddha's house. Beholding Aniruddha Devaki, Revati and the Bidarbha princess Rukshmini shed tears of joy.…
verses.science: थे॥ ९०॥ दायें-बायें दोनों ओर बाण छोड़ते हुए उस दानवराजका दीपतिमान् धनुष मण्डलाकार होकर अलात- चक्रके समान प्रतीत होता था॥९१॥ उसके धनुषसे छूटे हुए तीखे बाणोंसे…। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: पाण्ड्याश्चोलकलिङ्गेशा बाह्रीका द्राविडाः खशाः । अक्षौहिणीः प्रकर्षन्तो दृशा चाष्टौ च भूमिपाः ॥ ९ ॥
verses.transliteration: pāṇḍyāścolakaliṅgeśā bāhrīkā drāviḍāḥ khaśāḥ | akṣauhiṇīḥ prakarṣanto dṛśā cāṣṭau ca bhūmipāḥ || 9 ||

verses.sanskrit: आजग्मुर्यादवपुरीं गोविन्दभुजपालिताम् । ते पर्वतं रैवतकं परिवार्यावनीश्वराः ॥ १० ॥
verses.transliteration: ājagmuryādavapurīṃ govindabhujapālitām | te parvataṃ raivatakaṃ parivāryāvanīśvarāḥ || 10 ||

verses.sanskrit: विविशुर्योजनाख्यासु स्वासु स्वासु च भूमिषु । ततः श्रीमान् हृषीकेशाः सह् याद्वपुङ्गवैः ॥ ११ ॥
verses.transliteration: viviśuryojanākhyāsu svāsu svāsu ca bhūmiṣu | tataḥ śrīmān hṛṣīkeśāḥ sah yādvapuṅgavaiḥ || 11 ||

verses.sanskrit: समीपं मानवेन्द्राणां निर्ययौ कमलेक्षणः । स तेषां नरदेवानां मध्यस्थेओ मधुसूदनः ॥ १२ ॥
verses.transliteration: samīpaṃ mānavendrāṇāṃ niryayau kamalekṣaṇaḥ | sa teṣāṃ naradevānāṃ madhyastheo madhusūdanaḥ || 12 ||

verses.sanskrit: व्यराजत यदुश्रेष्ठः शरदीव दिवाकरः । कृत्वा सिंहासने कृष्णः काञ्चने निषसाद् ह । राजानोऽपि यथास्थानं निषेदुर्विविधेष्वथ ॥ १४ ॥
verses.transliteration: vyarājata yaduśreṣṭhaḥ śaradīva divākaraḥ | kṛtvā siṃhāsane kṛṣṇaḥ kāñcane niṣasād ha | rājāno'pi yathāsthānaṃ niṣedurvividheṣvatha || 14 ||

verses.sanskrit: सिंहासनेषु चित्रेषु पीठेषु च नराधिपाः । स यादवनरेन्द्राणां समाजः शुशुभे तदा ॥ १५ ॥
verses.transliteration: siṃhāsaneṣu citreṣu pīṭheṣu ca narādhipāḥ | sa yādavanarendrāṇāṃ samājaḥ śuśubhe tadā || 15 ||

verses.sanskrit: सुराणामसुराणां च सदसि ब्रह्मणो यथा । तेषां चित्राः कथास्तत्र प्रवृत्तास्तत्समागमे । यदूनां पार्थिवानां च केशवस्योपश्रृण्वतः ॥ १६ ॥
verses.transliteration: surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca sadasi brahmaṇo yathā | teṣāṃ citrāḥ kathāstatra pravṛttāstatsamāgame | yadūnāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca keśavasyopaśrṛṇvataḥ || 16 ||

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वायुर्ववौ मेघरवोपमः । तुमुलं दुर्दिनं चासीत् सविद्युत्स्तनयित्नुमत् ॥ १७ ॥
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare vāyurvavau megharavopamaḥ | tumulaṃ durdinaṃ cāsīt savidyutstanayitnumat || 17 ||

verses.sanskrit: तद् दुर्दिनतलं भित्त्वा नारद्ः प्रत्यदृश्यत । सञ्चेष्टितजटाभारो वीणासक्तेन बाहुना ॥ १८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tad durdinatalaṃ bhittvā nāradḥ pratyadṛśyata | sañceṣṭitajaṭābhāro vīṇāsaktena bāhunā || 18 ||
verses.translation: Vyasa said:—O king, the cause thereof will be the ireful curse of a Brāhmana. You may fare well if you try to avoid it. O slayer of enemies, as long as the world will last, the Kshatriyas will not be able to collect materials for your horse-sacrifice (34–35).
verses.hindi: उन्होंने पूर्णतः: कानोंतक खींचकर छोड़े गये झुकी हुई गाँठवाले बाणोंद्वारा लोहेकी ढालोंकों भी छिन्न- भिन्न करके एक-दूसरेको विदीर्ण कर दिया उनके सारे अड्गभ विकृत तथा रक्तसे लथपथ हो गये थे तो भी वे दोनों रथी परम दुर्मद (युद्धके लिये उन्मत्त) दिखायी देते थे। वे तीखे बाणोंसे परस्पर गहरी चोट कर रहे थे और दूसरेकी ओर देख नहीं पाते थे॥ १२३॥ तदनन्तर शम्बरासुरकी आँखें क्रोधसे लाल हो उठीं। वह काल, अन्तक और यमके समान विकराल हो गया। उसने तुरंत ही समरभूमिमें भगदेवताको घायल कर दिया॥ १२४॥ जैसे गरुड़ आकाशमें बड़े भारी सर्पको दबोच लेता है, उसी प्रकार शम्बरासुरने भगको पीड़ित कर दिया। शम्बरासुरके चलाये हुए नाराच भगके शरीरपर तीत्र बेगसे गिरने लगे, किंतु भगने अन्तरिक्षमें ही अपने बाणोंद्वारा उन सभी नाराचोंको काट दिया। तब असुरशिरोमणि शम्बरने अग्निके समान तेजस्वी और पर्वतके समान स्थिरभावसे खड़े हुए प्रकाशमान भगदेवताको महान् वेगशाली सुवर्णभूषित चौंसठ बाणोंसे बींध डाला॥ १२५--१२७॥ उस समय
verses.commentary: Sense: Vyasa said:—O king, the cause thereof will be the ireful curse of a Brāhmana. You may fare well if you try to avoid it. O slayer of enemies, as long as the world will last, the Kshatriyas will not be able to collect materials for your horse-sacrifice (34–35).
verses.science: उन्होंने पूर्णतः: कानोंतक खींचकर छोड़े गये झुकी हुई गाँठवाले बाणोंद्वारा लोहेकी ढालोंकों भी छिन्न- भिन्न करके एक-दूसरेको विदीर्ण कर दिया उनके सारे अड्गभ विकृ…। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: स पपात नरेन्द्राणां मध्ये सागरसन्निभः । नारदोऽग्निशिखाकारः श्रीमाञ्छक्रसखो मुनिः ॥ १९ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa papāta narendrāṇāṃ madhye sāgarasannibhaḥ | nārado'gniśikhākāraḥ śrīmāñchakrasakho muniḥ || 19 ||

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् निपतिते भूमौ नारदे मुनिपुङ्गवे । तदद्भुतं महामेधं व्यपाकृष्यत दुर्दिनम् ॥ २० ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmin nipatite bhūmau nārade munipuṅgave | tadadbhutaṃ mahāmedhaṃ vyapākṛṣyata durdinam || 20 ||

verses.sanskrit: सोऽवगाह्य नरेन्द्राणां मध्ये सागरसन्निभः । आसनस्थं यदुश्रेष्ठमुवाच मुनिरव्ययम् ॥ २१ ॥
verses.transliteration: so'vagāhya narendrāṇāṃ madhye sāgarasannibhaḥ | āsanasthaṃ yaduśreṣṭhamuvāca muniravyayam || 21 ||

verses.sanskrit: आश्चर्यं खलु देवानामेकस्त्वं पुरुषोत्तमः । धन्यश्चासि महाबाहो लोकेनान्योऽस्ति कश्चन ॥ २२ ॥
verses.transliteration: āścaryaṃ khalu devānāmekastvaṃ puruṣottamaḥ | dhanyaścāsi mahābāho lokenānyo'sti kaścana || 22 ||

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः स्मितं कृत्वा प्रत्युवाच मुनिं प्रभुः । आश्चर्यश्चैव धन्यश्च दक्षिणाभिः सहेत्यहम् ॥ २३ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ smitaṃ kṛtvā pratyuvāca muniṃ prabhuḥ | āścaryaścaiva dhanyaśca dakṣiṇābhiḥ sahetyaham || 23 ||
verses.translation: Shouti said:—Thus accosted the Divine Vyāsa accurately thought of the condition of men in the Kali-yuga and began to describe the future cycle
verses.hindi: समान रूप धारण करके वह सौ मस्तकों और सौ पेटोंसे युक्त हो गया (अथवा महानू पर्वतरूप होकर सैकड़ों शिखरों एवं कन्दराओंसे सम्पन्न हो गया)। उस समय वह शतश्रुड्र पर्वतकी भाँति स्वर्गलोकका स्तम्भ- सा दिखायी देता था॥ १४२॥ जो दूसरे देवता, साध्यगण और विश्वेदेव उसके ऊपर दिव्यास्त्र चलाते थे, उनके उन सभी अस्त्रोंको वह असुर अपना ग्रास बना लेता था॥ १४३ ॥ समराज्भणणमें युद्ध करता हुआ वह असुरशिरोमणि शम्बर अपने रथके साथ गन्धर्व-नगरकी भाँति वहीं वे प्रसिद्ध देवता समरभूमिमें विचित्र युद्ध करनेवाले सहस््र मायाधारी शम्बरासुरको भयभीत होकर देखने लगे॥ १४५॥ उस युद्धस्थलमें दानवराज शम्बरासुरके भयसे संत्रस्त हो महाभाग भगदेवता अपना रथ छोड़कर
verses.commentary: Sense: Shouti said:—Thus accosted the Divine Vyāsa accurately thought of the condition of men in the Kali-yuga and began to describe the future cycle
verses.science: समान रूप धारण करके वह सौ मस्तकों और सौ पेटोंसे युक्त हो गया (अथवा महानू पर्वतरूप होकर सैकड़ों शिखरों एवं कन्दराओंसे सम्पन्न हो गया)। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो मुनिश्रेष्ठः प्राह मध्ये मद्दीभृताम् । कृष्ण पर्याप्तवाक्योऽस्मि गमिष्यामि यथागतम् ॥ २४ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamukto muniśreṣṭhaḥ prāha madhye maddībhṛtām | kṛṣṇa paryāptavākyo'smi gamiṣyāmi yathāgatam || 24 ||

verses.sanskrit: तं प्रस्थितमभिप्रेक्ष्य पार्थिवाः प्राहुरीश्वरम् । गुह्यं मन्त्रमजानन्तो वचनं नारदेरितम् ॥ २५ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṃ prasthitamabhiprekṣya pārthivāḥ prāhurīśvaram | guhyaṃ mantramajānanto vacanaṃ nāraderitam || 25 ||

verses.sanskrit: आश्चर्यमित्यभिहितं धन्योऽसीति च माधव । दक्षिणाभिः सहेत्येवं प्रत्युक्तेऽपि च नारदे ॥ २६ ॥
verses.transliteration: āścaryamityabhihitaṃ dhanyo'sīti ca mādhava | dakṣiṇābhiḥ sahetyevaṃ pratyukte'pi ca nārade || 26 ||

verses.sanskrit: किमेतन्नाभिजानीमो दिव्यं मन्त्रपदं महत् । यदि श्राव्यमिदं कृष्ण श्रोतुमिच्छाम तत्त्वतः ॥ २७ ॥
verses.transliteration: kimetannābhijānīmo divyaṃ mantrapadaṃ mahat | yadi śrāvyamidaṃ kṛṣṇa śrotumicchāma tattvataḥ || 27 ||

verses.sanskrit: तानुवाच ततः कृष्णः सर्वान् पार्थिवपुङ्गवान् । श्रोतव्यं नारदस्त्वेष द्विजो वः कथयिष्यति ॥ २८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tānuvāca tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvān pārthivapuṅgavān | śrotavyaṃ nāradastveṣa dvijo vaḥ kathayiṣyati || 28 ||

verses.sanskrit: ब्रूहि नारद तत्त्वार्थं श्रीतुकामा महीभुजः । यत् त्वयाभिहितं वाक्यं मया नु प्रतिभाषितम् ॥ २९॥ , स पीठे काञ्चने शुभ्रे सूपविष्टः स्वलङ्कृतः । प्रभावं तस्य वन्द्यस्य प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमे ॥ ३० ॥
verses.transliteration: brūhi nārada tattvārthaṃ śrītukāmā mahībhujaḥ | yat tvayābhihitaṃ vākyaṃ mayā nu pratibhāṣitam || 29|| , sa pīṭhe kāñcane śubhre sūpaviṣṭaḥ svalaṅkṛtaḥ | prabhāvaṃ tasya vandyasya pravaktumupacakrame || 30 ||

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयतां भो नृपश्रेष्ठा यावन्तः स्थ समागताः । अस्य कृष्णस्य महतो यथा पारमहं गतः ॥ ३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrūyatāṃ bho nṛpaśreṣṭhā yāvantaḥ stha samāgatāḥ | asya kṛṣṇasya mahato yathā pāramahaṃ gataḥ || 31 ||

verses.sanskrit: अहं कदाचिद् गङ्गायास्तीरे त्रिषवणातिथिः । चराम्येकः क्षपापाये दृश्यमाने दिवाकरे ॥ ३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ kadācid gaṅgāyāstīre triṣavaṇātithiḥ | carāmyekaḥ kṣapāpāye dṛśyamāne divākare || 32 ||

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यं गिरिकूटाभं कपालद्वयदेहिनम् । क्रोशमण्डलविस्तारं तावद् द्विगुणमायतम् ॥ ३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: apaśyaṃ girikūṭābhaṃ kapāladvayadehinam | krośamaṇḍalavistāraṃ tāvad dviguṇamāyatam || 33 ||

verses.sanskrit: चतुश्चरणसुश्लिष्टं क्लिन्नं चैव सपङ्किलम् ॥ मम वीणाकृतिं कूर्मं गजचर्मचयोपमम् ॥ ३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: catuścaraṇasuśliṣṭaṃ klinnaṃ caiva sapaṅkilam || mama vīṇākṛtiṃ kūrmaṃ gajacarmacayopamam || 34 ||

verses.sanskrit: सोऽहं तं पाणिना स्पृष्ट्वा प्रोक्तवाञ्जलचारिणम् । त्वमाश्चर्यशरीरोऽसि कूर्म धन्योऽसि मे मतः ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: so'haṃ taṃ pāṇinā spṛṣṭvā proktavāñjalacāriṇam | tvamāścaryaśarīro'si kūrma dhanyo'si me mataḥ || 35 ||

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वमेवमभेद्याभ्यां कपालाभ्यां समावृतः । तोये चरसि निःशङ्कः कञ्चिज्ञमचिन्तयन् ॥ ३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: yastvamevamabhedyābhyāṃ kapālābhyāṃ samāvṛtaḥ | toye carasi niḥśaṅkaḥ kañcijñamacintayan || 36 ||

verses.sanskrit: स मामुवाचाम्बुचरः कूर्मो मानुषवत्स्वयम् । किमाश्चर्ये मयि मुने धन्यश्चाहं कथं विभो ॥ ३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa māmuvācāmbucaraḥ kūrmo mānuṣavatsvayam | kimāścarye mayi mune dhanyaścāhaṃ kathaṃ vibho || 37 ||

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गेयं निम्नगा धन्या किमाश्चर्यमतः परम् ॥ यत्राहमिव सत्त्वानि चरन्त्ययुतशो द्विज ॥ ३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: gaṅgeyaṃ nimnagā dhanyā kimāścaryamataḥ param || yatrāhamiva sattvāni carantyayutaśo dvija || 38 ||

verses.sanskrit: सोऽहं कुतूहलाविष्टो नर्दी गङ्गामुपस्थितः । धन्यासि त्वं सरिच्छ्रेष्ठे नित्यमाश्चर्यभूषिता ॥ ३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: so'haṃ kutūhalāviṣṭo nardī gaṅgāmupasthitaḥ | dhanyāsi tvaṃ saricchreṣṭhe nityamāścaryabhūṣitā || 39 ||

verses.sanskrit: या त्वमेवं महादेहैः श्वापदैरुपशोभिता । ह्रदिनी सागरं यासि रक्षन्ती तापसालयान् ॥ ४० ॥
verses.transliteration: yā tvamevaṃ mahādehaiḥ śvāpadairupaśobhitā | hradinī sāgaraṃ yāsi rakṣantī tāpasālayān || 40 ||

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ता ततो गङ्गा रूपिणी प्रत्यभाषत । नारदं देवगन्धर्वं शक्रस्य दयितं द्विजम् ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktā tato gaṅgā rūpiṇī pratyabhāṣata | nāradaṃ devagandharvaṃ śakrasya dayitaṃ dvijam || 45 ||
verses.hindi: विरोचनश्चरन् मार्गान् प्रकारानेकविंशतिम् केचिद् वरासिना रुग्णा दानवेन महात्मना। विनेदुश्छिन्नवर्माणो निपेतुश्ष गतासवः विद्वुता: स्वान्यनीकानि जष्नुस्त्रिदशवारणा: निपेतुरुर्व्यामाकाशे निकृता दृढ्धन्विना। विविधास्तोमराश्चापा महामात्रशिरांसि च
verses.translation: Vyasa said:—When Kali will set in the kings, incapable of protecting their subjects, will only guard themselves busily exacting tributes from them. At the end of this cycle the kings will not act like the Kshatriyas, the Brāhmanas will carry on their livelihood like the Sudras and the Sudras will behave like the Brāhmanas. O Janamejaya, at the end of this cycle the Brāhmanas, well read in Srutis and Vedas, will take up arrows and Havi will be divorced from sacrifices and all people will take their meals in the same row. When the last of the cycles Kali will appear men will be artizans, untruthful, fond of wine and meat and know the wives of their friends. In the Kali Yuga the thieves will fare like the kings and the kings will act like thieves and the servants will enjoy unfixed incomes. In the last cycle wealth will be spoken of highly, the character of the pious will be despised and the fallen will not be censured. The widows, divorced from the consciousness of virtue and sin, the ascetics and men of fifteen years of age will procreate offspring through promiscuous intercourse. In that last cycle the villagers will sell food, the Brāhmanas will sell the Vedas, and the women will sell their persons. In this cycle all will read the Vedas and celebrate Vajasaneyi sacrifices and the Sudras will (boldly) address all as "O". The Sudras following the tenets of Buddha will abstain from taking meat. And with white teeth, keen observation and shaving their heads and wearing silk raiments they will practise religion (5-15). The Mlechchas will live in the province of Kurupānchāla and people of that country will live in that of the former. In the end of the cycle men will go downwards. The Brāhmanas will sell the fruits of Tapas and sacrifices and the seasons will be perverted. The beasts, with tusks and teeth, will be set to ploughs and carts: men will till with the water of ponds and the clouds will irregularly discharge their contents. The thieves will steal the wealth of one another and wretched men will be rich acquiring very little money. In this last cycle men will be divorced from religious rites, the divisions of the land will abound in deserts, and the cities will be traversed by many roads. In the Kali yuga every body will become a merchant and the sons will divide the ancestral gifts. Impelled by covetuousness and false-hood people will fight with one another and rob their wealth. In the absence of beauty, personal grace and ornaments the women will be only adorned with hairs (16-22). In this last cycle, men, divorced from all objects of enjoyment, as garlands, sandal, etc., will find pleasure only in their wives (22–23). When the wicked and non-aryans will multiply, when the number of males will decrease, and dis-proportionate to it that of women will increase know this as the real sign of the end of the cycle. Then every body will be a beggar: and no one will give alms. Without distinction people will accept gifts from other Varnas (orders), And afflicted by the king, thieves and fire, people will meet with extinction. In this last cycle people will not get crops, youthful persons will be visited by decrepitude and people will be unhappy for their bad ambition. Blowing high and downwards the wind will shower dust in the rany season and people will feel doubts about the next world. Every one will be wicked by nature, will villify the God and be egoistic: being covetous the Brāhmanas will blame others. Adopting the ways of the Vaishyas the Kshatriyas will maintain themselves by cultivation and trade and the Brāhmanas will destroy the dignity of religion (24-29). In the end of the cycle men will not observe their vows and promise. And what to speak of their satisfying their own debts, they will, for it, even cast off courtesy. Fruitless will be a man's joy and fruitful will be his anger. For milk the sheep will be regarded. In the end of the cycle, men, shorn of the knowledge of scriptures, will naturally behave thus. Disregarding moral laws, men, proud of their own learning, will interpret the Sastras. When the last cycle will set in every one, without the instruction of their elders, will acquire knowledge in all branches and there will be no one who will not be a poet. Deviating from their right duties the Brāhmanas will turn out astrologers and the kings will become thieves (30–34). In the end of the cycle those men, who will co-habit with bastard women, be deceiptful and drunkards, will be Brahmavadins and celebrate horse sacrifices. Eager for acquiring riches the Brāhmanas will officiate as priests for unworthy persons and partake of the forbidden food. Every one will recite "Bho!" and no one will study the Vedas. The women will put on one conch bangle and use an ornament of the shape of a paddy. The stars will not be united with proper planets, the quarters will be contrary—the appearance of an evening and burning will always be seen. The son will engage his father in works and the daughter-in-law will order her mother-in-law. Men will co-habit with beasts and women of different castes. The disciples will wound their preceptors with wordy shafts and men, maddened, will speak many things. Without offering the first four oblations to the gods the Agnihotris will take their meals; and without offering food to their guests, men will eat themselves. Deceiving their sleeping husbands the women will visit other men, and men too, leaving their sleeping wives, will go to other women. When the cycle will run out people will be visited with diseases, mental agony and envy and they will not remedy their own actions (35–43).
verses.explanation: विरोचनश्चरन् मार्गान् प्रकारानेकविंशतिम् केचिद् वरासिना रुग्णा दानवेन महात्मना। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: विरोचनश्चरन् मार्गान् प्रकारानेकविंशतिम् केचिद् वरासिना रुग्णा दानवेन महात्मना। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मा मैवं देवगन्धर्व सङ्ग्रामकलहप्रिय । नाहं धन्या द्विजश्रेष्ठ नैवाश्चर्योपशोभिता ॥ ४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: mā maivaṃ devagandharva saṅgrāmakalahapriya | nāhaṃ dhanyā dvijaśreṣṭha naivāścaryopaśobhitā || 42 ||

verses.sanskrit: तव सत्ये निविष्टस्य वाक्यं मां प्रतिबाधते । सर्वाश्चर्यकरो लोके धन्यश्चैवार्णवो द्विज ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tava satye niviṣṭasya vākyaṃ māṃ pratibādhate | sarvāścaryakaro loke dhanyaścaivārṇavo dvija || 43 ||

verses.sanskrit: यत्राहमिव विस्तीर्णाः शतशो यान्ति निम्नगाः । सोऽहं त्रिपथगावाक्यं श्रुत्वार्णवमुपस्थितः ॥ ४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: yatrāhamiva vistīrṇāḥ śataśo yānti nimnagāḥ | so'haṃ tripathagāvākyaṃ śrutvārṇavamupasthitaḥ || 44 ||

verses.sanskrit: आश्चर्य खलु लोकान धन्यश्चासि महार्णव । येन खल्वसि योनिस्त्वमम्भसां सलिलेश्वरः ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: āścarya khalu lokāna dhanyaścāsi mahārṇava | yena khalvasi yonistvamambhasāṃ salileśvaraḥ || 45 ||

verses.sanskrit: स्थाने त्वां वारिवाहिन्यः सरितो लोकपावनाः । इमाः समभिगच्छन्ति पत्न्यो लोकनमस्कृताः ॥ ४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sthāne tvāṃ vārivāhinyaḥ sarito lokapāvanāḥ | imāḥ samabhigacchanti patnyo lokanamaskṛtāḥ || 46 ||
verses.hindi: जघानाचलसंकाशो मत्तवारणविक्रमः । स्फुरद्धिर्निशितैस्तीक्ष्णशरैर्बहुभिराशुगै: देवसैन्यसहस्राणि सरथानि महाहवे। तस्य बाणपथं प्राप्य नाभ्यवर्तन्त सर्वशः देवानामजयः क्रूरः प्रत्यपद्यत दारुण: अकरोद् दानवश्रेष्ठ उद्दिश्योद्दिश्य तान् बली

verses.science: जघानाचलसंकाशो मत्तवारणविक्रमः। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रस्त्वेवमुक्तस्तु ततो मामवदद्वचः । स्वं जलौघतलं भित्त्वा व्युत्थितः पवनेरितः ॥ ४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: samudrastvevamuktastu tato māmavadadvacaḥ | svaṃ jalaughatalaṃ bhittvā vyutthitaḥ pavaneritaḥ || 47 ||

verses.sanskrit: मा मैवं देवगन्धर्व नास्म्याश्चर्यो द्विजर्षभ । वसुधेयं मुने धन्या यत्राहमुपरि स्थितः ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.transliteration: mā maivaṃ devagandharva nāsmyāścaryo dvijarṣabha | vasudheyaṃ mune dhanyā yatrāhamupari sthitaḥ || 48 ||

verses.sanskrit: ऋते तु पृथिवीं लोके किमाश्चर्यमतः परम् । सोऽहं सागरवाक्येन क्षितिं क्षितितले स्थितः ॥ ४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛte tu pṛthivīṃ loke kimāścaryamataḥ param | so'haṃ sāgaravākyena kṣitiṃ kṣititale sthitaḥ || 49 ||

verses.sanskrit: कौतूहलसमाविष्टो ह्यब्रुवं जगतो गतिम् । धरित्रि देहिनां योने धन्या खल्वसि शोभने ॥ ५० ॥
verses.transliteration: kautūhalasamāviṣṭo hyabruvaṃ jagato gatim | dharitri dehināṃ yone dhanyā khalvasi śobhane || 50 ||

verses.sanskrit: आश्चर्यं चापि भूतेषु महत्या क्षमया युते । तेन खल्वसि भूतानां धरणी मनुजारणिः ॥ ५१ ॥
verses.transliteration: āścaryaṃ cāpi bhūteṣu mahatyā kṣamayā yute | tena khalvasi bhūtānāṃ dharaṇī manujāraṇiḥ || 51 ||

verses.sanskrit: क्षमा त्वत्तः प्रभूता च कर्म चाम्बरगामिनाम् । ततो भूः स्तुतिवाक्येन सा मयोक्तेन तेजिता ॥ ५२ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣamā tvattaḥ prabhūtā ca karma cāmbaragāminām | tato bhūḥ stutivākyena sā mayoktena tejitā || 52 ||

verses.sanskrit: विहाय सहजं धैर्यं प्रत्यक्षा मामभाषत । देवगन्धर्व मा मैवं सङ्ग्रामकलहप्रिय ॥ ५३ ॥
verses.transliteration: vihāya sahajaṃ dhairyaṃ pratyakṣā māmabhāṣata | devagandharva mā maivaṃ saṅgrāmakalahapriya || 53 ||

verses.sanskrit: नास्मि धन्या न चाश्चर्ये पारक्येयं धृतिर्मम । एते धन्या द्विजश्रेष्ठ पर्वता धारयन्ति माम् ॥ ५४ ॥
verses.transliteration: nāsmi dhanyā na cāścarye pārakyeyaṃ dhṛtirmama | ete dhanyā dvijaśreṣṭha parvatā dhārayanti mām || 54 ||

verses.sanskrit: आश्चर्याणि च दृश्यन्ते एते लोकस्य हेतवः । सोऽहं धरणिवाक्येन पर्वतान् समुपस्थितः ॥ ५५ ॥
verses.transliteration: āścaryāṇi ca dṛśyante ete lokasya hetavaḥ | so'haṃ dharaṇivākyena parvatān samupasthitaḥ || 55 ||

verses.sanskrit: धन्या भवन्तो दृश्यन्ते बह्वाश्चर्याश्च भूधराः । काञ्चनस्याग्ररत्नस्य घातूनां च विशेषतः ॥ ५६ ॥
verses.transliteration: dhanyā bhavanto dṛśyante bahvāścaryāśca bhūdharāḥ | kāñcanasyāgraratnasya ghātūnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 56 ||

verses.sanskrit: तेन खल्वाकराः सर्वे भवन्तो भुवि शाश्वताः । ते ममैतद् वचः श्रुत्वा पर्वतास्तस्थुषां वराः ॥ ५७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tena khalvākarāḥ sarve bhavanto bhuvi śāśvatāḥ | te mamaitad vacaḥ śrutvā parvatāstasthuṣāṃ varāḥ || 57 ||

verses.sanskrit: ऊचुर्मां सान्त्वयुक्तानि वचांसि घनशोभिताः । ब्रह्मर्षे न वयं धन्या नाप्याश्चर्याणि सन्ति नः । ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिर्धन्यः सर्वाश्चर्यः सुरेष्वपि ॥ ५८ ॥
verses.transliteration: ūcurmāṃ sāntvayuktāni vacāṃsi ghanaśobhitāḥ | brahmarṣe na vayaṃ dhanyā nāpyāścaryāṇi santi naḥ | brahmā prajāpatirdhanyaḥ sarvāścaryaḥ sureṣvapi || 58 ||

verses.sanskrit: सोऽहं प्रजापतिं गत्वा सर्वप्रभवमव्ययम् । तस्य वाक्यस्य पर्यायपर्याप्तमिव लक्षये ॥ ५९ ॥
verses.transliteration: so'haṃ prajāpatiṃ gatvā sarvaprabhavamavyayam | tasya vākyasya paryāyaparyāptamiva lakṣaye || 59 ||

verses.sanskrit: सोऽहं पितामहं देवं लोकयोनिं चतुर्मुखम् । स्तोतुं पश्चादुपगतः प्रणतोऽवनताननः ॥ ६० ॥
verses.transliteration: so'haṃ pitāmahaṃ devaṃ lokayoniṃ caturmukham | stotuṃ paścādupagataḥ praṇato'vanatānanaḥ || 60 ||

verses.sanskrit: सोऽहं वाक्यसमाप्त्यर्थं श्रावये पद्मयोनिजम् । आश्चर्यं भगवानेको धन्योऽसि जगतो गुरुः ॥ ६१ ॥
verses.transliteration: so'haṃ vākyasamāptyarthaṃ śrāvaye padmayonijam | āścaryaṃ bhagavāneko dhanyo'si jagato guruḥ || 61 ||

verses.sanskrit: न किञ्चिदन्यत् पश्यामि भूतं यद्भवता समम् । त्वत्तः सर्वमिदं जातं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम् ॥ ६२ ॥
verses.transliteration: na kiñcidanyat paśyāmi bhūtaṃ yadbhavatā samam | tvattaḥ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam || 62 ||

verses.sanskrit: सदेवदानवा मर्त्या लोके भूतेन्द्रियात्मकाः । भवन्ति सर्वदेवेश दृष्ट्वा सर्वमिदं जगत् ॥ ६३ ॥
verses.transliteration: sadevadānavā martyā loke bhūtendriyātmakāḥ | bhavanti sarvadeveśa dṛṣṭvā sarvamidaṃ jagat || 63 ||

verses.sanskrit: तेन खल्वसि देवानां देवदेवः सनातनः । तेषामेवासि यत्स्रष्टा लोकानामादिसम्भवः ॥ ६४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tena khalvasi devānāṃ devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ | teṣāmevāsi yatsraṣṭā lokānāmādisambhavaḥ || 64 ||

verses.sanskrit: ततो मां प्राह भगवान् ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । धन्याश्चर्याश्रितैर्वाक्यैः किं मां नारद भाषसे ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato māṃ prāha bhagavān brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | dhanyāścaryāśritairvākyaiḥ kiṃ māṃ nārada bhāṣase || 65 ||
verses.hindi: ततो हाहाकृताः सर्वे देवे भूतलमाभ्रिते। जगत् सदेवमाविग्न॑ यथार्कपतनं तथा जयश्निया सेव्यमानो दीप्यमान इवाचलः। प्रगृह्म कार्मुंकं घोर गतः शक्ररथं प्रति प्रयुद्धो सह वृत्रेण बलिना देवतारिणा आसाद्य सो5श्विनी हैत्य: स्थितो गिरिरिवाचल: यक्षराक्षसदेवीघा वृत्रस्थापि च निःस्वनम्
verses.translation: Vyasa said:—When Kali will set in the kings, incapable of protecting their subjects, will only guard themselves busily exacting tributes from them. At the end of this cycle the kings will not act like the Kshatriyas, the Brāhmanas will carry on their livelihood like the Sudras and the Sudras will behave like the Brāhmanas. O Janamejaya, at the end of this cycle the Brāhmanas, well read in Srutis and Vedas, will take up arrows and Havi will be divorced from sacrifices and all people will take their meals in the same row. When the last of the cycles Kali will appear men will be artizans, untruthful, fond of wine and meat and know the wives of their friends. In the Kali Yuga the thieves will fare like the kings and the kings will act like thieves and the servants will enjoy unfixed incomes. In the last cycle wealth will be spoken of highly, the character of the pious will be despised and the fallen will not be censured. The widows, divorced from the consciousness of virtue and sin, the ascetics and men of fifteen years of age will procreate offspring through promiscuous intercourse. In that last cycle the villagers will sell food, the Brāhmanas will sell the Vedas, and the women will sell their persons. In this cycle all will read the Vedas and celebrate Vajasaneyi sacrifices and the Sudras will (boldly) address all as "O". The Sudras following the tenets of Buddha will abstain from taking meat. And with white teeth, keen observation and shaving their heads and wearing silk raiments they will practise religion (5-15). The Mlechchas will live in the province of Kurupānchāla and people of that country will live in that of the former. In the end of the cycle men will go downwards. The Brāhmanas will sell the fruits of Tapas and sacrifices and the seasons will be perverted. The beasts, with tusks and teeth, will be set to ploughs and carts: men will till with the water of ponds and the clouds will irregularly discharge their contents. The thieves will steal the wealth of one another and wretched men will be rich acquiring very little money. In this last cycle men will be divorced from religious rites, the divisions of the land will abound in deserts, and the cities will be traversed by many roads. In the Kali yuga every body will become a merchant and the sons will divide the ancestral gifts. Impelled by covetuousness and false-hood people will fight with one another and rob their wealth. In the absence of beauty, personal grace and ornaments the women will be only adorned with hairs (16-22). In this last cycle, men, divorced from all objects of enjoyment, as garlands, sandal, etc., will find pleasure only in their wives (22–23). When the wicked and non-aryans will multiply, when the number of males will decrease, and dis-proportionate to it that of women will increase know this as the real sign of the end of the cycle. Then every body will be a beggar: and no one will give alms. Without distinction people will accept gifts from other Varnas (orders), And afflicted by the king, thieves and fire, people will meet with extinction. In this last cycle people will not get crops, youthful persons will be visited by decrepitude and people will be unhappy for their bad ambition. Blowing high and downwards the wind will shower dust in the rany season and people will feel doubts about the next world. Every one will be wicked by nature, will villify the God and be egoistic: being covetous the Brāhmanas will blame others. Adopting the ways of the Vaishyas the Kshatriyas will maintain themselves by cultivation and trade and the Brāhmanas will destroy the dignity of religion (24-29). In the end of the cycle men will not observe their vows and promise. And what to speak of their satisfying their own debts, they will, for it, even cast off courtesy. Fruitless will be a man's joy and fruitful will be his anger. For milk the sheep will be regarded. In the end of the cycle, men, shorn of the knowledge of scriptures, will naturally behave thus. Disregarding moral laws, men, proud of their own learning, will interpret the Sastras. When the last cycle will set in every one, without the instruction of their elders, will acquire knowledge in all branches and there will be no one who will not be a poet. Deviating from their right duties the Brāhmanas will turn out astrologers and the kings will become thieves (30–34). In the end of the cycle those men, who will co-habit with bastard women, be deceiptful and drunkards, will be Brahmavadins and celebrate horse sacrifices. Eager for acquiring riches the Brāhmanas will officiate as priests for unworthy persons and partake of the forbidden food. Every one will recite "Bho!" and no one will study the Vedas. The women will put on one conch bangle and use an ornament of the shape of a paddy. The stars will not be united with proper planets, the quarters will be contrary—the appearance of an evening and burning will always be seen. The son will engage his father in works and the daughter-in-law will order her mother-in-law. Men will co-habit with beasts and women of different castes. The disciples will wound their preceptors with wordy shafts and men, maddened, will speak many things. Without offering the first four oblations to the gods the Agnihotris will take their meals; and without offering food to their guests, men will eat themselves. Deceiving their sleeping husbands the women will visit other men, and men too, leaving their sleeping wives, will go to other women. When the cycle will run out people will be visited with diseases, mental agony and envy and they will not remedy their own actions (35–43).
verses.explanation: ततो हाहाकृताः सर्वे देवे भूतलमाभ्रिते। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: ततो हाहाकृताः सर्वे देवे भूतलमाभ्रिते। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आश्चर्यं परमं वेदा धन्या वेदाश्च नारद । ये लोकान् धारयन्ति स्म वेदास्तत्त्वार्थदर्शिनः ॥ ६६ ॥
verses.transliteration: āścaryaṃ paramaṃ vedā dhanyā vedāśca nārada | ye lokān dhārayanti sma vedāstattvārthadarśinaḥ || 66 ||

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्सामयजुषां सत्यमथर्वणि च यन्मतम् । तन्मयं विद्धि मां विप्रं धृतोऽहं तैर्मया च ते ॥ ६७ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛksāmayajuṣāṃ satyamatharvaṇi ca yanmatam | tanmayaṃ viddhi māṃ vipraṃ dhṛto'haṃ tairmayā ca te || 67 ||
verses.hindi: इसके बाद उसने पुनः रणभूमिमें सुन्दर पंखयुक्त सूर्यसदृश तेजस्वी, अनृपम एवं कालके समान भयंकर बाणका संधान करके उसे हरिपर छोड़ दिया॥ ३९॥ भयंकर कर्म करनेवाले उस दानवके उस बाणप्रहारसे युद्धस्थलमें हरिदेवता सहसा मूर्च्छित हो गये और पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़े ॥ ४०॥ हरिदेवके धराशायी होते ही सब लोग हाहाकार करने लगे। देवताओंसहित सारा जगत उद्दिग्न हो उठा, मानो साक्षात् सूर्यदेव आकाशसे पृथ्वीपर टूट गिरे हों ॥ ४१ ॥ हरिको सब ओरसे घेरकर खड़े हुए जो सैनिक थे, उन सबको मारकर उस दानवराजने समराड्भणमें देवपक्षके इकतीस हजार योद्धाओंका संहार कर डाला विजयश्रीसे सेवित हो दीप्तिमान् पर्वतकी भाँति प्रतीत होनेवाला असिलोमा घोर धनुष लेकर इन्द्रके रथकी ओर चला गया॥४३॥ इसी प्रकार उस महायुद्धमें सेनासहित दोनों अश्विनीकुमार बलवान देवद्रोही वृत्रासुरके साथ युद्ध कर रहे थे॥ ४४॥ वृत्रासुरके हाथमें बाण, खड्ग और धनुष थे। वह जीवनका मोह छोड़कर समरभूमिमें आया था। वह हैत्य दोनों अश्विनीकुमारोंके पास पहुँचकर पर्वतके समान अविचल भावसे खड़ा हो
